jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to strengthen the systems that power our go-to-market teams.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the processes, workflows, automations, and data architecture that accelerate how we find, engage, win, onboard, retain, and expand customers at scale. You will partner across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership to turn fragmented systems and manual work into a high-leverage GTM engine.

If you naturally think: “This should be an automated system, not a spreadsheet.” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. We would love to connect with you about enabling our rapidly growing revenue team. You will play a key role in increasing internal efficiency and productivity to support the team in creating the best customer experience, and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • CRM and revenue tech stack architecture

    • Own end-to-end CRM administration as the single source of truth for revenue activities

    • Manage the design, configuration, and roadmap of a connected revenue tech stack

    • Set and enforce data governance standards: field hygiene, deduplication, permissions, and ongoing data-quality monitoring

  • Automation and data foundation

    • Automate and enrich the manual layer with workflows and LLMs

    • Build and maintain operational dashboards (recurring KPIs, data hygiene, system adoption)

    • Advise with thought leadership on which tooling we procure next as we scale

  • Cross-functional partnership and enablement

    • Operational business partner to GTM leadership

    • Drive systems and process adoption across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership teams through training and enablement

    • Act as first point of contact for revenue system support tickets

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • GTM signals are consistently translated into actionable workflows

  • Sellers and customer-facing teams spend materially less time on manual admin and prep

  • Critical revenue systems are connected, key workflows are AI-assisted or fully automated

  • Leadership has a real-time view into pipeline, conversion, execution, and customer health

You're a great fit if you:

  • 5+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS hypergrowth environment

  • Deep hands-on expertise in CRM administration (HubSpot/Salesforce)

  • Proven track record building revenue systems, processes, and data flows from scratch

  • Persistent problem-solver at your core

  • Sharp entrepreneurial instincts and analytical mindset

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management

What you can look forward to:

  • Taking full ownership of high-leverage systems and delivering work that directly impacts pipeline, productivity, and revenue

  • Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up

  • A competitive compensation and equity package that reflects the leverage and strategic importance of the role

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive II - DACH
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive II to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of Public Sector enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex deals with multiple stakeholders, and you'll have the support of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close. Camunda’s capabilities are well-aligned to the use cases that will help the DACH Administration digitize and automate for more efficiency and agility - this is an opportunity to shape and build a large and meaningful business!

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies Land opportunities and Expand possibilities, leveraging your extended resources such as Partners, Marketing, Inside Sales, Customer Success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to business and technical buyers, tailoring the message to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Handle tender processes with precision, observe pipeline health with discipline, manage Forecast with accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in DACH, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Efficient balance between driving towards a customer vision and achieving short-term projects towards this horizon.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with own initiative. The playbook will not provide all answers in advance!

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, orchestrating resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you, and you're learning to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • Experience navigating complex public procurement procedures - knowing and following the processes but also influencing them with initiative and creativity.

jobs.title: Senior PR Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German ( desirable), depending on territory.

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

jobs.title: Er du den nye selgeren ved Narvesen Moss jbst.?
jobs.description:
Vi søker en selger deltid som trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Som selger i Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk hverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet. Hvis du har et lite konkurranseinnstinkt, tipper vi at du vil ha det gøy med alle salgskonkurransene vi kjører!

Hvem er du?
Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er

  • effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder

Hvorfor Narvesen?
Som en del av Reitan Convenience har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!


Narvesen er den originale kiosken i Norge. Vi har vært en del av hverdagen til det norske folk siden 1894. I dag er vi en fleksibel, smidig og fremoverlent convenience-kjede som leder utviklingen fremover med stadig nye tanker, ideer og løsninger. Vi er der for dem som raskt og enkelt ønsker å forenkle hverdagen på en måte som gir god samvittighet. Våre kunder er på farten, og vi skal hjelpe dem med påfyll i en ellers så travel hverdag. Narvesen er en del av Reitan Convenience Norway.

För vår kunds räkning söker vi nu en Systemspecialist inom IT-drift som vill arbeta med verksamhetskritiska plattformar där stabilitet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet står i fokus. Välkommen med din ansökan!

OM TJÄNSTEN:

I rollen som Systemspecialist inom IT-drift blir du en del av ett team som ansvarar för drift, övervakning och vidareutveckling av tekniska plattformar som används för säker kommunikation och överföring av kritisk information. Du kommer att arbeta i en tekniskt komplex IT-miljö där systemen hanterar stora mängder information och där höga krav ställs på tillgänglighet, kvalitet och säkerhet.

Rollen kombinerar operativ systemdrift med avancerad felsökning och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete. Du ansvarar för att säkerställa att plattformarna fungerar stabilt och effektivt, samtidigt som du arbetar med att identifiera tekniska problem, hantera incidenter och utveckla lösningar som stärker systemens funktionalitet och säkerhet.

Du kommer även att arbeta med tekniska ärenden inom tredje linjens support samt testa och kvalitetssäkra nya funktioner och tjänster innan de implementeras. I rollen har du ett nära samarbete med kollegor inom bland annat utveckling, support och IT-infrastruktur för att tillsammans säkerställa välfungerande tekniska lösningar.

Du kommer till exempel att:

    Ansvara för drift och övervakning av verksamhetskritiska IT-plattformar
    Felsöka och lösa komplexa tekniska problem inom tredje linjens support
    Arbeta med incidenthantering, problemlösning och förebyggande åtgärder
    Vidareutveckla och förbättra system med fokus på stabilitet, tillgänglighet och IT-säkerhet
    Testa och kvalitetssäkra nya produkter, funktioner och tekniska lösningar
    Samarbeta med andra tekniska team för att säkerställa effektiva och tillförlitliga system
    Bidra till att utveckla och effektivisera tekniska processer, dokumentation och arbetssätt

VI SÖKER DIG SOM:

    Har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, datateknik eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
    Har minst två års arbetslivserfarenhet av applikationsdrift, eller systemdrift i komplexa IT-miljöer
    Har kunskap inom nätverk, databaser och IT-säkerhet
    Har god teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning i system där flera tekniska komponenter samverkar
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift, då båda språken används i det dagliga arbetet

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av IP-baserad kommunikation, IoT eller uppkopplade enheter
    Erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar och tjänster
    Kunskap inom systemövervakning, logghantering och incidenthantering
    Erfarenhet av tekniska system med höga krav på tillgänglighet och säkerhet
    Erfarenhet av avancerad teknisk support eller problemlösning inom tredje linjen

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är analytisk, noggrann och lösningsorienterad. Du har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och tycker om att sätta dig in i komplexa system för att förstå hur olika tekniska komponenter samverkar. Vidare är du ansvarstagande, strukturerad och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och motiveras av att hitta långsiktiga lösningar och bidra till ständiga förbättringar.

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag, vilket innebär att du till en början kommer att vara anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult hos vår kund. Ambitionen från kunden och vår sida är att du efter en tid går över i en anställning hos kunden.

ÖVRIG INFO:

    Omfattning: Heltid
    Start: Enligt överenskommelse
    Placering: Göteborg
    Lön: Marknadsmässig
    Kontaktperson: Evelina Ogheden

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Vi gör löpande urval, så vänta inte med din ansökan – tjänsten kan tillsättas innan annonsperioden har löpt ut. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mejl.

OM FRIDAY:

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som talang en riktigt bra start och fortsatt utveckling i karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

jobs.title: Senior Programmer
jobs.description:
Frontier is an independent video game developer and publisher, crafting immersive gaming experiences with fun gameplay and unparalleled artistic quality. Renowned for its iconic creative management simulation games, Frontier captivates players worldwide with immersive and authentic game worlds. The modern studio is located in the vibrant technology hub of Cambridge (UK). The talented team at Frontier are dedicated to nurturing our existing portfolio and delivering our exciting future roadmap. 
 
This role is offered on a full in-studio basis or a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days per week in the studio). We can provide a comprehensive relocation support package as part of any offer, should you need to relocate. 

WHAT'S THE ROLE?

We are looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to join our Planet Coaster 2 team and play an important role in delivering quality experiences to our players. Joining an established and diverse team, you will bring experience, expertise, curiosity and energy to the development of our games.  You will program primarily in C++ working with our in-house Cobra engine and cross-platform game code.

As part of our development team, you will have a fantastic opportunity to apply, expand and share your expertise in modern game development techniques, and help push the boundaries of the current generation of gaming platforms. You will be collaborating with a talented team of programmers working on game features alongside specialists across multiple disciplines. You will also collaborate with game designers and QA testers on tuning the player experience.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of the team behind our multi‑million‑selling, cross‑platform titles and help us continue delivering exceptional gaming experiences to our players.    


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  • Architecting and developing game features and systems.
  • Collaborating effectively with team members and discipline leads.
  • Designing and implementing technology using structured, efficient, maintainable, and well‑documented code. 
  • Considering the impact of systems on other disciplines and projects, ensuring usability, scalability, and support for long-term maintenance.
  • Guiding more junior programmers and providing feedback on their code, documentation and approach to game development.
  • Creating and maintaining project wide documentation for more complex systems, features and workflows. 
  • Participating in, contributing to, and occasionally leading aspects of project reviews and meetings, as required.

    • WHAT YOU'LL BRING
    • A track record in the development of complex game features in released titles.  
    • Excellent problem solving and programming skills using modern C++.
    • Experience working in a large codebase with the ability to adapt to established methods.
    • Proficient profiling and optimisation skills for CPU performance and memory usage.
    • Experience of cross-discipline collaboration with game designers and content creators.
    • A genuine passion for video games.
    • A desire to be part of a world class team and contribute to its continued success.
    • A proactive approach to collaborative learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.
    • A drive to expand your existing expertise in game development, and a passion for continued learning and self-improvement.

    BONUS IF YOU HAVE
    • Experience working with a proprietary game engine.
    • Familiarity providing technical direction to teams for the development of core systems, game features or workstreams.
    • Experience managing or mentoring other programmers to support their growth.
    • Cross-platform development experience on shipped titles, including consoles (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.).
    • Working knowledge of an entity component system.

    WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

    You will work with talented and passionate people to support, develop or publish our sophisticated and enduring games, in a creative, collaborative and inclusive environment. We love what we do, and we work hard to provide outstanding experiences for our players. 

    Wellbeing is a big focus at Frontier, and we are continually evolving how we can support our people. We encourage a healthy work/life balance and provide a range of wellbeing activities, initiatives and sessions to support both mental and physical health.  

    We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes a success-based annual bonus, share option schemes, life assurance, private family healthcare, flexitime working hours, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, in-house subsidised catering, support with relocation, a Cycle to Work scheme, free bike servicing, and social activities and events. 

    We strive to create an environment where everyone can fully demonstrate their capability and potential. If you therefore need any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please speak to your Talent Acquisition representative.

jobs.title: Senior ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering.

You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure & automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale.

This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention.

  • Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services.

  • Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift.

  • Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production.

  • Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability.

  • Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported "golden paths" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure.

Please apply if you have:

  • Experience building and operating ML platforms in production environments.

  • Solid working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Linux internals, and model serving at scale.

  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring.

  • Experience owning production systems: defining service-level objectives (SLOs), building observability (for example, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog), participating in incident response, and diagnosing large-scale failures systematically. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it.

  • Comfort writing production-quality code in Python or a comparable language.

  • Experience modernizing production infrastructure with attention to reliability, risk, and cost — including thoughtful sequencing of work to maintain availability and continuity for live systems.

  • The ability to take ownership of technical outcomes, advocate for decisions using data, and communicate clearly in writing and in person — to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

  • Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

  • Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

  • Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

  • Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

  • Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

  • Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

  • Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

  • Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

  • Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

  • Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

  • Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

  • A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

  • Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

  • A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments.

  • Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability.

  • Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus.

  • Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

jobs.title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At 5Plus (part of Pentadoc Group), we build production-grade AI systems that solve real operational problems for our customers.

As a AI Engineer (m/f/d), you will take technical responsibility for customer-facing AI solutions — from early design decisions to production deployment and operation. You will design, build, and operate AI applications ranging from LLM-powered workflows (e.g., intelligent document processing, RAG systems) to agentic AI systems that are actively used in customer environments.

German language skills at C1 level and above are mandatory for this role.

You’ll work closely with customers and internal engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into reliable, scalable systems and guide AI-driven product development within customer projects. This role is hybrid, with predominantly remote work and occasional on-site presence at customer locations across Germany and our office in Würzburg, Bavaria.

Your profile

  • Several years (3–6) of hands-on experience building and operating AI/ML systems in real-world projects.
  • Solid experience implementing agents on the LangChain stack (LangGraph, DeepAgents) in Python, including FastAPI interfaces.
  • Experience with AWS (e.g. ECS, CDK, …)
  • Strong Python expertise (app. 5 years) and experience with modern AI/LLM tooling; framework-agnostic mindset.
  • Proven experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., RAG, embeddings, tool usage) and an understanding of trade-offs between quality, cost, latency, and complexity.
  • Ability to work independently in customer-facing environments, taking ownership of technical decisions under uncertainty.
  • Professional communication skills in customer contexts.
  • Residence in Germany.

Bonus points to score

  • Deeper experience with agentic architectures (planning, memory, multi-agent coordination).
  • Contributions to open-source projects, technical writing, or applied research.

Your daily business

  • Design and ship end-to-end AI systems, from prototype to production.
  • Build LLM-powered applications (incl. RAG, tool usage, validations) with a focus on reliability and cost-efficiency.
  • Develop and operate agentic AI systems (e.g., planning, tool orchestration, multi-step workflows) with clearly defined safety and integrations into customers’ systems.
  • Define evaluation strategies (offline + online), including metrics, benchmarks, and monitoring.
  • Optimize system performance across latency, cost, and quality.
  • Take technical leadership within customer project teams, coordinating architecture, implementation, and iteration cycles.
  • Act as a technical point of contact for customers, explaining trade-offs and guiding solution decisions.
  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to turn ambiguous, real-world problems into concrete AI solutions.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and support less-experienced engineers through technical guidance (no people management).

Some of your benefits at 5Plus

  • Real ownership: Build and own AI solutions that go live quickly!
  • Small, experienced team with fast decision-making.
  • Flexible working hours and freedom to choose your workplace.
  • Learning budget and support for conferences and publications.
  • Pentadoc Group offers additional benefits, feel free to check out everything.


To plan an initial conversation quickly, please make sure your application contains all relevant documentation and information, you'd like to share with us.

We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Head of Bid EuroMaint - Led vårt anbudsarbete mot nästa nivå
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning:

Är du en erfaren ledare som trivs i komplexa affärer och motiveras av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet? Vi söker nu en Head of Bid som vill bygga vidare på ett kompetent team och leda EuroMaints anbudsarbete mot nästa nivå. I rollen leder du arbetet från affärsmöjlighet till kontraktstecknande och säkerställer att vi fortsätter vinna lönsamma affärer på en konkurrensutsatt marknad.

Arbetsbeskrivning:Om rollen

Som Head of Bid ansvarar du för att leda och utveckla EuroMaints anbudsarbete genom hela affärscykeln, från identifiering och kvalificering av affärsmöjligheter till anbudsarbete, kontraktsförhandling, kontraktstecknande och överlämning till verksamheten.

Du leder ett erfaret team av Bid Managers med djup kompetens inom anbudsarbete och affärsutveckling. Samtidigt är teamet relativt nytt i sin nuvarande sammansättning, vilket innebär att en viktig del av uppdraget är att stärka samarbetet, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa långsiktiga förutsättningar för hög prestation och trivsel. Som Head of Bid har du ett övergripande ansvar för att säkerställa hög kvalitet, lönsamhet och effektiv riskhantering i våra affärer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med kunder, affärsansvariga, kontraktschefer, ledning och vår ägare CAF.

Förekommande arbetsuppgifter:


    Leda och utveckla anbudsverksamheten och dess tillhörande processer
    Personalansvar för Bid Management-teamet med fokus på kompetensutveckling, resursplanering och prestation
    Säkerställa att anbud planeras, genomförs och levereras enligt tidplan och affärsmål
    Ansvara för den kommersiella strategin för anbuds- och kontraktsportföljen för att säkerställa lönsam tillväxt
    Stödja strategiska kunddialoger, förhandlingar och kontraktsfrågor
    Säkerställa att affärsmöjligheter utvärderas utifrån strategi, risk och lönsamhet samt bidra i bid/no bid-beslut
    Säkerställa att anbud och avtalsförslag uppfyller bolagets krav avseende lönsamhet, risk och affärsmässighet
    Arbeta proaktivt med både nya och befintliga kunder för att identifiera och utveckla affärsmöjligheter
    Rapportera affärsstatus, prognoser och anbudsportfölj till ledning och ägare
    Bidra aktivt till den strategiska utvecklingen som medlem i ledningsgruppen för Försäljning & Marknad

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och affärsdriven ledare med erfarenhet av komplex anbudsverksamhet och kommersiellt arbete. Du är van att navigera i en miljö med många intressenter och kan anpassa din kommunikation utifrån såväl kunder som medarbetare, ledning och externa partners.

Som person är du självgående, strukturerad och tydlig i ditt ledarskap. Du är trygg i dig själv, vågar lyfta utmaningar och har förmågan att skapa förtroende och engagemang i organisationen. Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö där tempot periodvis är högt, samtidigt som du säkerställer ordning, tydlighet och leverans mot uppsatta mål.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:


    Minst 10 års relevant erfarenhet inom anbud, affärsutveckling, kommersiell ledning eller liknande
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa affärer och tvärfunktionella team
    God förståelse för kontraktshantering, förhandling, riskhantering och kommersiella villkor
    Stark finansiell kompetens med erfarenhet av kalkyler, affärscase och lönsamhetsanalyser
    Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
    Erfarenhet från industri, järnväg, infrastruktur, anläggning eller närliggande verksamhet är meriterande.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att påverka affärer av stor strategisk betydelse och arbeta nära kunder, ledning och internationella intressenter i en nyckelroll för EuroMaints fortsatta tillväxt.



Förmåner & erbjudande

Vi erbjuder:


    Friskvårdsbidrag på 4 000 kr per år
    Ersättning för läkarkostnader och receptbelagd medicin upp till högkostnadsskyddet
    Gratis mensskydd på alla våra arbetsplatser

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: System Integration Engineer (System Engineer - Effector Development)
jobs.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Systems Engineer to lead the system-level definition and technical development of our effector programmes. This role sits at the centre of the development effort – bridging operational requirements and technical execution across propulsion, structures, avionics, and seeker.

The ideal candidate brings a defence systems background and understands the full development lifecycle of a guided effector – from ConOps and requirements through subsystem design, integration, and qualification. They are technically credible across multiple domains, rigorous in their systems thinking, and effective at driving alignment across disciplinary teams.

What You’ll Do

· Define and own system-level requirements for effector programmes – capturing operational needs, translating them into technical requirements, and maintaining traceability from ConOps through to subsystem specifications

· Develop and maintain ConOps and operational scenario definitions; work with the customer and programme stakeholders to ensure operational intent is correctly reflected in the system design

· Define and manage technical interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, warhead/pyrotechnics, structures, avionics, guidance, and GSE); own the ICD and IRS documentation

· Lead trade studies and make-or-buy analyses to identify the best technical and commercial solutions at system and subsystem level

· Identify and track critical components and subsystems; define mitigation strategies for technical risk and drive resolution through the engineering team

· Lead or support system design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and prepare the associated technical baseline documentation

· Coordinate system integration activities across propulsion, structures, avionics, and external teams; ensure interfaces are closed and integration milestones are met

· Support verification and validation planning; define the V&V approach at system level and ensure it flows down to subsystem test plans

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

· 5–8 years of systems engineering experience on defence or weapons system programmes – rockets, missiles, or guided weapons are a strong advantage; a background in aerospace or space launcher development is also suitable

· Proven experience defining and managing system requirements and interfaces across multi-disciplinary teams in a defence acquisition or development environment

· Hands-on experience with ConOps development, trade studies, and make-or-buy decision frameworks

· Familiarity with system design review processes (SRR, PDR, CDR) and the associated technical documentation

· Experience with V&V planning and requirements traceability; exposure to relevant standards (e.g. ARP4754, DEF STAN, MIL-STD, or equivalent) is an advantage

· Solid understanding of at least one key effector subsystem domain – propulsion, structures, avionics, or guidance – with the breadth to work credibly across all of them

· Structured, rigorous, and delivery-focused – able to drive technical decisions without getting lost in analysis

· Fluent in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: Structural Dynamics Engineer
jobs.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking an Aeroelastic/Structural Dynamics Engineer to lead structural dynamic and aeroelastic simulation activities across our vehicle programmes, from model setup through test correlation.

The ideal candidate bridges analysis and test – ensuring dynamic behaviour is accurately predicted, verified, and substantiated against experimental data.

What You’ll Do

· Set up, execute, and post-process structural dynamics and aeroelastic simulations

· Create and maintain Global Finite Element Models (GFEM) representing vehicle-level dynamic behaviour, ensuring consistency and traceability with detailed local FE models

· Support structural dynamic qualification and verification of components, subsystems, and full vehicle assemblies

· Define, document, and oversee execution of vibration, modal survey, and ground vibration test (GVT) campaigns

· Correlate simulation predictions against experimental test data; interpret and communicate results clearly

· Prepare technical reports, analysis documentation, and design justification packages

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in structural dynamics, aeroelasticity, or vibration engineering

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct – for modal, transient, frequency response, and/or random vibration analysis

· Demonstrated experience defining and executing vibration and dynamic test plans

· Strong ability to correlate experimental test data against simulation predictions

· Solid grounding in structural dynamics fundamentals: SDOF/MDOF systems, modal analysis, damping, and forced response

jobs.title: Stress Engineer - Non-linear & Propellants
jobs.description:
The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures.

A core part of this role is the structural simulation of propellant grains, liner bonds, thermal protection systems (TPS), and propellant–liner–casing interfaces – combining FEA with material characterization and test correlation to build substantiated models of energetic material assemblies.

What You’ll Do

· Conduct stress analysis using both classical hand-calculation methods and FEA – linear and non-linear, static and dynamic

· Simulate solid rocket motor structures: propellant grain stress and strain fields, bond integrity at propellant–liner and liner–casing interfaces, TPS thermomechanical response, and igniter/nozzle attachment loads

· Conduct non-linear simulations covering geometric non-linearity, material non-linearity (plasticity, hyperelasticity for propellant and elastomeric materials), and contact mechanics

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

What You’ll Need

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

· Proficiency with FEA packages: NASTRAN (Femap or equivalent), Abaqus, or Optistruct/HyperWorks for both linear and non-linear analysis

· Strong classical stress analysis skills: beam theory, buckling, fastener and joint analysis, margin-of-safety calculations

· Experience with non-linear material modelling – plasticity, hyperelasticity, or viscoelasticity; familiarity with propellant or elastomeric material constitutive models is a strong advantage

· Experience with thermomechanical or thermal-structural analysis

· Experience correlating FE predictions with experimental test data

· Background in solid rocket motor, propulsion, or energetic structures is a strong advantage

· Fluent in English; German or French is an advantage

jobs.title: Flight Physics & Performance Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly capable Flight Physics & Performance Engineer to support the development, implementation, and validation of high-fidelity simulation environments for missile system performance analysis. In this role, you will design and maintain 6-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) simulation frameworks, implement flight physics and guidance models, and ensure simulation tools are robust, scalable, and aligned with system requirements. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to enable accurate performance predictions and support broader system design activities.

This position is ideal for an engineer with strong analytical skills, hands-on experience in simulation toolchains, and a passion for advancing the modelling capabilities behind next-generation missile systems.

Responsibilities

· Develop, maintain, and extend 6-DoF simulation environments for missile performance assessment, system trade studies, and design validation.

· Implement and refine flight physics models, including aerodynamics, propulsion behavior, actuator dynamics, sensor models, and environmental effects.

· Build and integrate simulation tools and analysis utilities to support SIL, CIL, and HIL test configurations.

· Define, decompose, and manage system and simulation requirements using DOORS NG or similar systems engineering tools.

· Generate clear, structured, and technically rigorous documentation, covering modelling assumptions, equations of motion, validation results, and verification.

· Produce and execute test cases for requirement verification across multiple simulation levels (SIL, CIL, HIL).

· Work cross-functionally with Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), Systems Engineering, Software, and Flight Dynamics teams to ensure model fidelity and alignment with system needs.

· Participate in design and technical reviews, presenting simulation methodologies, performance outcomes, and model limitations.

· Support algorithm development teams by providing simulation environments, interfaces, and validation scenarios.

· Actively contribute to continuous improvement of internal simulation capabilities, toolchains, and workflows.

· Represent the simulation domain in external collaborations, technical meetings, or strategic advisory groups when required.

Requirements

· Proven experience developing and managing 6-DoF simulations for aerospace or missile systems.

· Strong understanding of flight mechanics, aerodynamics, propulsion models, rigid-body dynamics, and related numerical methods.

· Hands-on experience with simulation tool development, including model integration, scenario generation, and test automation.

· Proven coding experience preferred: Python, C/C++, Rust.

· Experience with SIL, CIL, and HIL simulations and verification processes.

· Strong technical writing skills and experience in producing advanced engineering documentation.

· Proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent modelling environments; experience with MathWorks tools is highly valued.

· Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex technical topics clearly.

· Proactive attitude, good problem-solving skills, and willingness to take ownership of simulation tasks and toolchain development.

MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related fields.

· Fluency in English is a must.

jobs.title: SEO Manager (m/w/d) – Content & Kundenprojekte
jobs.description:
Du bist verantwortlich für folgende Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest unsere eigene organische Sichtbarkeit, von der Keyword-Strategie bis zur fertigen Seite in Webflow oder WordPress. Zusaetzlich bringst du dein SEO-Handwerk, technisch, inhaltlich und beim Linkbuilding, in Kundenprojekte unseres Managed Service ein, wenn dort echte Umsetzung gebraucht wird. Je nach Projekt kann das auch direkten Kontakt zum Kunden bedeuten, im Kern bleibst du aber fuer die Umsetzung zustaendig, nicht fuer die Kundenbeziehung. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschaeftsleitung und dem Einkauf.

In deinem Bereich entscheidest du nach vorheriger Einarbeitung ohne Ruecksprache.

Deine Aufgaben

  1. Content-Flaeche ausbauen – Money-Pages, Branchenseiten, Glossar und Blog auf Basis bestehender Keyword-Maps und Briefings.

  2. Schreiben auf Fachniveau – Texte, die ranken und von ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews als Quelle genommen werden.

  3. Selbst bauen und live stellen – neue Seiten in Webflow oder WordPress, ohne auf Entwicklerkapazitaet zu warten.

  4. Technisches SEO und GEO – Struktur, interne Verlinkung, Schema, Ladezeit, KI-Zitierbarkeit, auf unserer Website wie auf Kundenprojekten.

  5. Kundenprojekte mitoptimieren – technisches SEO, Content und Linkbuilding-Strategie, wenn ein Kundenprojekt echte Umsetzung braucht.

  6. Messen statt vermuten – monatlicher Status gegen Non-Brand-Traffic, rankende Keywords, Positionen der Money-Keywords, live gestellte Seiten.

Du arbeitest taeglich mit Claude Code. Webflow, Ahrefs und Google Search Console sind direkt angebunden, du ziehst Daten, baust Seiten und laesst Analysen laufen, ohne zwischen Tools hin- und herzuspringen.


Das bringst du mit

Uns ist die Person wichtiger als der Lebenslauf.

  1. Erfahrung mit Ergebnissen – drei bis fuenf Jahre SEO inhouse oder in einer Agentur, und du kannst an einem Projekt zeigen, was du bewegt hast.

  2. Breite statt nur eine Disziplin – technisches SEO, Content und Linkbuilding sind fuer dich ein Werkzeugkasten, kein Gegensatz.

  3. Umsetzungsstaerke im Web – Webflow oder WordPress bedienst du sicher, inklusive Gefuehl fuer Layout und Struktur.

  4. Tempo durch Systeme, nicht durch Handarbeit – du willst mit KI eigene Prozesse fuer SEO bauen, statt drei Tage an einem einzelnen Blogartikel zu sitzen. Das musst du heute noch nicht beherrschen, die Richtung muss stimmen, dahin entwickelt sich die Rolle mit dir.

  5. Ownership und Flexibilitaet – du wechselst ohne Reibung zwischen eigener Website und Kundenprojekt, je nachdem wo es gerade brennt.

Zur Einarbeitung bist du bei uns im Buero in Bonn-Ramersdorf, danach 3 zu 2.


Wir bieten dir nicht nur einen Job, der Spaß macht, sondern eine Chance zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung:

  1. Ein Projekt mit echtem Hebel – die eigene Website gehoert dir, was du baust, bleibt und waechst weiter. Dazu Abwechslung durch Kundenprojekte.

  2. 40.000 - 60.000 Euro Euro variabel – bei Zielerreichung, gekoppelt an deine Ergebnisse.

  3. Modernes KI-Setup – Recherche, Datenaufbereitung und Analyse nimmt dir unsere KI-Infrastruktur ab.

  4. Kurze Wege – direkt mit der Geschaeftsleitung, nicht ueber drei Ebenen.

  5. Perspektive – unbefristet, in einem Markt, der gerade erst anfaengt. Wer diesen Bereich bei uns aufbaut, waechst mit ihm.

  6. 30 Tage Urlaub – dazu die 3-zu-2-Homeoffice-Regelung nach der Einarbeitung.

So laeuft deine Bewerbung ab

Schick uns zwei bis drei Seiten oder Artikel, die du selbst geschrieben und live gestellt hast, mit einem Satz dazu, was sie erreicht haben. Das sagt mehr als jedes Anschreiben.

Dann entwickle mit uns KI-Lösungen für den Mittelstand. Als Einsatzentwickler konzentrierst du dich voll auf die Entwicklung von KI-Systemen und deren direkte Umsetzung beim Kunden. Du verstehst Prozesse, integrierst Sprachmodelle und baust intelligente Anwendungen, die im Arbeitsalltag funktionieren.

Über uns

Agentur Philipp ist auf die praktische Umsetzung von Künstlicher Intelligenz spezialisiert. Mit einem Team aus über 20 Menschen begleiten wir Unternehmen im KI-Marathon® durch Beratung, Entwicklung und Optimierung. Wir entwickeln KI-Kollegen, automatisieren Prozesse und verbinden bestehende Systeme. Unser Ziel: keine isolierten Prototypen, sondern Lösungen, die Mitarbeiter spürbar entlasten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden und übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete KI-Architekturen.

  • Du entwickelst KI-Agenten, LLM-Integrationen, Automatisierungen und intelligente Anwendungen.

  • Du integrierst Sprachmodelle und KI-Funktionen über APIs in bestehende ERP-, CRM- und weitere Unternehmenssysteme.

  • Du arbeitest bei gezielten Einsätzen direkt beim Kunden vor Ort und setzt KI-Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen um.

  • Du begleitest deine KI-Modelle und -Anwendungen vom ersten Prototyp bis zum produktiven Einsatz, inklusive Tests, Dokumentation und Optimierung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Beratung und Projektleitung zusammen und machst aus Projekterfahrungen wiederverwendbare KI-Komponenten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der KI-Entwicklung und im Softwarebau, beispielsweise mit Python oder TypeScript.

  • Erfahrung mit APIs, Vektordatenbanken, Prompt Engineering und der Anbindung von Sprachmodellen.

  • Fundierte umgesetzte Projekte mit Sprachmodellen, KI-Agenten oder intelligenter Prozessautomatisierung.

  • Die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in unbekannte Prozesse einzuarbeiten und pragmatische KI-Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du kannst technische KI-Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären und arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kunden.

  • Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein und Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Reisen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentation.

Entscheidend ist, was du bauen und umsetzen kannst. Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg: Zeig uns deine KI-Projekte und wie du Probleme löst.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • KI-Projekte mit echtem Praxisbezug und sichtbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Eine Rolle mit starkem Fokus auf echte KI-Entwicklung und direkte Kundenarbeit.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Raum, intelligente Systeme aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Beratung, Entwicklung und Projektleitung.

  • Unterschiedliche Branchen, Systeme und KI-Herausforderungen statt immer derselben Standardaufgabe.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein Profil und ein bis zwei KI-Projekte, auf die du stolz bist. Beschreibe kurz, welches Problem du mit Künstlicher Intelligenz gelöst hast und welchen Anteil du an der Umsetzung hattest.

Logisticien / logisticienne
===========================

**Pour que nos équipes puissent avancer, nous avons besoin de vous !**

De la préparation du matériel à la gestion des dépôts, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans le bon déroulement de nos chantiers. Vous aimez être utile, prendre des initiatives et voir concrétement le résultat de votre travail ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous !



Entreprise familiale fondée en 1985, nous sommes l’un des plus grands groupes de peinture, plâtrerie et isolation de Suisse romande avec plus de 160 collaborateurs et 5 entreprises.

Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) **Logisticien / Logisticienne** pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique chez Peinture Renens SA.

Véritable **maillon essentiel entre nos dépôts, nos chantiers, nos collaborateurs et nos fournisseurs**, vous assurez la bonne gestion de nos stocks et de notre matériel.

Au quotidien, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

* Gérer et approvisionner les dépôts de peinture et de plâtrerie
* Préparer le matériel et les commandes nécessaires aux collaborateurs
* Effectuer les livraisons et les débarras sur les différents chantiers
* Réceptionner les marchandises et organiser leur rangement
* Gérer les retours de matériel et de marchandises
* Veiller à l’ordre, à l’entretien et à l’optimisation des espaces de stockage
* Assurer la gestion et le suivi des machines et de leur état
* Contrôler, nettoyer et faire réparer le matériel si nécessaire
* Assurer le suivi de la flotte de véhicules et gérer les services et problèmes courants
* Organiser l’élimination des déchets
* Participer aux inventaires et assurer un suivi régulier des stocks
* Contribuer à améliorer nos méthodes et nos procédures afin de faciliter le travail de tous


**Ce que nous recherchons**

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne **fiable, organisée et débrouillarde**, qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions.

Vous êtes :

* autonome et capable de gérer vos priorités
* organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et à l’aise avec la planification
* flexible et résistant(e) au stress
* doté(e) d’un bon sens pratique et d’un esprit d’initiative
* à l’aise dans les contacts avec les collaborateurs, fournisseurs et partenaires
* discret(ète), respectueux(se) et doté(e) d’un bon esprit d’équipe
* à l’aise avec les responsabilités et le travail en toute autonomie.


**Votre profil**

* CFC, formation ou brevet fédéral dans le domaine de la logistique ou formation jugée équivalente
* Permis de conduire indispensable
* Expérience confirmée dans le domaine de la plâtrerie\-peinture, un réel atout
* Bonne maîtrise des techniques liées au métier
* çais parfaitement maîtrisé, à l’oral comme à l’écrit
* Les autres langues sont les bienvenues
* Une bonne présentation et de bonnes manières complètent votre profil


**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Parce que ce poste n'est pas uniquement un poste de magasinier !

Vous serez **un véritable acteur du bon fonctionnement de notre entreprise**, avec un rôle transversal et varié. Votre organisation, votre réactivité et votre sens pratique auront un impact direct sur le travail de nos équipes.

Vous aimez que les choses soient bien faites, que le matériel soit au bon endroit et que les équipes puissent compter sur vous ?

Alors nous avons certainement envie de faire votre connaissance !

**Intéressé(e) ?**

Fachspezialist:in Gesundheitsmanagement
=======================================







  
Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung  




Fachspezialist:in Gesundheitsmanagement 50%
===========================================



Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden ist Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung (JuWe) für den Straf\- und Massnahmenvollzug sowie für die Durchführung verschiedener Haftarten verantwortlich. Unsere Mitarbeitenden aus rund 40 Berufen unterstützen und fördern die Wiedereingliederung straffällig gewordener Menschen und setzen sich wirksam und fortschrittlich für eine sichere und gerechte Gesellschaft ein.  

Der Fachbereich Human Resources gehört zur Amtsleitung. Die rund 25 Mitarbeitenden gestalten und verantworten sämtliche Aufgaben des Personalmanagements – von der Gewinnung, Beratung, und Entwicklung der JuWe Mitarbeitenden über personalrechtliche und administrative Dienstleistungen bis hin zu HR\-Controlling und strategischer Personalsteuerung.  

Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die das Thema Gesundheit ganzheitlich denkt, strategisch weiterentwickelt und nachhaltig in unserer Organisation verankert. Wenn Du Lust hast, nicht nur bestehende Prozesse zu betreuen, sondern den Bereich Gesundheit aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit HR und Führung weiterzuentwickeln, dann freuen wir uns, Dich kennenzulernen.





### Was auf Dich wartet



* Gemeinsam mit der Leitung HR\-Beratung konzipierst und entwickelst Du unsere Gesundheitsthemen sowie die dazugehörigen Prozesse weiter. Dabei behältst Du sowohl die Bedürfnisse der Organisation als auch die gesetzlichen und kantonalen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick  
* Du kannst bei uns Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Verankerung des Bereichs Gesundheit übernehmen: vom Anwesenheitsmanagement über das Gesundheitscontrolling und die Prävention bis hin zur Umsetzung konkreter Massnahmen  
* Du erkennst relevante Gesundheitskennzahlen, kannst diese systematisch analysieren und auswerten, daraus Handlungsfelder identifizieren und fundierte strategische Massnahmen ableiten. Die daraus entstehenden Projekte begleitest und leitest Du von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung  
* Du unterstützt dabei, Gesundheitsthemen wirkungsvoll in bestehende HR\- und Führungsprozesse zu integrieren, verantwortest den Gesundheitsprozess und berätst deine Kolleg:innen innerhalb der HR\-Beratung sowie weitere relevante Schnittstellen in fachlichen Fragestellungen  
* Du entwickelst zudem Sensibilisierungs\-, Informations\- und Schulungsangebote für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte  





### Was Du mitbringst



* Du verfügst über einen Bachelorabschluss. Eine zusätzliche Weiterbildung, beispielsweise einen CAS in Betrieblicher Gesundheitsförderung, Betrieblichem Gesundheitsmanagement (BGM), Sozialversicherungen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich, ist von Vorteil.  
* Du verfügst über fundiertes Fachwissen und praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Gesundheit und/oder Absenzenmanagement und verstehst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge strukturiert zu analysieren und daraus umsetzbare Lösungen abzuleiten  
* Erfahrung in einem Umfeld mit Schichtbetrieb und unterschiedlichen Mitarbeitendengruppen ist für uns ein grosses Plus  
* Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, bildest dir eine fundierte Meinung und kannst diese situationsgerecht und überzeugend vertreten. Gleichzeitig baust du tragfähige Beziehungen auf und verstehst dich als interne:r Dienstleister:in und Sparringspartner:in für HR und Führung  
* Veränderungen begegnest du mit Offenheit und Interesse. Auch bei anspruchsvollen oder längerfristigen Themen bleibst du dran und behältst Qualität und Zielsetzung im Blick. Strategisches und vernetztes Denken gehören für dich ebenso dazu wie eine klare, adressatengerechte Kommunikation

Flexsis ist ein Unternehmen der Interiman Group, einer der führenden Anbieter von Personaldienstleistungen in der Schweiz. Dank unseres soliden Fachwissens sowie den Kompetenzen innerhalb der Interiman Group bietet wir massgeschneiderte Lösungen in der Personalberatung an.

Startdatum: 01\.11\.2026

* Berechnungen \& Simulation: Auslegung von Antriebs\- und Bewegungskomponenten (Aktoren, Motoren, Pneumatik) sowie Durchführung von FEA\- und Kinematik\-Simulationen zur Optimierung von Taktzeiten, Lastgrenzen und dynamischem Systemverhalten.

Vous êtes **physiothérapeute** et vous recherchez un **poste fixe à 80\-100%** sur le **Canton de Neuchâtel** ?

PHYSIOTHERAPEUTE en Fixe à 80\-100%
