jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager - Cell 4
jobs.description:
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Program Manager (ARP) to join Cell 4.
Reporting to the Program Manager, the Deputy Program Manager plays a key role in steering MSF’s operations within Cell 4, contributing to operational decision-making and ensuring the relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance. The role supports operational planning, resource mobilisation, programme monitoring, security and advocacy, while supervising and supporting Heads of Mission. As a central operational role within MSF, the Deputy Program Manager acts as a key interface between missions and headquarters, ensuring effective information flow, coherent HQ support and a shared understanding of operational priorities across OCG. The role also contributes to the internal visibility of programmes and to critical reflection on operational challenges and MSF’s social mission.

Tasks & Responsibilities
By delegation of responsibilities and tasks from the Program Manager:
In accordance with the Charter, the Chantilly / La Mancha agreements and OCG operational policy, the Deputy Program Manager ensures the overall relevance, timeliness and quality of MSF’s assistance to populations in danger within a selected group of countries.
Is responsible for steering the operations planning cycle, ensuring that transversal internal processes are respected, that MSF policies are translated into action unless otherwise justified, and that resources are adequately mobilized to support operational objectives and the chosen intervention strategies.
Ensures that key medical and/or humanitarian stakes are identified within each mission and project, prioritizes them, and carries them internally and externally through bilateral meetings, documentation, témoignage and communication; determines how MSF will address the issues at stake and defines its public position.
Creates and maintains a network of relevant political, humanitarian, medical and academic contacts to ensure the best possible knowledge of the environment for teams working in the field, especially in tense contexts.
Monitors the level of exposure to risk affecting teams in the field and validates the security framework proposed by the Heads of Mission for each project.
Supervises, advises, supports and evaluates the Heads of Mission in the fulfilment of their overall responsibilities and duties; in this perspective, provides them with all relevant information and visits missions at key moments (exploratory missions, programme definition phases and/or reorientations due to evolving needs, context or policy).
Organizes the best possible level of headquarters support to field operations by optimizing the input, expertise and control functions of professionals from different departments, each representing a technical field necessary for the effective running of projects in the field.
Monitors programme implementation and the effective running of missions by analysing situation and programme reports submitted by the coordination and providing feedback; is accountable for timely reporting on operations, including institutional donors supporting MSF’s action in the field.
Aims to continuously improve MSF’s medical assistance by evaluating results achieved, leading thematic working groups on intervention strategies, initiating critical reviews as needed, supporting operational research projects, and contributing to the design and delivery of training modules for coordinators.

Your profile
Education
University-level degree in international relations, social sciences, medicine, public health, a paramedical field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience
Experience in humanitarian aid, ideally as an MSF Head of Mission or Emergency Coordinator. Previous experience as a Medical Coordinator is an asset.
Expertise in analysing and managing unstable contexts and crisis situations.
Experience in, and interest in, the medical, social, economic and political dimensions of countries affected by humanitarian crises, whether acute or protracted, or undergoing development, is an asset.

Languages
Fluency in English and French is mandatory.
Knowledge of a third language is an asset.

Skills/ professional competencies
Strong representation and diplomatic skills, with proven negotiation abilities.
Strong strategic planning and orientation skills.
Ability to analyse humanitarian contexts, with a sound understanding of medical issues and MSF intervention strategies.
Ability to design and plan medical programmes, build and maintain networks, motivate and lead teams, organise responsibilities and delegate tasks effectively.
Excellent writing skills.

Personal Abilities/Qualities
Dynamic and flexible, with strong initiative and decision-making skills.
Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with a clear sense of priorities.
Highly developed stress-management skills.
Strong communication and public-speaking skills.
Participative management style.

Terms of employment :
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
3 years contract, renewable once.
Working place: Based in Geneva, with very frequent international travel.
Ideal start date: 1st of December 2026
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.

The application deadline is  31 of october 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

● Umfassendes Sicherheitsmanagement: Du entwickelst und gestaltest unsere Bereiche
Arbeitssicherheit, Umweltschutz, Energie-/Entsorgungsmanagement,
Anlagen-/Gebäudesicherheit und Prozesssicherheit nachhaltig weiter.
● Schnittstelle zu Behörden: Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit Behörden und berätstx das
Werk auf allen Ebenen zu neuen und geänderten Anforderungen.
● Sicherer Anlagenbetrieb: Du erarbeitest Lösungsvorschläge und Massnahmen, um den
sicheren Betrieb unserer chemischen Anlagen, Abläufe und Prozesse zu gewährleisten.
● Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsbewusstseins: Du konzipierst und führst
sicherheitsrelevante Trainingsmassnahmen für alle Bereiche und Ebenen durch.

Chemie-Ingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik oder Sicherheitsingenieurwesen sowie ein
ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsverständnis.
● Berufserfahrung: Erfahrung als Sicherheitsfachkraft mit Bezug zur Arbeits- und
Prozesssicherheit (HAZOP, PHA, PSM) in einem chemischen Produktionsumfeld.
● Kenntnisse im Recht: Fundierte Kenntnisse bezüglich schweizerischer und europäischer
arbeitsschutzrechtlicher Vorgaben und Verordnungen sowie im Chemie- und Umweltrecht
und der europäischen Chemikalienverordnung (REACH).Fähigkeiten, die Du für deinen Erfolg benötigst
● Projektmanagement & Sprachkenntnisse: Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise
basierend auf Lean / Six Sigma Methoden (Green Belt oder Black Belt), sowie fliessende
Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
● Persönlichkeit: Du bist kreativ, innovationsfreudig, denkst unternehmerisch und hast Lust,
nachhaltige Projekte aufzubauen.

Was Wir Bieten Hier ist ein Einblick in die grossartigen Vorteile, die dich erwarten können:
- Freizeit: Geniesse 25 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

eine Unfallversicherung, die sowohl berufliche als auch private Unfälle abdeckt.

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Profitiere von hybriden Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten für
Teilzeitstellen (nicht anwendbar auf Schichtmodelle).

Schulungen und einem personalisierten Individuellen Entwicklungsplan.

gemeinnütziger Organisationen.
Um Ihre Bewerbung schnellstmöglich zu bearbeiten, bitten wir Sie, Ihren Lebenslauf entweder im
PDF- oder Word-Format hochzuladen. Wir bitten Sie ausserdem, Ihren Lebenslauf in der gleichen
Sprache wie diese Stellenausschreibung einzureichen.

Warum Avery Dennison
Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen für Materialwissenschaften und digitale Identifikationslösungen
mit Standorten in über 50 Ländern und rund 35.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Als Wissenschafts- und
Innovationsunternehmen glauben wir, dass vielfältige Teams stärkere Teams sind. Wir setzen uns
dafür ein, eine Kultur der Neugier und des Mutes zu fördern, in der Sie Ihre Karriere in einem
Unternehmen ausbauen können, das Innovation in seiner DNA hat. Gegründet, um eine echte
Wirkung für eine bessere Zukunft zu erzielen, streben wir danach, eine offene, kollaborative Kultur
zu bieten, in der Gedankenvielfalt ermutigt und respektiert wird. Erfahren Sie von unseren

www.averydennison.com.
Bei Avery Dennison arbeiten wir mit den grössten Marken in den Branchen FMCG (Konsumgüter),
Bekleidung, Automobil und Pharma zusammen. Unser Chemie-Werk in Kreuzlingen ist seit über 40
Jahren in Betrieb und beschäftigt mehr als 100 Mitarbeitende. Die nachhaltige Verbesserung und
Optimierung unserer Produkte ist ein zentrales Unternehmensziel von Avery Dennison und unseres

jobs.title: Manager - Technology Risk Advisory – SAP Security and Authorizations (25318)
jobs.description:
Location: Zurich, or Geneva
Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100%
Start Date: Immediate

Join Deloitte Switzerland’s SAP Security and Authorization Team

Secure the digital core of enterprises through SAP security and authorization management

About the Role

Are you passionate about translating complex SAP security challenges into elegant, resilient solutions that safeguard critical business systems? At Deloitte Switzerland, within our SAP Security team in Technology & Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in helping organisations strengthen their SAP security posture and authorization controls. Your expertise will empower clients to manage complex security challenges in an increasingly digital and regulated environment, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and resilience.

Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique

Day-to-day, you will lead SAP security and authorization transformation initiatives, design robust security frameworks, and provide expert guidance on managing access controls and security risks within SAP environments, notably SAP S/4HANA implementations.

How you can make an impact

Manage the delivery of projects, actively engaging with clients and overlooking quality and performance of teams.
Drive growth by expanding our SAP Security offering and on-boarding high-value clients.
Lead strategic initiatives to help clients assess SAP security risks, define resilient security controls and frameworks, and establish good-practice security processes with long-term compliance roadmaps.
Design comprehensive SAP security baselines and authorization concepts, including roles and Segregation of Duties rulesets for various SAP systems, such as SAP ECC and S/4HANA.
Conduct comprehensive SAP security assessments and implement SAP cyber security controls aligned with industry frameworks (e.g. NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).
Implement solutions (e.g. SAP GRC, SAP Ariba, etc.) that optimize processes and deliver innovative solutions to complex SAP security challenges at our clients.
Work with best-in-class AI solutions to deliver value to clients.
Contribute to the further improvements of innovative AI and automation tools and assets that drive the future of SAP security and authorization transformation.
Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to support go-to-market strategies and develop cutting-edge SAP security offerings.

What you bring to succeed  

You are proactive, adaptable, keen to grow and have strong interpersonal and communication skills, focused on building outstanding relationships with clients.
You are able to manage end-to-end sales processes / “RFP” related dynamics for medium/high complexity clients. Experience in a leading Consulting firm will be considered a plus.
Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in SAP Security and Authorizations, including authorization frameworks, role concept and design (attribute-based (ABAC) and role-based access controls (RBAC)), Segregation of Duties, and GRC technologies. Hands-on experience with SAP security solutions beyond SAP GRC is a plus.
Proven expertise in implementing SAP S/4HANA, including business process mapping, technical configuration of authorizations, and Fiori.
You have proven experience in Cyber Security Frameworks and Application Security, with hands-on expertise in managing SAP System Security (e.g. patch and vulnerability management, system parameters, connectivity, technical users, secure code etc). Experience with SAP Security Software and Tools is a plus.
Fluent in English, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders. Additional languages, such as German or French, is a plus.

What sets you apart

Relevant certifications : CISM, SAP Certifications, CISSP, CISA
Experience with SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) security, including identity and access management (IAM), API security, secure integration patterns, and cloud-native security controls. Knowledge of SAP BTP security best practices and threat modelling is a plus.
You understand the operating models to be put into place for efficient day-to-day SAP security processes. Experience with near- and off-shore models is a plus.
Demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence (AI), such as leveraging AI tools or solutions within risk, security, or SAP-related contexts (e.g., AI-driven access control analysis, intelligent risk assessment, automation of security controls).
Coaching, team management and problem resolution skills are part of your strengths.

Your Team

Our SAP Security and Authorization team, part of the Controllership & Treasury team within Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of application security, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their digital transformation journeys.

Meet our people

Want to learn more about what it's really like to work at Deloitte? Hear directly from our Technology & Transformation team: Take off into a career without limits: In Technology & Transformation | Deloitte Switzerland.

Benefits for you

We believe in more than just work – we're committed to creating meaningful, inclusive experiences where you can thrive, both personally and professionally. From flexible working arrangements and continuous learning to comprehensive well-being support and opportunities to make a social impact, we invest in helping you grow. Explore our full benefits package here.

Careers at Deloitte

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background, and perspective help us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the future of those our work affects. 
With more than 460’000 employees globally, Deloitte is the largest professional services firm in the world, with offices in more than 150 countries.

In Switzerland, we provide a wide range of integrated services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions, and Technology & Transformation. With around 2,500 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in every industry sector. Experience endless opportunities for professional growth, where you can bring in your entrepreneurial spirit while advising top-tier organizations on cutting-edge interdisciplinary projects within a global environment.  
Join a collaborative culture where you can work flexibly alongside talented, inspiring colleagues from over 70 nationalities. 

We are looking for people who approach challenges with curiosity and flexibility; bring a collaborative mindset and a can-do attitude; and wish to grow their career in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.  

Together makes progress. 

Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers

How to apply

Ready to make an impact? Apply now! We're looking forward to hearing from you. Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates.

You will generously share the spirit of Hermès with every employee and every visitor to the store.

MAIN ACTIVITIES

You work closely with the Communications Department to organize customer events for your store

o You promote Hermès by getting involved in your local community.

PURCHASING

o You work closely with the Product Offer Department to define your purchasing strategy.

o Based on sales analysis and your knowledge of the clientele, you will make purchases for your store four times a year.

o You ensure that the store is in excellent condition at all times and suggest maintenance and refurbishment work to the branch management to improve the customer experience and facilitate operations.

\- Analytical skills

\- At least 10 years of experience in managing a commercial entity and leading a team with diverse and multicultural profiles

\- The ability to develop a highly demanding local and international clientele

\- Very good oral and written communication skills in and English, French is a great asset.

Er du klar for å bli en del av teamet? Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, så send inn så snart som mulig!

Hva vi ser etter

  • Erfaring som barber eller frisør er en fordel, men nyutdannede og lærlinger oppfordres også til å søke

  • Gode ferdigheter innen herreklipp, fades, skjeggtrim og klassisk barbering

  • Frisører med erfaring innen dame- eller unisexklipp er også velkomne

  • Du skaper en god kundeopplevelse og gir kundene råd de kan stole på

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner, positiv holdning og ordenssans

  • Interesse for trender innen hår, grooming og styling

  • Du tar ansvar for egen arbeidsplass og følger faste rutiner

  • Du må ha gyldig rett til å arbeide i Norge ved oppstart. Vi kan dessverre ikke bistå med søknad om arbeidstillatelse

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Hårklipp, fades, skjeggtrim og barbering

  • God konsultasjon før hver behandling, slik at kunden får akkurat det de ønsker

  • Gi kundene en førsteklasses opplevelse fra de kommer inn til de går

  • Veilede kunder og selge stylingprodukter

  • Bidra til et positivt, ryddig og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø

Vi tilbyr

  • En etablert kjede med mange faste kunder og full timebok via egen bookingapp

  • Konkurransedyktig provisjonsbasert lønn, i tillegg til provisjon på produktsalg

  • Tydelige karrieretrinn: Lærling, Junior Barber, Barber og Senior Barber

  • Opplæring og faglig utvikling

  • Mulighet til å jobbe i én fast salong eller på flere av våre avdelinger

  • Spennende vekstmuligheter når vi åpner nye avdelinger i Oslo-området

  • Sosialt og profesjonelt miljø med dyktige kolleger

Om arbeidsgiveren:

J&K Barber Shop er en voksende barberkjede med salonger i Ski, Kolbotn, Sandvika, Strømmen og Jessheim, og vi åpner flere nye avdelinger i Oslo-området. Vi står for kvalitet, service og et moderne herreuttrykk, og har et lojalt kundegrunnlag som kommer tilbake gang på gang.

We also welcome applications in English. We are looking for skilled barbers and hairdressers who share our passion for the craft and want to grow with us as we open new locations in the Oslo area.

Please note: Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Norway at the start of employment, for example as citizens of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland, or by holding a valid Norwegian residence permit that allows work. We are unable to sponsor or assist with work permit or visa applications, and applications that require this will not be considered.

jobs.title: Lead Talent Acquisition EMEA
jobs.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

What You’ll Do

Shape the talent strategy for EMEA

  • Build our EMEA recruiting strategy from the ground up: the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythm that let us scale hiring with quality.

  • Raise talent quality and density: define what great looks like for each role, coach hiring managers on how to spot and hire the right people, and track quality of hire.

  • Partner with People leadership on a data-driven talent strategy, using funnel metrics and market insights to forecast needs and influence hiring decisions.

  • Create our EMEA employer brand strategy, from job sites and career page to school partnerships and events, with a great candidate experience at every step.

Stay hands-on: recruit every day

  • Own full-cycle recruiting from kickoff through offer acceptance, with a focus on tech roles and support on select business hires.

  • Run creative, outbound-first sourcing and build talent pipelines before needs become urgent.

  • Advise hiring managers on candidate profiles, interview design, and calibration.

Build a TA function powered by AI

  • Embed AI across sourcing, market research, candidate engagement, and recruiting operations, and keep testing new ways of working.

  • Set up the tools and ATS (Ashby) that let the team scale.

About You

AI-powered and innovative

  • You design recruiting processes where AI does the heavy lifting, and you know when to automate and when to keep the human touch.

  • You’re resourceful and curious, and you bring ideas to the team rather than waiting to be asked.

6+ years of tech recruiting experience

  • You have a proven track record hiring tech profiles (engineering, data, product) through full-cycle recruiting.

  • You’re comfortable as a generalist, hiring across functions and seniority levels as needs evolve.

  • You’re skilled at outbound sourcing and experienced with modern ATS platforms.

Scale-up and agile mindset

  • You’ve worked in a high-growth, fast-changing environment and love building from zero.

  • You think like an owner, balancing speed with quality.

  • You influence leaders with sound judgment and a genuine care for candidate experience.

Nice to have

  • International recruiting experience across multiple markets.

  • Experience managing or mentoring recruiters.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity - you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model - we care about output, not face time

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Learning & development budget - we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Engineering Internships 2027
jobs.description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment: Internship-to-hire

What we Offer

  • Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

  • Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

  • Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

  • Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

  • Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains:

  • Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

  • Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

  • Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field.

  • Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

  • Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

  • Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

  • Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required)

  • Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

  • Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at:

  • Télécom Paris

  • Forum Trium

  • ENSIMAG

  • CentraleSupélec

  • École Polytechnique

  • EPFL

  • Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Field Sales Team Lead, Lyon (French and English Speaking)
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you
might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Team Lead, Field Sales to join our growing EMEA team in Lyon. This is an opportunity to build on the foundations of our Lyon sales team. Working closely with the Senior Manager, Outbound, you’ll coach and support the team, continue shaping our ways of working and play an important role in growing our presence in the market. You’ll join a team with ambitious growth plans and have high visibility across the organisation, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact as the team expands.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Outbound, to mentor, motivate and develop the team.

  • Provide regular coaching, training and feedback to help team members grow their sales careers.

  • Help the team consistently achieve monthly, quarterly and annual targets.

  • Analyse pipeline and performance metrics, identify opportunities and turn insights into action.

  • Support outbound initiatives that improve team performance and market reach.

  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Inbound, Implementation and Marketing to strengthen our customer journey and ways of working.

  • Help grow the Lyon team’s culture, operating rhythm and local market presence.

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new team members as the team grows.

What you bring to the team:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • Experience coaching or leading a sales team.

  • B2B sales experience, ideally in technology, solution sales or fintech.

  • A strong understanding of sales best practices and a proven ability to close.

  • A track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • A data-driven approach to decision-making and a genuine interest in performance metrics.

  • A passion for coaching and helping others develop.

  • The ability to thrive in a competitive, dynamic and target-driven environment.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias toward action and the flexibility to adapt as priorities evolve.

  • The ownership and energy to help build something new in a launch-phase environment

Even better if you have (but not necessary):

  • Experience working in the hospitality industry

  • Experience with POS systems


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

  • Unlock your potential with our growth program, paving the way for promotions and career advancement;

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office

  • Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plan

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Electrodialysis and CO2 reduction
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

In mitigating CO2emissions, capturing and reusing CO2is a key path. In turn, CO2 electroreduction enables the production of new chemical compounds. Imagine a renewable energy-driven electroconversion process that not only captures and converts CO2 into chemical industry precursors, but also upgrades the products to industry-grade concentrations. Further, imagine doing this in collaboration with industry partners who are also pioneering this field, and helping show how it can be done.

If this imagination reflects your visions and career dreams, this exciting opportunity is excellent for you!

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate and, at the same time, gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

The position is funded through ICAF, a Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action coordinated by NORCE Research AS. The successful candidate will join a team working on the direct electrochemical conversion of captured CO2into formate and formic acid, with laboratory work feeding into an industrial pilot campaign at Heroya Industry Park in Norway.


About the project

In this project,14 knowledge development and industry partners across Europe come together to drive a carbon-neutral, environmentally friendly society into the future. The PhD project focuses on production of industrial grade formate derivatives from CO2capture solution via electrochemical methods. The PhD project is, in this way, experimental, theoretical ,and numerically oriented. By deploying electrochemical techniques under non-reversible thermodynamic considerations and alongside numerical and machine learning analysis methods, this work will advance a high-level scientific path toward a sustainable future.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education required to obtain a doctorate
  • Carry out high-quality research within the framework described above
  • Participate in or lead writing of academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group of sustainable energy systems
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Supervision of related master or bachelor thesis projects
  • Other career-promoting work is sometimes added during the PhD study and compensated by an extension of the contract period according to effort (depends on interest and talent of the candidate and is not guaranteed).

Be prepared for opportunities for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a Master of Science degree, or equivalent, in chemical engineering, electrochemistry, chemistry, materials science, process technology or a closely related discipline with specialization in experimental efforts on electrochemical devices (e.g., batteries, fuel cells, electrolysis, electrodialysis, and similar). 
    Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master’s students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong, relevant academic background from your previous studies and an average grade from your master's degree studies, or equivalent education, equal to a B or better on NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • You must have relevant courses covering electrochemistry at a master's level.
  • Documented experimental competence in electrochemistry and general chemistry. 
  • The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Masters thesis/project in experimental electrochemistry specially electrolysis will be given preference.
  • Journal publications (published or draft with group leader statement attached).
  • Experience in research deploying transport phenomena or thermodynamics for modelling.
  • Experience in deploying machine learning in research.
  • Experience with non-equilibrium thermodynamics and Onsager coupling coefficients.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian equivalent level.
  • Confidence in public speaking. 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analysedata, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse, and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.  

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability ,and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in (at the Faculty of Engineering Science) within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control(legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services).Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application
  • Transcripts and diplomas for bachelor’s and master’s degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of master’s thesis. If you have recently submitted your master’s thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master’s degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications, etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contributiontojoint work, you must attacha briefdescription of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications and visions for the future society, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Odne Burheim, email: burheim@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 21.10.2025

The city of Trondheim is located on the Trondheim Fjord in mid-Norway. It is a modern, Scandinavian city with a unique cultural scene. Trondheim has a growing and increasingly diverse population, currently of around 200 000, and is known as the tech capital of Norway. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools and kindergartens, is among the best of its kind in the world. Professional, subsidized wrap-around care for school children in grades 1-4 is easily available. Trondheim has two International Schools, and the public school system offers Norwegian language support to international children whose families have relocated to Trondheim. Trondheim has low crime rates, clean air and water, and offers great opportunities for enjoying nature and culture.

You will ensure that technical solutions align with enterprise architecture strategies, business requirements, and existing IT environments.

The role combines solution architecture, cloud transformation, and hands-on software development, working closely with cross-functional teams across software engineering, technology, production, and aftermarket operations.



Architecture Lead – Strategy & Solution Design

    Technical Strategy: Evaluate existing systems, identify architectural improvements, and support long-term technology roadmaps.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with solution architects, development teams, business analysts, project managers, and stakeholders.

Technical & Software Development

Solution Implementation & Collaboration

    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve software architecture, development efficiency, and system performance.
    Stakeholder Management: Collaborate across technology, production, aftermarket, and IT delivery organizations.



Required Qualifications & Experience

    Extensive experience as a Software Architect, IT Solution Architect, or Senior Software Developer.

    Experience with microservices architecture, cloud solutions, and modern software development environments.
    Hands-on programming and software development experience.

    Experience in process definition, documentation, and implementation.

    Ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple technical teams.

Meritorious Qualifications:

Personal Qualities:

We are looking for an open-minded, proactive, and collaborative team player with strong technical expertise and a genuine interest in technology. You are a fast learner who enjoys solving complex challenges, sharing knowledge, and contributing to a positive and engaging work environment.

Vastaat komponenttien operatiivisesta ostamisesta ja tilausten seurannasta. Tärkein työkalusi on JDE-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä, jonka ostotarpeiden perusteella teet tilaukset ja seuraat niiden etenemistä toimitukseen asti.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat:

* komponenttien ostotilausten tekeminen

* tilausvahvistusten ja toimitusaikojen seuranta

* yhteydenpito kansainvälisiin toimittajiin ja toimituksiin liittyvien tilanteiden selvittäminen

* toimitusaikatietojen ylläpito ja dokumentointi ERP-järjestelmässä

* tiivis yhteistyö tuotannonsuunnittelun kanssa.

Tehtävän painopiste on päivittäisessä ostotyössä ja toimitusvalvonnassa.

Millaisella taustalla onnistut?

Edellytämme käytännön kokemusta toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän käytöstä sekä sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Englanti on konsernin yhteinen kieli, ja käytät sitä säännöllisesti toimittajayhteistyössä. Sinun ei tarvitse tuntea JDE-järjestelmää ennestään, kokemus muusta ERP-järjestelmästä antaa hyvän pohjan tehtävään.

Sinulla on soveltuva tekninen tai kaupallinen koulutus. Aiempi kokemus teollisuuden ostoista on merkittävä etu, mutta voit tulla tehtävään myös esimerkiksi myynnin tai tilaustenkäsittelyn parista, jos olet käyttänyt ERP-järjestelmää työssäsi.

Muutaman vuoden työkokemus tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta huomioimme myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevat hakijat, joilla on noin vuoden kokemus ERP-järjestelmän käytöstä ja valmiudet ottaa ostotyön kokonaisuus haltuun. Hyvä Excel-osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Työssä tarvitset järjestelmällisyyttä, tarkkuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta. Pidät tilausten tiedot ajan tasalla, seuraat toimituksia aktiivisesti ja viestit selkeästi sekä toimittajien että tuotannonsuunnittelun kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää hankintaosaamistasi kasvavassa hydrauliikka-alan yrityksessä ja kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä. Työskentelet osana noin 15 toimihenkilön työyhteisöä.

Perehdytykselle on varattu aikaa: työskentelet sijaisuuden alussa rinnakkain nykyisen ostoinsinöörin kanssa. Myös sijaisuuden päättyessä tehtävien luovutus toteutetaan yhdessä.

* Työsuhde: kokoaikainen, noin 12 kuukauden määräaikainen vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus Worknown kautta

* Aloitus: joulukuussa 2026

* Työaika: 37,5 tuntia viikossa

* Palkka: 3 000–3 700 €/kk kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan

* Sijainti: Ahertajankatu 6, Tampereen Hervanta – työpaikalle pääsee myös julkisilla.

Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti toimistolla. Yrityksen kasvun jatkuessa sijaisuuden jälkeen voi avautua mahdollisuus vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Bucher Hydraulics Oy:ssä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi. Kerro erityisesti, mitä toiminnanohjausjärjestelmiä olet käyttänyt, millaisissa tehtävissä olet hyödyntänyt niitä ja millaista kokemusta sinulla on ostoista, tilaustenkäsittelystä tai toimittajayhteistyöstä.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Hakemuksen täyttäminen on nopea ja helppo tie kohti uutta työtä tai jopa unelmasi täyttymistä.

Lisätietoja saat Worknown Jennalta puhelimitse 040 160 3159 tai meilitse jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi [jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi].



Worknow Oy työnantajana

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

* Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan

* Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen

* Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaan


Meille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja onnistut.

jobs.title: En städare och säljare
jobs.description:
Raymonds AB söker två medarbetare – Städare & Secondhandmedarbetare

Raymonds AB söker två pålitliga, ansvarsfulla och serviceinriktade personer till vår verksamhet i Osby.

1. Städare

Vi söker en person med erfarenhet av städning som kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för våra olika städuppdrag.

Arbetsuppgifter:

    Hemstädning
    Flyttstädning
    Kontorsstädning och andra städuppdrag
    Arbeta självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor
    Se till att arbetet utförs noggrant och professionellt

Arbetstid: Cirka kl. 10.00–16.00, beroende på våra bokningar och uppdrag.

Vi söker dig som är noggrann, pålitlig, punktlig och ansvarsfull. Tidigare erfarenhet av städning är viktigt.

2. Medarbetare till secondhandbutik

Vi söker även en pålitlig och serviceinriktad person som kan arbeta i vår secondhandbutik och som vi kan känna oss trygga med att lämna ansvar till.

Arbetsuppgifter:

    Hjälpa och ge god service till kunder
    Sälja secondhandvaror
    Ta emot, sortera, organisera och prismärka varor
    Hålla butiken ren, snygg och välorganiserad
    Hantera de dagliga arbetsuppgifterna i butiken
    Ta ansvar och kunna arbeta självständigt

Arbetstid: Cirka kl. 10.00–18.00.

Erfarenhet av secondhand, butik, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande.

Vi värdesätter att du är:

    Ärlig och pålitlig
    Ansvarsfull och punktlig
    Serviceinriktad och trevlig mot kunder
    Självständig och initiativtagande
    Noggrann och arbetsvillig

Arbetsgivare: Raymonds AB

Arbetsort: Osby med omnejd

Antal tjänster: 2 personer

Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan

Är du intresserad av någon av tjänsterna? Skicka en kort presentation av dig själv och berätta om din tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet. Ange också om du söker tjänsten som städare eller secondhandmedarbetare.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Enterprise Architect – Gothenburg

We are looking to extend our team with an experienced Enterprise Architect for a fast-growing technology start-up here in Gothenburg.

Work Description:

As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a key role in developing and improving the company's Enterprise IT architecture, governance, and system landscape. You will define architectural principles, drive integration strategies, and ensure that IT solutions support business objectives, security requirements, and long-term scalability.

The role combines strategic architectural planning with hands-on technical involvement, working closely with Enterprise IT, business stakeholders, Procurement, and external IT providers.

Architecture Lead – Strategy & Governance

    Enterprise Architecture & Roadmap: Define target architecture and develop IT roadmaps aligned with business needs, risks, and costs.
    Architecture Governance: Establish and lead architecture reviews, governance processes, standards, and design principles.
    System Landscape Management: Map and maintain enterprise systems, ownership, dependencies, and integrations.
    Architecture Optimization: Identify technical debt, overlapping systems, and opportunities for consolidation.
    Stakeholder Collaboration: Support architectural decisions together with management, business functions, and external IT partners.

Technical & Solution Design

    Solution & Integration Architecture: Guide solution designs and integration strategies using APIs, event-driven integrations, and iPaaS platforms.
    Data Architecture & Governance: Define standards for data modelling, master data management, classification, and ownership.
    Enterprise Applications: Evaluate and guide architectural decisions involving ERP, CRM, PLM, HR, and other SaaS platforms.
    Cloud & Security Architecture: Support solutions involving Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, IAM, and zero-trust principles.
    Security & Compliance: Ensure architectural alignment with TISAX, ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS2.
    AI & Emerging Technologies: Evaluate AI tools and agents to ensure architectural and security alignment.

Solution Implementation Oversight

    Architecture Reviews: Ensure new systems, integrations, and major changes follow architectural standards.
    Integration & System Onboarding: Support implementation, vendor evaluations, and technical requirements for new systems.
    Architecture Documentation: Maintain system diagrams, integration maps, architectural decision records (ADRs), and technical standards.
    Technical Optimization: Drive improvements in system efficiency, integration quality, and technical debt reduction.
    Vendor Collaboration: Work closely with outsourced infrastructure providers and technology partners.

Required Qualifications & Experience

    5–7 years of experience as an Enterprise, Solution, or Integration Architect.
    Proven experience establishing enterprise architecture, governance, standards, and architecture review processes in growing organizations.
    Strong background in system integration, APIs, event-driven architecture, and iPaaS platforms.
    Experience in system landscape mapping, consolidation, data architecture, and governance.
    Knowledge of enterprise SaaS platforms such as ERP, CRM, PLM, and HR systems.
    Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, IAM, and cloud security.
    Understanding of TISAX, ISO 27001, GDPR, and NIS2.
    Experience working with outsourced IT infrastructure providers.
    Familiarity with TOGAF, ArchiMate, ITIL, or similar frameworks.
    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and business-oriented decision-making skills.
    Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious Qualifications:

    Experience from the automotive industry or other regulated technology environments.
    Swedish language skills.

Assignment Details:

    Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
    Start: ASAP
    Engagement: Full-time (100%)

jobs.title: Leidingtechnicus
jobs.description:
Achter deze vacature als leidingtechnicus regio Leuven zit een bedrijf dat bouwt aan de toekomst van energie en infrastructuur in België. Ze zijn actief in ondergrondse leidingen, distributienetten en industriële installaties en hebben al meer dan vijftig jaar ervaring in hun vak. Hun ploegen werken voor overheden en nutsbedrijven en doen dat met moderne technieken en veilig materiaal. Wie hier start, wordt goed begeleid: je loopt mee met ervaren collega’s die je stap voor stap het vak aanleren. De sfeer is eerlijk en collegiaal – samen werken, samen lachen, samen groeien. Veiligheid en kwaliteit staan centraal, maar er is ook ruimte voor humor en menselijkheid. Deze job in Leuven is meer dan een baan: het is een startpunt voor een stabiele toekomst in de bouw en techniek.


Jobomschrijving

's Ochtends vroeg. De wekker rinkelt. Vandaag is je eerste dag als leidingtechnicus in regio Leuven. Je trekt je veiligheidsschoenen aan, springt in de camionette en voelt die mix van goesting en zenuwen. Op de werf word je opgewacht door je ploegbaas die zegt: “Welkom! Vandaag leer je hoe ondergrondse leidingen écht gelegd worden.”
- Je helpt bij het plaatsen en verbinden van leidingen op werven in Leuven en omgeving.
- Je leert werken rond sleuven en met moderne meettoestellen.
- Je bereidt materialen voor en legt buizen op de juiste plaats.
- Je ondersteunt bij het inmeten en nivelleren van leidingen.
- Je volgt veiligheidsregels nauwgezet op en krijgt uitleg over je persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen.
- Je werkt op de werf samen met ervaren techniekers die je de knepen van het vak leren.
- Je ziet elke dag tastbaar resultaat van je werk door leidingen in het werk te stellen die écht gebruikt worden.
- Je denkt mee en stelt vragen want zo leer je het snelst.
- Je helpt de energietransitie in regio Leuven mee uit te bouwen.
- Je sluit de dag af met het gevoel dat je iets écht hebt bijgedragen.

In deze functie van leidingtechnicus regio Leuven zoeken we iemand met goesting om te werken en te leren. Motivatie is hierbij de grootste troef.
- Je hebt een opleiding in de bouw, techniek of elektriciteit achter de rug.
- Je wil graag iets doen waarbij je handen en hoofd samen werken.
- Je bent graag buiten en werkt liever met materiaal dan met muisklikken.
- Je neemt veiligheid serieus en gebruikt steeds de nodige beschermingsmiddelen.
- Je kan instructies goed volgen en stelt vragen als iets onduidelijk is.
- Je werkt graag in teamverband.
- Je wil een vaste job waar toekomstmuziek in zit.
- Je bent niet bang van wat fysiek werk en hebt doorzettingsvermogen.
- Je wil meewerken aan iets groters, zoals de leidingen die onze toekomst verbinden.
- Je komt graag op tijd en doet gewoon wat je zegt.

jobs.title: Arbeider wegenwerken
jobs.description:
Wie hier als arbeider wegenwerken in Geetbets begint, merkt snel dat structuur en teamwerk centraal staan. De werven worden goed voorbereid, de briefing is helder, iedereen kent zijn rol. Ervaren collega’s staan klaar om kennis te delen, tegelijk krijg je vertrouwen om zelfstandig te werken. Veiligheid is zichtbaar aanwezig, het materiaal is in orde, afspraken worden nageleefd. Projecten variëren van rioleringen en betonwegen tot stadspleinen, je ziet dagelijks tastbaar resultaat. De planning is realistisch, de communicatie is direct, het respect voor vakmanschap is oprecht. Wie inzet toont, krijgt kansen om bij te leren en door te groeien, zonder het menselijke uit het oog te verliezen.


Jobomschrijving

In deze job als arbeider wegenwerken regio Geetbets kom je terecht op werven waar tempo, afwerking en veiligheid tellen. We zoeken iemand die meters maakt en kwaliteit levert.
- Je helpt bij rioleringen plaatsen, je zorgt voor propere sleuven en nette aansluitingen.
- Je zet boordstenen en trottoirs, je volgt maatvoering en plan.
- Je nivelleert onderfunderingen, je gebruikt trilplaat en laser.
- Je giet en werkt beton af, je bewaakt het oppervlak.
- Je bereidt asfalt- en betonlagen voor, je denkt mee met de ploeg.
- Je houdt de werf veilig en ordelijk, je meldt risico’s meteen.
- Je werkt vlot samen met machinisten en collega's.

Voor deze vacature arbeider wegenwerken in Geetbets mikken we op iemand met eerste sterke ervaring in grond- of wegenwerken. Hier toon je vooral vakmanschap, verantwoordelijkheid en zin voor resultaat.
- Jij kan zelfstandig taken opnemen.
- Je schakelt snel tussen voorbereiden en afwerken.
- Je werkte al op een werf met riolering, boordstenen of beton.
- Je leest een plan of je laat het je vlot toelichten, je stelt gerichte vragen.
- Je meet liever twee keer voor je begint.
- Je kan met laser en klein materieel overweg en je respecteert het onderhoud hier van.
- Je raakt zelfstandig tot aan een ophaalpunt.
- Je bent stipt.
- Leergierigheid is hier nodig.

jobs.title: Metselaar
jobs.description:
Als metselaar regio Sint-Truiden kom je terecht in een hecht team dat elke dag bouwt aan projecten die gezien mogen worden. Je werkt samen met mensen die fier zijn op hun stiel, elkaar helpen en mekaar waarderen. Je voelt meteen dat er ruimte is om te leren, fouten te maken en beter te worden. De werfsfeer is menselijk, met korte lijnen tussen ploegbaas en arbeider. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en respect staan er niet alleen op papier, maar worden effectief nageleefd. Er is aandacht voor persoonlijke groei: wie inzet toont, krijgt kansen om bij te leren en door te groeien. En bovenal: je werkt aan iets tastbaars. Elke muur, elke gevel, elke steen die je legt, blijft zichtbaar als bewijs van je vakmanschap.


Jobomschrijving

In deze vacature van metselaar regio Sint-Truiden krijg je de kans om je eerste stappen in de bouw te zetten of je schoolkennis eindelijk in praktijk te brengen. Je bouwt letterlijk mee aan stevige muren, rechte lijnen en zichtbare resultaten waar je trots op kan zijn.
- Je helpt bij het opbouwen van muren, gevels en funderingen.
- Je leert profielen uitzetten en mortel voorbereiden samen met ervaren collega’s.
- Je voert metselwerken uit in snelbouw, betonblokken of gevelsteen.
- Je controleert of alles waterpas en volgens plan gebeurt.
- Je springt bij met opruimwerk, materiaal klaarmaken en stenen aanreiken.
- Je leert omgaan met modern gereedschap en veilig werken op de werf.
- Je werkt nauw samen met je ploegbaas en volgt zijn aanwijzingen op.
- Je krijgt de kans om door te groeien binnen je team naarmate je zelfstandiger wordt.

Voor deze functie van metselaar in Sint-Truiden zoeken we iemand die zin heeft om te werken, bij te leren en vooral: te bouwen. Je hoeft geen jaren ervaring te hebben, als je maar goesting hebt om de handen uit de mouwen te steken.
- Je hebt een opleiding bouw gevolgd of deed al een eerste ervaring op in metselwerken.
- Je werkt graag buiten en houdt van fysiek werk.
- Je geraakt elke dag tot aan het ophaalpunt of kan thuis in Sint-Truiden aan je voordeur opgepikt worden.
- Je hebt oog voor nauwkeurigheid en wil dat je werk er goed uitziet.
- Je bent leergierig en neemt graag tips over van ervaren collega’s.
- Veiligheid op de werf vind je belangrijk.
- Je wil terechtkomen in een ploeg die elkaar helpt, lacht en waar het vooruitgaat.

jobs.title: Kundservicemedarbetare till företag i Göteborg
jobs.description:
Har du erfarenhet av administration eller kundtjänst och vill utvecklas vidare i en roll med mycket kundkontakt? Trivs du med dialog med kunder och att bygga långsiktiga relationer? Nu söker vi en kundservicemedarbetare till ett större företag där rollen kombinerar administrativa uppgifter med löpande kontakt med kunder.

Om tjänsten

Det här är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid som varar i 12 månader. Du blir anställd av Bravura och arbetar som konsult hos företaget. Det finns möjligheter till förlängning av uppdraget.

🚀 Om företaget

Vi kan per idag inte berätta vilket företag det gäller. Givetvis kommer du att få reda på det under processens gång, som senast när du är på intervju hos oss på Bravura.

💼 Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen arbetar du i en kundnära och bred funktion där ni ansvarar för både kundservice och administration och är kundens huvudsakliga kontaktväg. Du bygger nära och långsiktiga relationer med kunderna och fungerar som spindeln i nätet mellan kund, trafikledning och övriga involverade parter. Arbetet innebär att ta emot bokningar och upphämtningsförfrågningar från kund, säkerställa att all information är korrekt och förmedla ärendena vidare till trafikledare som ansvarar för själva inhämtningen. Under hela transportflödet har du löpande kontakt med kund och bekräftar status, från bokning till leverans. Du samordnar dialogen mellan kund, trafikledning och chaufför och ser till att informationen flyter på ett strukturerat sätt.

När transporten är genomförd hanterar du den administrativa uppföljningen, bland annat fakturering. Vid avvikelser, förseningar eller om gods behöver spåras, driver du ärendet vidare, genomför sökningar och hanterar reklamationer i dialog med kund och interna funktioner.

    

Huvudkontakt mot nyckelkunder

    

Administrativt arbete kopplat till flödet

🔍Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper

    

Avslutad gymnasieutbildning

    

Erfarenhet av administration eller kundtjänst

    

God dator- och systemvana

    

Obehindrade kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift, goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

För att trivas i rollen är du relationsskapande och har ett tydligt kundfokus. Du är lugn och sansad i ditt bemötande, även när kraven är höga eller dialogen blir utmanande. Du är inte rädd för att ta tag i saker, sätta gränser när det behövs och driva frågor framåt på ett professionellt sätt. Rollen kräver att du kan hantera flera parallella ärenden samtidigt och snabbt växla mellan olika uppgifter, utan att tappa struktur eller servicekänsla. Du har ett tryggt sätt att kommunicera, är lösningsorienterad och har den mentala uthållighet som krävs för att bygga och behålla långsiktiga kundrelationer över tid.

Övrig information

Start: Omgående Plats: Göteborg Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Slumpmässiga drogtester förekommer på arbetsplatsen.

Vi använder en kompetensbaserad metodik i alla rekryteringsprocesser för att säkerställa fördomsfria urval. Vi jobbar också med löpande urval, vilket innebär att vi tar ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har ansökt. Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer vi att kontakta dig för en första telefonintervju. Oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte så kommer du att få återkoppling på din ansökan.

Har du frågor? Hör gärna av dig!
