jobs.title: Målare för roliga projekt i Göteborg med omnejd
jobs.description:
Vi söker målare till spännande projekt i Göteborg med omnejd 🎨

Är du en noggrann och engagerad målare som gillar att skapa fina resultat och nöjda kunder? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!

Vi söker nu målare till flera olika projekt och kunduppdrag i Göteborg med omnejd. Uppdragen varierar i både storlek och karaktär, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta med allt från traditionellt måleriarbete i bostäder till större renoveringar och kommersiella lokaler.

Vi tror på ett gott samarbete, ett professionellt bemötande och stoltheten i att lämna ifrån sig ett väl utfört arbete. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra med din kompetens i varierande projekt och möta olika kunder och miljöer.

Om rollen

Som målare kommer du att arbeta med varierande måleriarbeten hos både privatpersoner, företag och andra kunder. Beroende på projekt kan arbetet omfatta såväl invändigt som utvändigt måleri, nyproduktion, renovering och underhåll.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

    Invändigt måleri: Målning av väggar, tak, lister, dörrar, fönster och andra snickerier.
    Utvändigt måleri: Fasadmålning, målning av trädetaljer, fönster, staket och andra utvändiga ytor.
    Förberedande arbete: Skrapning, slipning, spackling, lagning av sprickor och hål samt rengöring av ytor.
    Grundarbete och behandling: Grundmålning, grundning av olika material samt val av lämpliga färger och ytbehandlingar.
    Tapetsering: Borttagning av gamla tapeter, underarbete och uppsättning av nya tapeter.
    Renovering och underhåll: Uppfräschning av befintliga ytor, underhållsmålning och restaurering av målade ytor.
    Målning av olika material: Behandling av exempelvis trä, puts, gips och andra vanliga underlag.
    Maskering och skydd: Täcka golv, möbler och andra ytor samt säkerställa att arbetsplatsen hålls ren och välordnad.
    Kvalitetskontroll: Kontrollera det färdiga resultatet och säkerställa att arbetet håller hög kvalitet.
    Kundkontakt och samarbete: Ha en god dialog med kunder, kollegor och andra yrkesgrupper på arbetsplatsen.
    Material och planering: Hantera färg och material på ett ansvarsfullt sätt samt planera arbetet för att uppnå ett effektivt och hållbart resultat.

Arbetsuppgifterna varierar mellan projekten, och vi ser gärna att du är flexibel och tycker om en vardag där ingen arbetsdag behöver vara den andra lik.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är yrkesstolt, serviceinriktad och noggrann. Du förstår värdet av ett väl utfört arbete och tycker om att lämna efter dig ett resultat som både du och kunden kan vara nöjda med.

Vi ser gärna att du:

    Har utbildning inom måleri eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.
    Har erfarenhet av vanligt förekommande måleriarbeten.
    Är noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och har känsla för detaljer.
    Är självgående och kan planera och genomföra dina arbetsuppgifter på ett ansvarsfullt sätt.
    Har en positiv inställning och trivs med att samarbeta med andra.
    Har ett professionellt och trevligt bemötande gentemot kunder.
    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter olika projekt och arbetsmiljöer.
    Behärskar svenska eller engelska i den utsträckning som krävs för att kommunicera på arbetsplatsen.

B-körkort är meriterande, särskilt eftersom projekten finns på olika platser i Göteborg med omnejd.

Det viktigaste för oss är att du är engagerad i ditt arbete, tar ansvar och vill bidra till goda resultat och nöjda kunder.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika kunder och projekt i Göteborgsregionen. Vi vill skapa goda förutsättningar för att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna stolthet över det du gör.

Vi erbjuder:

    Varierande arbetsuppgifter och projekt hos olika kunder.
    Möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom olika typer av måleriarbeten.
    En vardag där kvalitet, yrkesstolthet och kundnöjdhet står i fokus.
    Möjlighet att arbeta självständigt och tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor.
    En arbetsmiljö där ett gott samarbete och ett professionellt bemötande uppskattas.
    

Vi värdesätter människor som tar ansvar, bidrar med positiv energi och vill göra ett bra jobb tillsammans med andra.

Ansökan

Låter det här som något för dig? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Skicka gärna in din ansökan med en kort presentation av dig själv, din erfarenhet och vilka typer av måleriarbeten du har arbetat med tidigare till rekrytering@doerbemanning.se

Vi rekryterar målare till flera olika projekt och kunder i Göteborg med omnejd och är därför intresserade av att komma i kontakt med både erfarna målare och dig som har en relevant utbildning och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom yrket.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

Jobbet som Arbetsledare

Som arbetsledare planerar du för och leder en grupp medarbetare som jobbar i kunduppdrag inom lokalvård. I nära samarbete med Områdeschefer stöttar du våra medarbetare i att upptäcka och utveckla sin kompetens för att på sikt lämna Samhall för en annan arbetsgivare. Det gör du bäst genom att lära känna dina medarbetare och jobba nära dem i vardagen.

I ditt dagliga arbete säkerställer du att allt fungerar som det ska för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för våra medarbetare att utvecklas samt att våra kunder blir nöjda.  

Du är expert i drift-frågor gällande lokalvård och kommer projektleda uppstarter, utökningar och avveckling av kunduppdrag.

Som arbetsledare rapporterar du till Verksamhetschef.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Här utvecklas du som ledare oavsett tidigare erfarenhet och bygger dessutom specifik kunskap inom flera områden, bland annat kring att leda personer med funktionsnedsättning.

Här har du ett nationellt nätverk samtidigt som du lokalt ingår i ett distrikt där du har dina närmaste kollegor samt rapporterar till verksamhetschef. Du samarbetar också med olika stödfunktioner lokalt och centralt. Samhall befinner sig i viktig och spännande utveckling där dina perspektiv tas tillvara.

Vad tar du med dig in i rollen?

Som arbetsledare är du operativ, närvarande och ser vad som behöver göras. Att du har erfarenhet från och trivs i en verksamhet som präglas av högt tempo och med människan i centrum är ett krav.

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi du har:

    

Minst 2 års erfarenhet av lokalvård

    

Erfarenhet av arbetsledande funktion på området lokalvård

    

Erfarenhet av arbete enligt SRY och INSTA 800

    

Tidigare arbetat med administration, dokumentation och har god systemvana

    

Gymnasieexamen

    

Svenska flytande i både tal och i skrift

    

B-körkort

Kunduppdragen kommer kräva genomförd och godkänd bakgrundskontroll som en del i rekryteringsprocessen.

Förutom gedigen kunskap är det dock vår värdegrund som gör att våra ledare trivs och gör ett bra jobb över tid. Din tro på alla människors lika värde, att alla människor har kompetens samt att jobbet har stor betydelse är det som motiverar i vardagen.

Ansökan och praktisk information

Vill du bli en av oss? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

På Samhall arbetar människor med många olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, det tror vi gör oss till en mer kreativ och rolig arbetsplats. Därför söker vi alltid efter personer som på olika sätt kan bidra till att bredda våra perspektiv.

Rekryteringsprocessen består av flera steg som inkluderar möten, tester, referenskontroll och bakgrundskontroll.

Om du har frågor eller behöver komma i kontakt med oss är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till oss enligt nedan.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organizations work and outpace their competition.

About The Role

As a CSM at monday.com, you will be a product master and trusted technical advisor, helping our customers build, optimise and scale their workflows. You’ll focus on the practical application of our platform, directly improving how customers work every day, including how they adopt and operationalise monday.com’s growing suite of AI capabilities.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Paris office.

You’ll have a strong impact on our customers’ success by:

Product & AI Expertise

  • Being a product and AI expert - master the technical aspects of our platform, including AI features, agents, and automations, to help enterprise customers solve complex business cases and define their unique setup with monday.com.

  • Operating AI-first - personally use AI tools to maximise your own efficiency every day: prepare for customer conversations using AI-generated research and account insights, automate routine tasks, and model the same AI-first working practices you help customers adopt.

Technical Implementation & Governance

  • Driving technical hands-on implementation - work directly with customers to set up and deploy new use cases, including AI-powered workflows, that solve real business challenges. You discover, plan and build things, not just recommend them.

  • Leading AI & Workflow Enablement - lead architecture reviews to ensure scale, performance, and alignment with customer goals, and lead governance initiatives around AI and workflow orchestration.

Value & Workflow Optimisation

  • Demonstrating value - clearly articulate the value of new and existing use cases, connecting their benefits directly to the customer’s business goals. Help customers see the ROI of monday.com’s AI capabilities in terms that resonate at every level of their organisation.

  • Optimising customer workflows - help customers improve their existing processes on the platform, identifying where AI automations and agents can increase efficiency, reduce manual work, drive deeper adoption and grow value. Conduct platform audits, share best practices, and document success criteria to drive performance, resiliency, and alignment to business outcomes.

Strategic Engagement

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor - engage in strategic c-suite level conversations, helping customers prioritise and unblock technical challenges throughout their lifecycle with monday.com.

  • Acting as the Voice of the Customer - collect and share customer feedback, including on AI feature adoption and gaps, with our product and engineering teams to help inform future development.

Retention, Growth & Risk Management

  • Ensuring retention and growth across your book - proactively manage your portfolio to ensure long-term customer satisfaction, successful renewals and ARR growth. Building the kind of operational dependency that makes renewal conversations straightforward.

  • Proactively addressing risks - identify and mitigate potential churn risks by ensuring customers are consistently deriving value from the platform and monitoring data signals across your portfolio.

 

Your Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager, Technical Customer Success or similar client-facing, hands-on role at a SaaS company.

  • Proven track record of implementing and configuring software solutions for clients, including hands-on platform deployment and architecture.

  • A passion for technology and AI, with the ability to quickly learn and master new products, including hands-on experience with AI tools in your day-to-day work.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical governance initiatives and platform audits, sharing best practices to drive performance, resiliency, and deeper adoption.

  • Experience engaging in strategic technical conversations with senior stakeholders (c-suite level), acting as a trusted advisor who can bridge business and technical outcomes.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to diagnose issues, interpret data, and provide practical solutions.

  • A creative, self-starter mentality with the ability to manage initiatives independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong understanding of how enterprise businesses operate and how they integrate software tools.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a talent for building strong relationships across a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience building and executing account plans to drive adoption and ensure long-term customer success.

  • Experience working in a global team for an international company.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager SMB
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

 

What You'll Do:

You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will:

  • Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work.

  • Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.

  • Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora.

  • Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews.

  • Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities.

  • Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization.

  • Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination.

  • Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment.

     

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We’re looking for:

  • A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases.

  • Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels.

  • 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment.

  • A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients.

  • Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation.

  • Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes.

  • Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale.

  • Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently.

  • Excellent French and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal.

  • High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.

  • A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

     

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA.

  • A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions.

  • Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential.

  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and an office designed for focus and high performance.

     

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At Swile, we believe that good products can help reduce friction in daily professional life and boost employee satisfaction. Today, we provide innovative solutions in various areas such as Fintech, Travel, HR, and Employee Benefits to more than 5.5 million users in 85,000 companies in France and Brazil.

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will join the Data Platform team. We are an enablement team: we build the tools, standards and foundations that let every engineering team at Swile own its data autonomously. You will work at the crossroads of data, software engineering and infrastructure, in a senior team where everyone has a direct impact.

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, your mission will be to:
  • Design and improve the tools and platforms that empower engineering teams to build and run their own data pipelines
  • Ship AI tooling (Skills, MCP) as part of the platform, to help teams design, build and run their data products
  • Contribute to our batch processing (Airflow, dbt) and event-driven architecture (Kafka)
  • Define, document and promote standards and best practices
  • Help teams adopt our tools and practices, and grow their skills
  • Evangelize the platform vision and build relays across teams, in France and Brazil
    •  

    ✨It will be a perfect match if you:
  • Have solid experience in data engineering or platform engineering, with a good software engineering culture
  • Have strong expertise in one area (data, infrastructure, software, EDA/streaming, developer tooling) and are curious to learn the others
  • Have worked with some of these: Python, Ruby, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform
  • Are autonomous, communicate clearly, and enjoy collaborating with and supporting other teams
  • Are curious about new tools and practices, including AI (no expertise required)
  • Speak good English (we work daily with our teams in Brazil)
  • You are a future responsible swiler: you share our commitment to the environment, diversity, fairness and inclusion and are prepared to work every day to improve individual and collective performance.

    • 📓 One thing worth to be mentioned
    We welcome people from entrepreneurial backgrounds as well as from established organizations. A platform, infrastructure or software background is just as relevant as a pure data engineering one. At Swile, we believe that delivering impactful products requires engineers to understand the needs of users and clients as well as the code itself.

    ⚒️ Our tech stack
  • Ruby/Rails, Typescript/Node.js
  • Terraform/Terragrunt, Python, SQL, dbt
  • AWS/Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Kafka (MSK), Airflow (MWAA), Snowflake

    • 💡What’s in it for you ?
  • An opportunity to integrate a dynamic team of talented engineers.
  • A broad role with direct impact on how many teams work at Swile.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be the face of IT at an international airport site, in a demanding operational environment?

Joining SAL International at Liège Airport means ensuring, day in and day out, the continuity of IT services for a multilingual organisation at the heart of logistics and airport operations.

As part of its growth, SAL International is looking for an L1 IT Support Technician – Resident Engineer based in Liège.

WHY JOIN SAL INTERNATIONAL?

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

  • A dynamic, operational environment at the heart of Liège Airport
  • An international and multilingual setting
  • An autonomous role: you are the site's IT point of reference
  • A solid structure, backed by central IT teams (L2/L3, infrastructure, network, security


Jobomschrijving

As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk.

User support

  • Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site
  • Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals
  • Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support
  • Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN)
  • Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)

Access and security

  • Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures
  • Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)

Hardware and lifecycle

  • Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals)
  • Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights)
  • Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals
  • Tickets, escalation and coordination
  • Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…)
  • Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs
  • Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers
  • Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions
  • Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)

You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.

THE TEAM & THE MANAGER

Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT
  • At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support
  • Fluent French and English, both spoken and written
  • Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA
  • Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity

Assets

  • Knowledge of Arabic
  • Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer
  • Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment
  • IT certifications (CompTIA A , ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)

Soft skills

  • Customer focus and service mindset
  • Autonomy and rigour in incident management
  • Clear communication with non-technical users
  • Hands-on, proactive attitude

jobs.title: Varastopäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Etsimme varastopäällikköä kehittämään ja johtamaan varastomme toimintaa**

Sun Effects Oy on suunnittelu- ja tuotantotalo, joka lisäksi vuokraa laadukasta tapahtumakalustoa ja maahantuo valaisinlaitteita.

**Valo-, nosto- ja ripustuskaluston** (rigging) lisäksi varastoimme **lavastus- ja somistemateriaalia**, joka ei aina sovellu tavanomaiseen lavavarastointiin. Jokainen kalustoryhmä vaatii oman tapansa säilyttää, pakata ja käsitellä – ja juuri siinä tarvitsemme sinun osaamistasi.

**Varastopäällikkönä** pyörität varaston arkea, johdat pientä tiimiä käytännönläheisesti ja ymmärrät kaluston liiketoiminnallisen potentiaalin. Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemuksen lisäksi omaa näkemystä varastonhallinnasta: miten tilaa, sijainteja, tavaravirtoja ja työvaiheita järjestetään niin, että kalusto löytyy, pysyy kunnossa ja liikkuu sujuvasti. Keikkojen pakkaamisesta ja purkamisesta huolehtivat yleensä projekteille palkatut teknikot.

**Tehtävässäsi**

· **Johdat varaston päivittäistä toimintaa** – keräilyt, lähtö- ja paluutarkastukset, kaluston kunnossapito ja huoltojen ohjaus, inventaariot sekä varaston järjestys, turvallisuus ja erilaisille kalustoryhmille sopivat säilytys- ja pakkausratkaisut.

· **Hallitset tavaravirrat** – varastomme kautta kulkevat myös maahantuomiemme valaisinlaitteiden lähetykset sekä päivittäiset pakettilähetykset ja -vastaanotot. Huolehdit, että saapuvat ja lähtevät toimitukset kirjataan, tarkastetaan ja lähetetään ajallaan.

· **Toimit esihenkilönä** varaston tuntityöntekijöille ja tarpeen mukaan työskenteleville freelancereille: suunnittelet työvuorot, perehdytät, jaat työt ja huolehdit, että jokainen tietää mitä tehdään ja miksi.

· **Varmistat riittävät resurssit -** buukkaat apuvoimia tarpeen mukaan huomioiden kiirehuiput ja loma-ajat.

· **Kehität vuokraustoiminnan tuloksellisuutta** – seuraat kaluston käyttöastetta ja kuntoa, tuot näkemystä hankintoihin ja hinnoitteluun, huolehdit että vauriot, puutteet ja lisätyöt kirjataan ja laskutetaan, ja palvelet vuokra-asiakkaita noudoissa ja palautuksissa.

· **Koordinoit logistiikkaa** - vastaat kuormien suunnittelusta ja kommunikoit sujuvasti tuotannon, myynnin ja logistiikkakumppaniemme kanssa kuljetusaikatauluista

· **Kehität varaston toimintaa** – sinulla on näkemystä prosessien, Rentmanin hyödyntämisen, viivakoodi-/RFID-merkintöjen, työturvallisuuden ja tilankäytön kehittämiseen.

· **Toimit kiinteässä yhteistyössä** huollon, tuottajien ja myynnin kanssa ja tuot varaston näkökulman mukaan jo projektien suunnitteluvaiheessa.

**Toivomme sinulta**

· **Ymmärrystä keikka-alan rytmistä ja halua oppia**, mitä kalusto vaatii. Kokemus tapahtuma-, AV-, valo-, ääni- tai vuokraamoalalta on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

· **Esihenkilö- tai työnjohtokokemusta**, mieluiten myös vaihtuvista keikkatyöntekijöistä.

· **Kaupallista silmää** - näet kaluston pääomana, joka hyvin hoidettuna ja oikein käytettynä tuottaa.

· **Kokemusta varastonhallinta- tai vuokrausjärjestelmistä** – käytämme Rentmania, jonka tuntemus on etu.

· **Järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia** – organisoit, ennakoit ja siedät painetta. Pidät langat käsissäsi, vaikka samaan aikaan on käynnissä useita tuotantoja, vuokrauksia ja toimituksia.

· **Selkeää viestintää** suomeksi ja englanniksi.

· **Sujuvia perustaitoja toimisto-ohjelmista** (esim. Microsoft 365 tai Google Workspace)

· **B-ajokorttia ja työturvallisuuskorttia.**

**Katsomme eduksi**

· Kokemus prosessien kehittämisestä

· Trukinajotaito

· C-ajokortti ja kuormansidonnan osaaminen

· Kokemus kuljetusten tai alihankkijoiden koordinoinnista ja kustannusseurannasta

**Tarjoamme**

· Keskeisen roolin kasvavassa tapahtuma-alan yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten varasto ja vuokraus toimivat

· Vakituisen, kokoaikaisen työn monipuolisten tehtävien parissa mielenkiintoisella toimialalla

· Palkka: 3300-3800 eur/kk kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan

· Edut: liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, työterveyshuolto, puhelinetu

Työpaikka sijaitsee Helsingin Roihupellossa. Työajat painottuvat arkipäiviin, mutta alan luonteen mukaisesti työ vaatii ajoittain joustoa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail.

We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.

This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.


About Scality

Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.

Industry recognition:

  • Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception
  • #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors
  • Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category
  • Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA

About the team

You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution).

The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.


How We Build

We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.

We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.

If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.

One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.


How This Role Works

Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.

  • Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.
  • The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.
  • You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.
  • You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them.
  • You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.

    • The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.


Your First Missions

Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.

1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked

Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.

Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.

  • A standing exposure record, per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration
  • Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives
  • Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs
  • Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks
  • A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy
  • Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable
  • A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira
  • AI-assisted remediation, where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships

    • Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.

    2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS

    SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:

    • A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution
    • Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)
    • Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds
    • Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline
    • Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on
    • Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets

      • You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.


What We Are Looking For

This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat.

Required

  • Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI
  • Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below
  • Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase
  • A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real
  • Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment
  • Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it
  • The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed
  • The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend
  • French — the team works in French day to day
  • Written communication skills in English

    • Nice to Have

    • CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience
    • Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls
    • Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing
    • RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals
    • SELinux policy work
    • CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions
    • RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)
    • Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)
    • Ansible or Salt
    • Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3
    • Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts
    • Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete

      • To Be Clear About Scope

      This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.


What We Offer
  • Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done
  • Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick
  • A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters
  • Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release
  • Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in every engineer’s hands, and a real say in how AI reshapes our build and delivery chain
  • A rare combination: security work with the leverage of owning the whole stack, down to our own Linux distribution
  • Mentorship from senior engineers with deep expertise across Linux, storage, packaging, and distributed systems — you will not be the only person who understands your perimeter
  • A long-term growth path toward becoming your team’s security reference and a senior voice in the network
  • Work that ships to production and runs at exabyte scale, in banking, healthcare, and government
  • Standard French benefits: meal vouchers, Navigo subsidy, mutuelle

jobs.title: Advokathuset Helgeland AS søker advokat/advokatfullmektig til sin avdeling i Mo i Rana
jobs.employer: ADVOKATHUSET HELGELAND AS AVD MO I RANA
jobs.description:
Advokathuset Helgeland AS søker advokat/advokatfullmektig til sin avdeling i Mo i Rana

Vi opplever økt oppdragsmengde og søker derfor etter en ny advokat eller advokatfullmektig som kan styrke vårt team i Mo i Rana. Vi ser etter deg som tar initiativ, med et ønske om vekst og videreutvikling i vårt firma. Hos oss vil du bli en del av et kollegialt miljø, der vi i fellesskap utvikler oss faglig og som arbeidsplass.

Om oss

Advokathuset Helgeland består av 7 advokater, 1 advokatfullmektig og 2 service- og administrasjonsmedarbeidere, fordelt på våre avdelinger i Mosjøen og Mo i Rana, Helgeland. Vi har gode kontorfasiliteter for begge avdelingene, sentralt i bykjernen.

Vi yter tjenester til næringsdrivende, privatpersoner og det offentlige, med bred kompetanse innenfor de fleste juridiske fagfelt, inkludert selskapsrett, entrepriserett, generell kontraktsrett, fast eiendomsrettsforhold, strafferett og arv- og familierett. Selv om vi dekker et bredt spekter av fagområder, er det likevel rom for at den enkelte advokat kan jobbe mer spesialisert.

Vi har jevnlig prosedyreoppdrag hvor vi representerer både private og næringsdrivende i tvisteløsning for domstolene, så vel som i forliksrådet og fylkesnemnda. Advokatfullmektiger hos oss får vanligvis innvilget advokatbevilling innen 2 år. I tillegg gir vi bred juridisk rådgivning, og bistår i forhandlinger. Selskapet har også jevnlig oppdrag for Helgeland tingrett, herunder bostyreroppdrag og tvangssalg m.m. Flere av våre advokater har verv som fast forsvarer hos Helgeland tingrett. Du kan lese mer om Advokathuset Helgeland AS på www.advokathuset-helgeland.no.

Helgeland er en region i stadig utvikling, med engasjerende fremtidsutsikter særlig når det gjelder industri. Regionen er også et ettertraktet område for rekreasjon og friluftsliv i umiddelbar nærhet til den vakre Helgelandskysten og fjellområdene i innlandet. Dette gir gode turmuligheter både sommer og vinter. Helgeland har også et meget rikt og variert kulturtilbud. Les mer om regionen på www.visithelgeland.com

Hva vi kan tilby

-Et ungt og spennende arbeidsmiljø

-En sunn balanse mellom jobb og fritid

-En interessant og variert arbeidshverdag

-Faglig og personlig utvikling

-Muligheter for stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar, men også tett samarbeid med kollegaer

- Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Kvalifikasjoner

Kandidaten må ha juridisk embetseksamen eller mastergrad i rettsvitenskap. I tillegg er det ønskelig med følgende egenskaper:

-Gode juridiske ferdigheter

-Evne til å jobbe strukturert, selvstendig og være løsningsorientert

-God språklig fremstillingsevne på norsk, og gjerne også på engelsk

-Erfaring som advokat/advokatfullmektig tillegges vekt

Dersom du har spørsmål om stillingen eller ønsker en uformell prat, er du velkommen til å kontakte advokat/daglig leder Ane Hiller Fladvad, tlf. 958 35 156 eller e-post anef@advhelg.no.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Advokathuset Helgeland består av 7 advokater, 1 advokatfullmektig og 2 service- og administrasjonsmedarbeidere, fordelt på våre avdelinger i Mosjøen og Mo i Rana, Helgeland. Vi har gode kontorfasiliteter for begge avdelingene, sentralt i bykjernen.

jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.


Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
  • Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
  • Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
  • Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
  • Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.

Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

  • You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
  • Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
  • You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
  • Your attention to detail is unmatched.
  • Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

jobs.title: Captain for Tugboat
jobs.description:
Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.


Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
  • Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
  • Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
  • Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
  • CRR holder credentials.
  • A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
  • A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.
  • Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

jobs.title: Production Operator (with housing)
jobs.description:
Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people.

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.


Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization.

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:

  • Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.
  • Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.
  • Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.
  • Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.
  • Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.
  • Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:

  • Experience in a production environment.
  • Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.
  • Ability to work with a computer.
  • Good command of English or Dutch.
  • Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.
  • Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.
  • No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).
  • Physical work does not deter you.
  • Basic technical knowledge.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (Junior) – Full Training Provided
jobs.description:
Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.


Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:

  • Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).
  • Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.
  • Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.
  • Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.
  • Work accurately and pay attention to safety.
  • Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.
  • Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

jobs.description:
🍕 Join Our Team at Panzanella – Now Hiring Pizzaiolo / Chef ! 👨‍🍳🇮🇹

Panzanella Pizzeria, a casual fine dining restaurant located in Stavanger, is seeking a talented pizzaiolo to join our kitchen team. We will have a 2 week trial period and if everything goes well we will offer the full-time (100%) position, starting ASAP. Our restaurant is dedicated to serving authentic Italian cuisine, and we view pizza as an art form, crafted with care to deliver an exceptional experience.

🔍 What We Look For A passion for Italian cuisine and pizza-making Someone that can handle the hot section and not just Pizza. As we make ragu etc from scratch Strong understanding of traditional cooking methods Ability to work efficiently in a high-paced kitchen Excellent teamwork and communication skills Experience in a professional kitchen environment is a plus Fluency in Norwegian or English

Responsibilities: Prepare and bake Rome style pizza of pizza using high-quality ingredients Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in line with food safety standards Manage dough preparation, including mixing, kneading, and shaping Create new pizza recipes and contribute to menu development Ensure consistent presentation and flavor profiles for every dish Collaborate with the kitchen team to ensure smooth operations during service

What We Offer: Competitive salary based on experience A respectful and collaborative work environment Opportunities for professional development and career advancement A chance to work with high-quality ingredients and authentic Italian recipes

Panzanella Pizzeria is a casual fine dining restaurant located in Stavanger, Norway, dedicated to serving authentic Italian cuisine. The establishment reflects a commitment to traditional cooking methods, emphasizing high-quality ingredients and rich flavors. At Panzanella, pizza is viewed as an art form, crafted carefully to ensure that each bite delivers an unparalleled experience. The core mission of Panzanella is to bring the true tastes of Italy to local patrons while creating a welcoming atmosphere that fosters community. The restaurant is a space where guests can enjoy delicious meals while building connections with family and friends. Panzanella values its team members and promotes a culture of collaboration and respect. Employees are encouraged to share their ideas and contribute to a positive dining experience for all guests. The restaurant seeks individuals who are passionate about food and customer service, and who are committed to maintaining high standards of quality and hospitality. With its prime location in the heart of Stavanger, Panzanella aims to be a go-to destination for both locals and visitors seeking an authentic Italian dining experience. The restaurant prioritizes creativity, teamwork, and a dedication to excellence, making it an ideal workplace for those looking to grow in the hospitality industry.

jobs.title: Ønsker du å jobbe som fastlege?
jobs.description:
Legekontoret på Vinstra ligger i gangavstand til sentrum med togstasjon, butikker og restauranter. Vinstra ligger tett innpå både Rondane og Gålå med ca. 15- 30 minutters kjøring opp til de ulike fjelldestinasjonene. 

Legekontoret er godt driftet i gruppepraksis og består pr. i dag av 8 fastleger, 1 sykehjemslege og 1 LIS1 lege. Legekontoret har ungt og dynamisk miljø med stor interesse for fagutvikling. I tillegg til leger så består legekontoret av en kompetent og dyktig hjelpepersonellgruppe og det er eget sykepleierkontor 1 dag pr. uke. Vi er opptatt av tverrfaglig samarbeid og helhetlig pasienttilnærming, og våre leger og hjelpepersonell samarbeider godt med øvrige kommunale helsetjenester.

Vi har ledig:

100 % vikariat som lege i tiden fom. 01.12.2026 – 31.08.2027 med mulighet for forlengelse. Listestørrelse 900 pasienter.

100 % vikariat som lege i tiden fom. 01.02.2027 – 31.08.2027. Listestørrelse 600 pasienter.

Vi søker etter engasjerte leger, gjerne med erfaring som fastlege og vikarene må delta i interkommunal legevakt på Lillehammer.

Det kan åpnes opp for at legen kan jobbe 3 dager i uka med fysiske pasientkonsultasjoner, 1 dag med e-konsultasjon/video-konsultasjon og 1 dag med administrativ tid.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Fastlegefunksjon
  • Legevakttjeneste
  • Bidra til utvikling ved legekontoret

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Autorisasjon som lege. Det vises til kompetansekrav iht Forskrift om kompetansekrav for leger i den kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenesten § 3.
  • Spesialist i allmennmedisin.
  • Gode samarbeidsegenskaper og stor arbeidskapasitet er ønskelig.

På grunn av arbeidsoppgavene må søkere kunne kommunisere tilfredsstillende på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Engasjement og interesse for allmennmedisin.
  • God klinisk vurderingsevne.
  • God evne til refleksjon rundt fag og pasientmøter.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter.
  • Evne og vilje til godt samarbeid.
  • Pasientorientert, systematisk og pålitelig arbeidsstil.
  • Interesse for fagutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid.

Personlige egenskaper for stillingen vil tillegges stor vekt.

Er du på utkikk etter nye utfordringer ved en spennende arbeidsplass? Ta gjerne kontakt om det er noe du lurer på og send oss en søknad.

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende og utfordrende stilling i en fremtidsrettet kommune.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

 Forutsetninger / vilkår

  • Politiattest av nyere dato er et krav for stillingen.

Arbeidstakere i Nord-Fron kommune blir ansatt på de vilkårene som til enhver tid fremgår av gjeldende lover, reglement og Hovedtariffavtalen og det blir trukket 2 % av brutto lønn til pensjon.

Arbeidsplassene i Nord-Fron kommune skal preges av mangfold og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile kommunens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn eller etnisk bakgrunn til å søke jobb hos oss.

Unntatt offentlighet må begrunnes
Nord-Fron kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jf. Offentleglova § 11.
Dette betyr at alle søkere oppføres på offentlig søkerliste. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak jf. Offentleglova § 25.

Søknaden sendes
Alle søknader på ledige stillinger skal sendes elektronisk via vårt søkesystem.
Kopi av attester og vitnemål blir etterspurt ved behov.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nord-Fron kommune med byen Vinstra og tettstedene Kvam og Skåbu ligger i Gudbrandsdalen, midt mellom Trondheim og Oslo. Kommunen har ca. 5 700 innbyggere. Nord-Fron skal være det attraktive midtpunktet i Gudbrandsdalen og våre verdier er: SYNLIG: Gjennom åpen og aktiv tilstedeværelse viser vi hva vi står for. Vi engasjerer oss i lokalsamfunnet og Nord-Fron kommune lytter til innbyggernes behov og jobber åpent for å skape tillit og forståelse for våre beslutninger og tjenester. SAMLENDE: Vi jobber sammen for å utvikle samfunnet vårt. Vi er stolte av vår historie, kultur, natur og samfunn. Gjennom inkludering, samarbeid og fellesskap bygger vi sterke relasjoner og fremmer en kultur der alle føler seg verdsatt og hørt. Vi tror på kraften i å stå sammen og jobbe mot felles bærekraftige mål. SOLID: Vi er trygge, bærekraftige og pålitelige. Vi bygger et inkluderende samfunn basert på gjensidig respekt, langsiktig planlegging og effektiv ressursforvaltning. Dette sikrer trygghet og livskvalitet for alle innbyggere.

jobs.title: EMPREGADO DE MESA
jobs.description:
O empregado de mesa é o profissional responsável por assegurar todo o serviço de refeições e bebidas num estabelecimento de restauração. As suas funções começam antes da chegada dos clientes, com a preparação da sala e a realização da mise-en-place, o que inclui a limpeza, arrumação e montagem correta das mesas com toalhas, talheres, copos e pratos.
Durante o serviço, este profissional executa o acolhimento e encaminhamento dos clientes, apresentando a ementa e a carta de vinhos. Cabe-lhe aconselhar os clientes, fazer sugestões gastronómicas e registar os pedidos, transmitindo-os de forma clara à cozinha e ao bar. Posteriormente, realiza o serviço de alimentos e bebidas seguindo as técnicas apropriadas, garantindo que o ritmo da refeição é o ideal e respondendo com eficácia a qualquer necessidade ou solicitação adicional que surja ao longo da refeição.
No final, o empregado de mesa faz o desembaraço das mesas, efetua o fecho das contas e o processamento dos pagamentos, e despede-se dos clientes com cortesia. Por fim, participa nas tarefas de higienização do espaço e dos utensílios, arrumação da sala e reposição de stocks para os turnos seguintes, cumprindo sempre rigorosamente as normas de segurança, saúde e higiene alimentar.

jobs.title: Timvikarier Personlig assistans och korttidsverksamhet
jobs.description:
Välkommen till Askersund! Hos oss får du alla fördelarna med att arbeta i en liten kommun. Här värdesätter vi skapandet av nära relationer, modet att påverka och det engagemang som genomsyrar vårt arbete. Vi har jobb som märks och tillsammans gör vi skillnad varje dag, alla på olika sätt men alltid med kommunens invånare i fokus.

I Askersunds kommun tillämpas individuell och differentierad lönesättning i enlighet med centrala löneavtal (HÖK). Vi omfattas även av kollektivavtalet Allmänna bestämmelser (AB) som garanterar villkor och avtalsenliga ersättningar.

Socialförvaltningen i Askersunds kommun ansvarar för äldreomsorg, LSS- och omsorgsverksamheten, socialpsykiatri, verksamhet för ensamkommande flyktingbarn samt individ- och familjeomsorg.

3 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Nu söker vi timvikarier med ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor till våra verksamheter inom personlig assistans och korttidsverksamhet.

I alla våra verksamheter är din huvuduppgift att få andra att må bra. Det gör du genom sociala aktiviteter, att ge stöd i vardagssysslor samt vård och omsorg. Du får mycket uppskattning tillbaka, en känsla som får dig att må bra!

Som personlig assistent är du ett nära stöd i vardagen. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar och kan innefatta personlig omvårdnad, hjälp vid måltider, medicinska insatser enligt delegering, hushållssysslor, inköp, fritidsaktiviteter, träning och kommunikation. Arbetet kräver personlig mognad, ansvarstagande och god samarbetsförmåga med omsorgstagaren, anhöriga och andra i nätverket runt individen. Ensamarbete kan förekomma

Korttidsverksamheten riktar sig till barn och ungdomar 0-21 år. Här bidrar du till en trygg och stimulerande miljö som ger möjlighet till rekreation, personlig utveckling och social gemenskap, samtidigt som insatsen fungerar som avlastning för vårdnadshavare.

Arbetsuppgifter

* Ge personlig vård och omsorg utifrån den enskildes individuella behov.  

* Arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar i ditt uppdrag utifrån din profession.

* Dokumentera  i våra verksamhetssystem.

* Samverka i arbetsgruppen och tillsammans med övriga professioner.

* Arbeta utifrån ett rehabiliterande och personcentrerat förhållningssätt och ta vara på brukarens egna förmågor.

* Utföra hälso- och sjukvårdsuppgifter enligt ordination eller instruktion och utifrån delegering såsom medicinska, rehabiliterande och habiliterande insatser samt läkemedelshantering.

KVALIFIKATIONER
- Vi söker dig som är trygg, engagerad och har erfarenhet av vårdarbete med driv och framåtanda som vill vara med och ge brukarna en trygg vardag.

- Du ska vara 18 år eller äldre och gärna ha relevant utbildning.

- Du ska ha ett genuint intresse för att arbeta med människor, att göra skillnad för brukarna är något som ska vara viktigt för dig.

- Du är lyhörd och har ett gott bemötande både avseende omsorgstagare, närstående samt övrig personal.

- Du har en vilja att lära nytt, tar ansvar och har en förmåga att snabbt kunna ställa om vid förändringar i verksamheten.

- Du behöver behärska det svenska språket, skriftligt och muntligt, då svenska är det gemensamma arbetsspråket på arbetsplatsen. Många av dina arbetsuppgifter handlar om att kunna ta emot instruktioner och föra information vidare på ett korrekt och tydligt sätt. Du kommer att få samarbeta och kommunicera med människor med olika språkliga bakgrund och du förväntas bidra med din erfarenhet och din kompetens på ett positivt samt konstruktivt sätt.

- Du bör ha god datavana.

- Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du har förmåga att arbeta i team och att du har ett gott bemötande mot omsorgstagare, närstående, arbetskamrater, andra yrkesprofessioner och arbetsledning.

- Arbetet kan delvis upplevas både fysisk och psykiskt påfrestande, vilket gör att arbetet kräver god grundfysik och i övrigt god hälsa.

Önskvärt att du har B-körkort.

Stor vikt fästes vid personlig lämplighet.

Ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska visas upp av den som erbjuds anställning hos oss.

Löneform: Timlön.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.

Askersunds kommun - vår pärla vid Sveriges hemligaste skärgård. Askersund är en plats där historisk skönhet möter naturens vilda underverk. Inte att förglömma vår unika skärgård som är en skatt som bara väntar på att utforskas.

Det som gör Askersunds kommun ännu mer speciell är dess invånare! 11 500 starka individer som kallar denna plats sitt hem, och vi är stolta över att vara deras gemenskap. Vi är något över 1 000 medarbetare som arbetar tillsammans för att se till att vår kommun fortsätter att blomstra.

Vi välkomnar och värdesätter olikheter och ser till att vår arbetsplats är öppen för alla. Vår vision är att Askersunds kommun ska vara en plats där det är attraktivt att leva och hållbart bo och verka i. Vi ska bidra till våra invånares möjligheter att ha en bra vardag. Kom och bli en del av vår gemenskap och låt oss tillsammans fortsätta att bygga en plats vi är stolta över att kalla hemma med lust, mod och engagemang.

Vi känner oss stolta över vårt Askersund! Besök gärna: https://www.visitaskersund.se/

Observera att vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

  • Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

  • Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

  • Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

About You

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

  • You can do 2 or more of the following:

  • Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

  • Develop and deploy NLP solutions

  • Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

  • Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

  • You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

  • You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

  • You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

  • You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at
