jobs.title: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.

What You’ll Do

- Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures
- Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, high-voltage insulation (creepage/clearance), IP67+ sealing, EMI, shock/vibration, and long-term environmental reliability
- Lead track: Serve as technical owner of a product line, mentor 3–4+ engineers, lead and approve design reviews, and enforce technical rigor and schedule discipline
- Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR, and DFMEA where it matters
- Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products, not afterthoughts
- Partner with electrical, systems, reliability, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance teams, and design against UL / IEC / GB standards through to certification
- Drive prototypes into reality: builds, test support, characterization, design verification, and root-cause analysis of failures
- Release for production in CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE: 3D models, 2D drawings with GD&T, PLM / ECOs / BOMs, and supplier collaboration for automated manufacturing at thousands of units per week

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master’s degree preferred for senior/ staff/ lead level
- Strong mechanical fundamentals and a physics-based, first-principles approach to structural and thermal problems
- Proven product design ownership from concept to scaled production (portfolio preferred)
- Lead track: 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including 2+ years of design leadership
- Fluency in CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume processes (molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)
- Ability to run, or critically review, thermal / CFD / structural analysis, plus working knowledge of power electronics components (PCBAs, MOSFETs, inductors, transformers)
- Detail-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Highly valued:
- Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules
- Experience designing against certification standards (UL, IEC, GB) and obtaining certificates
- Multiphysics intuition: heat transfer, fluids, mechanics, and materials (magnetics a strong plus)
- MATLAB / Python for data reduction, scripting, or reduced-order thermal models
- PLM / change control / BOM discipline in a fast-moving product environment
- Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slide

jobs.title: Recruiter - Engineering and Robotics (Recruiter/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla's EMEA Recruiting team is seeking an Engineering Recruiter to join us in Berlin. In this role, you'll drive hiring for diverse technical teams, across Engineering and Robotics, fuelling our most complex and high-impact Optimus projects, without being confined to a single job family or skillset. We're looking for a proven expert in technical recruiting who can source, engage, and evaluate EMEA's top engineering talent, while building and owning relationships with our senior leadership. Beyond hiring, you'll elevate the team by mentoring junior recruiters, modelling best practices, and leading initiatives to refine our processes and workflows. Ideal candidates are data-driven problem-solvers who thrive in ambiguity, apply strong project management skills, and innovate creative solutions to recruitment challenges. One hire at a time, you'll help assemble the talent revolutionizing energy and transportation, accelerating our path to a sustainable future and shaping the systems and products that power our employees' and customers' daily lives.

What You’ll Do

- Collaborate closely with hiring managers to evaluate talent needs, deliver expert guidance on hiring strategies, and own the end-to-end recruitment cycle for high-stakes technical roles.
- Establish and manage realistic recruiting timelines, proactively identifying risks and implementing solutions to keep processes on track and efficient.
- Leverage data analytics to evaluate candidate pipelines, measure recruitment performance, analyse talent market trends, and deliver insightful weekly reports to management and stakeholders.
- Continuously monitor and optimize the recruiting funnel, deploying innovative techniques to source, attract, and engage high-quality passive and active talent across EMEA, ensuring a steady flow of top-tier candidates.
- Lead in-depth behavioural interviews and phone screens to rigorously assess technical expertise and cultural fit within Tesla's fast-paced, mission-driven environment.
- Guide hiring managers in designing effective interview processes, including structuring panels, defining evaluation criteria, and ensuring alignment with role requirements.
- Prioritize a high-quality candidate experience at every touchpoint, continuously identifying ways to streamline processes and enhance overall satisfaction.
- Go above and beyond core recruiting duties by leading long-term projects to enhance team capabilities, while flexibly supporting urgent, high-priority hiring needs across other areas or functions as required.

What You’ll Bring

- Demonstrated excellence in sourcing, assessing, and hiring top-tier engineering talent, ideally within the automotive or related high-tech industries.
- Proven expertise in managing relationships with hiring teams and business partners, leading talent needs assessments, and developing effective hiring plans.
- Genuine passion for recruiting as a craft, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional growth in a dynamic role.
- Digitally savvy, with the ability to quickly adopt and adapt to new technologies, systems, and tools to drive recruitment efficiency.
- Comfortable working with data in a recruitment context, leveraging analytics to identify root causes, solve problems, and share actionable insights with stakeholders.
- Thrives in an agile, fast-paced environment, adept at pivoting amid rapidly changing priorities, targets, and business needs without losing momentum.
- Skilled in offer negotiations, with solid knowledge of relevant employment legislation and current talent market trends.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, enabling clear, persuasive interactions with candidates, stakeholders, and teams

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr Regulatory Compliance Engineer, Cyber Security (m/w/d) (Produktingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions. What You’ll Do

- Lead all cybersecurity homologation, certification, and testing activities for Energy and Charging products across the EMEA region.
- Develop and execute the compliance strategy for a multitude of upcoming cybersecurity regulations, including the Cyber Resilience Act and delegated acts of the Radio Equipment Directive (RED).

- Plan, coordinate, and execute vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities to proactively identify and mitigate security risks in our products.
- Translate complex cybersecurity standards (e.g., EN 18031, ETSI EN 303 645) into actionable design and testing requirements for hardware and software engineering teams.
- Manage relationships with third-party labs and certification bodies for all cybersecurity-related testing and approvals.
- Proactively monitor the global threat landscape and evolving regulations to inform product development and ensure a long-term, sustainable compliance strategy.

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in a product cybersecurity, compliance, or homologation role.
- Expert-level knowledge of cybersecurity principles and standards applicable to IoT or connected industrial products, such as IEC 62443, ETSI EN 303 645, and familiarity with foundational cryptographic standards like the ISO/EN 18031 series.
- Deep, practical understanding of emerging European cybersecurity legislation, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and relevant articles of the Radio Equipment Directive (RED).
- Hands-on experience with security assessment tools and methodologies, including vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and threat modeling.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Advisor / Kundenberater Inside Sales  (m/w/d) – Berlin (Verkaufsberater/in)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

In dieser Rolle als Inside Sales Advisor / Sales Operations Advisor / Sales Support Advisor betreust du Kunden und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Verkaufsprozess. Als erste Anlaufstelle in unseren digitalen Vertriebskanälen gewährleistest du ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis und teilst dein Fachwissen über Tesla-Produkte. Du begleitest virtuelle Testfahrten, organisierst die Fahrzeugflotte für Remote Test Drives und koordinierst die Übergabe an das Virtual Sales Team oder lokale Standorte. Zudem übernimmst du administrative Aufgaben rund um Fahrzeugbestellungen, einschließlich Stornierungen und Exporten. Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Team und unterstützt deutschlandweit bei Fahrzeuganfragen. Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist sind entscheidend. Virtuelle Kommunikation per Telefon, Chat und E-Mail gehört zu deinem Alltag, während du gemeinsam mit dem Team individuelle und gemeinsame Vertriebsziele erreichst.

Wir bieten



- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings)
- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen
- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten
- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Monatsgehalt sowie die Option auf eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket umfasst  
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet

Was zu tun ist

- Kundenbetreuung und administrative Unterstützung: Die schnelle und konkrete Beantwortung aller eingehenden Kundenanfragen über alle virtuellen Kanäle (einschließlich Anrufe, E-Mails, SMS, Chat, andere virtuelle Beratungen usw.) und Deeskalation bei kritischen Anfragen ist dir ein wichtiges Anliegen. Du begleitest Kunden bei der Nutzung von Remote Test Drives und kümmerst dich um die gesamte Verwaltung der Flotte (z.B. Öffnungszeiten der Standorte, Anpassung der Flottenausfälle, Fahrzeugüberwachung bei Unfällen)
- Umsetzung von Fahrzeugbestellung-Stornierungen: Du überprüfst und setzt Stornierungen von Fahrzeugbestellungen für den deutschen Markt um. Dies beinhaltet auch die Einleitung von Erstattungen
- Unterstützung beim Export- und Mehrwertsteuerfreie Prozesse: Du überprüfst und unterstützt bei der Abwicklung von VAT-free Bestellungen und arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Kunden zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Fahrzeuge korrekt für den Export verkauft werden
- Request-Management: Du bearbeitest alle eingehenden Kundenanfragen über unsere Website (Probefahrten, Rückrufwünsche, Inzahlungnahmen) und unterstützt lokale Standorte bei Bedarf
- Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstansprache aller Web Sales Opportunities in Deutschland. Dabei übernimmst du den ersten Kontakt mit potenziellen Kund:innen, sicherst einen professionellen und überzeugenden ersten Eindruck und leitest die nächsten Schritte im Verkaufsprozess ein  
- Zudem unterstützt du die Stores beim Erstkontakt von Event Sales Opportunities. Hierbei sorgst du dafür, dass Interessent: innen schnell und kompetent betreut werden und trägst aktiv zum Erfolg von Events  
- Darüber hinaus nimmst du an zielgerichteten Call-Kampagnen teil, mit dem Fokus auf Leasings Verlängerungen. Dabei begleitest du Kundinnen im Entscheidungsprozess, stärkst die Kundenbindung und trägst zur langfristigen Kundenzufriedenheit bei

Was mitzubringen ist

- Berufserfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Inside Sales, Sales Support oder einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem digitalen Vertriebsumfeld mit und kennst die Herausforderung, in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld zu arbeiten
- Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist in der Lage, sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch sicher zu kommunizieren, um mit Kunden aus dem internationalen Bereich (z.B. beim VAT-free Processing) professionell umzugehen
- Organisationsgeschick: Deine strukturierten Arbeitsmethoden und deine Fähigkeit zur richtigen Prioritätensetzung machen dich zu einem echten Organisationstalent
- Proaktives Handeln: Du bist eigeninitiativ und zeigst eine hohe Problemlösungsfähigkeit und hohe Serviceorientierung. Bei Schwierigkeiten gehst du direkt auf die Lösung zu und bist stets bereit, dich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen
- Technische Kenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit modernen CRM-Tools und bist sicher im digitalen Arbeitsumfeld
- Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Dies können auch Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (innerhalb: Montag bis Samstag, 8-19 Uhr)

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Stelle haben die gleiche Chance unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Orientierung, Alter, Herkunftsland, Behinderung, Veteranenschutzstatus, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen Faktoren, die durch die geltenden US-, bundesstaatlichen oder örtlichen Gesetze geschützt sind.

jobs.title: Digital Sales Advisor - German Speaking (m/w/d) – Berlin (Fachverkäufer/in - Kraftfahrzeuge)
jobs.description:

Tesla is on a mission to build a world of amazing abundance. With record-breaking growth over the years, the Ownership & Loyalty Advisor team is looking to expand to grow our customers’ renewals. Our current owners are the best advocate of the Tesla story and a key part of achieving our goal & mission. Keeping them engaged, satisfied & retained is therefore critical to us.As an Ownership & Loyalty Advisor, you will be the trusted voice that keeps this community engaged, inspired, and coming back. You won’t just be managing a sales pipeline; you will be building lasting relationships, turning every conversation into a connection and every connection into a lifelong Tesla Owner.

What You’ll Do

- Own your sales pipeline: Activate, enrich & convert a robust sales opportunities pipeline by conducting regular engagement activities with existing owners. Guide them through sales process, including financing, trade-ins and delivery expectations, each one as an opportunity to re-ignite passion for Tesla
- Act as a central & trusted Tesla point of contact for current owners with various level of maturity in their renewal journey. Understand their uniqueness to propose a tailored renewal solution
- Plan & maximize: the output of each day by leveraging omni-channel communication (phone, emails, live chat and others) to secure timely, accurate & customized follow-ups maximizing our renewal rates
- Achieve targets: Actively contribute to the achievement of sales & delivery goals by meeting and exceeding renewal & retention rate targets. Your success will be measurable, visible & celebrated
- Constructive feedback: As a frontline representative interacting with our customers all day, you will pass on valuable inputs to improve products, processes, and the entire customer renewal experience
- Collaboration: with delivery, store & HQ teams to ensure seamless test drives, customer handovers, proactive pre-delivery support, accurate contract and financing information processing, and more!    
- Master industry trends and best practices: including utilization of new technology, web resources and competition landscape to delivery world-class experience

What You’ll Bring

- Passion for Tesla's mission and products, and a desire to share this with others
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build rapport with customers across multiple channels (phone, email, chat)
- The ability to explain complex topics to customers in simple terms
- Focus on educating and understanding customers' needs, with a natural ability to turn conversations into lasting relationships
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, and prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Valid Driver License

jobs.title: (Senior) Controls Engineer - Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Note: We are considering several seniority levels, from recent graduates to experienced engineers. Title and scope will match your experience.At Tesla Engineering Germany GmbH in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions.This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities to create technologies that shape how energy systems evolve. You get to work on advancing power electronics used for Tesla products globally, thereby directly contributing to the acceleration of the world's transition to sustainable energy.

What You’ll Do

- Design, implement, and validate control algorithms for high-power AC/DC and DC/DC converters across energy and automotive products, with a focus on stability, dynamic performance, and robustness
- Develop real-time embedded firmware, mainly in C, including control loops, protection, and state machines
- Model and simulate converter dynamics (MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS or similar) and validate control strategies using hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) systems
- Do hands-on bring-up, testing, and debugging of control firmware on prototype and production hardware
- Work with hardware, systems, and test teams to define requirements and performance targets, choose circuit and control architectures, and integrate algorithms into the firmware framework
- Support manufacturing with test firmware and technical support at internal and external sites
- Support fleet deployment by analyzing field data, diagnosing issues, and delivering firmware updates
- Senior level: own control architecture decisions, lead design reviews, and mentor junior engineers

What You’ll Bring

- BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with a strong foundation in control theory and power electronics
- Solid C programming skills for embedded systems
- Understanding of switched-mode power converters and feedback control, from industry, research, a thesis, or hands-on projects
- Hands-on experience with hardware, such as lab work, prototyping, or debugging with oscilloscopes and debuggersAdditional qualifications for the senior level
- 5+ years of experience developing real-time embedded control for power electronics (3+ with a PhD)
- Strong experience modeling and controlling resonant converters (e.g. LLC, CLLC, DAB), including small-signal modeling and frequency- or phase-shift-based control
- Solid digital control background: discrete-time design, discretization, and the effects of sampling and delay
- A track record of taking products from prototype to productionPreferred qualifications
- Experience with resonant converter topologies, including coursework or thesis work
- Experience with TI C2000 (or equivalent) MCU peripherals: high-resolution PWM, ADC, comparators, CAN/ETH
- Experience with grid-connected converters (PFC, grid synchronization) and related standards (grid codes, EMC, functional safety)
- Experience with HiL platforms (e.g. Typhoon, OPAL-RT, Speedgoat)

jobs.title: (Senior) Electronics Failure Analysis Engineer, Energy (m/f/d) (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Failure Analysis Team’s mission is to determine root cause and contributing factors to improve the experience of Tesla’s Energy Products by reducing field issues, in collaboration with large cross-section of other engineering teams. Engineers and Technicians on the team are responsible for a wide variety Energy Product system like Powerwall, Megapack and Supercharger. This is an individual contributor role with great internal visibility role that requires extensive hands-on work focused on failure analysis and root cause activities. We are seeking a multi-faceted individual who will be responsible for all aspects of identifying, analyzing, root causing, implementing countermeasures, and reporting on issues effecting systems including power electronics, low voltage, and battery systems among others. To be effective in this role, the engineer will need to be intimately familiar with the detailed behavior of these electro-mechanical components and the tools and equipment used in their design and manufacture.  He/She will work with other Engineering teams to root cause and implement countermeasures of field issues to improve quality, reliability, durability of the products.  Tesla offers the opportunity to work on industry leading products and bleeding edge technology in a fast paced, dynamic, and high visibility role.

What You’ll Do

- Drive issue resolution from root cause analysis to countermeasure implementation on electromechanical components from Tesla’s Energy Products
- Investigate system assemblies, modules, components to identify root cause of failure in Tesla’s Energy products
- Design and conduct fault replication tests experiments on power converters and low voltage PCBA's including board rework and FW/HW testing
- Collaborate with appropriate engineers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers to drive resolution to the identified failure causes
- Provide inputs to design and manufacturing teams to improve design and production yield. Can be achieved through lessons learnt, product teardowns etc. helping to identify risks
- Support design reviews and DFMEAs based on prior failure experience
- Candidate should be detail oriented, and excellent communication skills

What You’ll Bring

- BS/MS Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience
- Strong demonstrable experience in Power Electronics/power converter circuits for energy storage/automotive applications
- Electrical/Electronic design experience a strong plus
- Strong demonstrable hands-on experience with electrical test equipment: Power Supplies, Multimeter, Oscilloscopes, and other common equipment
- Strong & demonstratable focus on adhering to Lab safety practices
- Extremely proficient at reading schematics and troubleshooting analog and digital circuits
- Familiarity with or willingness to learn the different failure analysis techniques including 2D and 3D X-Ray, Cross Sectioning, FTIR, DSC, SEM, and FLIR Thermography
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills required
- Experience with hand tools, basic power tools, soldering, and instrumentation is desirable

jobs.title: Tesla Service / Sales erleben – Wien Floridsdorf 09.10.2026 (Kraftfahrzeugservicemechaniker/in)

Du liebst Fahrzeuge & neueste Technologien – wir auch.
Sei bei unserer Eröffnung dabei – lerne Tesla, das Team & deine Karrieremöglichkeiten kennen.Wir eröffnen unseren neuen Standort und laden dich ein: Komm vorbei, triff Recruiter und unser Team vor Ort, erfahre mehr zu unseren offenen Stellen (Service & Sales), und erlebe Tesla hautnah – inklusive Probefahrt.

Einfach mit deinem Lebenslauf anmelden, die offizielle Einladung erhalten & dabei sein.Wo und Wann?

- Datum: Freitag, 9. Oktober 2026
- Uhrzeit: 15:00 Uhr
- Ort & Adresse: Alle Details erhältst du mit der offiziellen Einladungs-E-Mail (die Teilnehmerzahl ist begrenzt)

Was zu tun ist

Was dich erwartet:

- Einblick in die Tesla-Welt & deine Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns
- Direkter Austausch mit Recruiter:innen & unserem Team vor Ort
- Infos zu offenen Positionen als KFZ-Mechatroniker:in / Service Techniker:in & im Sales
- Tesla Probefahrt
- Du bist direkt bei der Eröffnung dabei

Was mitzubringen ist

- Service Techniker:in mit abgeschlossener Lehre (z.B. KFZ-Mechatroniker:in, Automechaniker:in, Diagnosetechniker:in) – alle Erfahrungslevel

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager (f/m/d) (Controller/in)
jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Location: Erlangen, Nürnberg, Mühlheim, Hamburg, Berlin, Lisbon, Bucharest, Warsaw

Department: SE FIN TI BC

Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management ÜT-Kreis

Mode of Employment: Full Time or Part Time / Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day

For the first 18-24 months this role has one clear focus: accompanying the carve-out of Transformation of Industry and supporting preparations for a potential future FP&A organization, hand in hand with the management team. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin.
At the moment, the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is preparing to evolve towards a potential Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, which could bring together more than 100 finance professionals. Its possible target organization, processes and reporting architecture are still being explored, and you will contribute to this work. You report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside the management team. The role asks you to hold two hats at once: you coordinate and organize the transformation centrally, the way a program office does, and at the same time you go deep into the content - preparing and challenging the decisions yourself and then carrying them into the organization.
A potential new team - the Center of Excellence - may grow out of this work: as the future organization develops, you help prepare a dedicated team that could bundle cross-cutting topics across the different FP&A teams, including standardized data and reporting, shared tools and systems, automation, process improvement and AI. Subject to the future setup and related decisions, the role may offer a path toward taking on team leadership responsibility for this unit.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Support the carve-out of Transformation of Industry from an FP&A perspective, including organizational and process changes, standalone company requirements, and Day 1 FP&A readiness
* Help prepare the potential future FP&A organization together with its management team, including target structures, roles and responsibilities, job profiles, and related training and reskilling needs
* Support the Vice President of FP&A in the daily business by preparing presentations, analyses, and decision-making materials for leadership and board audiences
* Improve the core FP&A processes together with the management team across planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting by turning best practices into common standards
* Take care of communication into the teams by explaining the why, keeping everyone informed, gathering input early, and making people part of the change journey
* Help develop the concept for a potential Center of Excellence within the future FP&A organization, including scope, services, operating model, staffing, roadmap, and the opportunity to potentially grow into a team leadership role

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Business Informatics, or a related field
* Longstanding experience in Controlling, FP&A, Finance Transformation, or Consulting, with the curiosity to grow into a carve-out environment
* An interest in organizational design, including roles, responsibilities, and interfaces, with the confidence to contribute ideas to a management team
* A solid understanding of planning, forecasting, closing, and reporting, along with strong Excel and reporting tool skills and curiosity about AI and automation
* Excellent communication and change management skills, combined with the energy, structure, and drive to build something new in an evolving environment
* Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

You do not need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

This position is newly created, and that is the whole point of it. Transformation of Industry does not yet have a dedicated Function Controlling — you are the person who builds it, for a functional cost base estimated at more than €600 million. You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.
You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team supports you closely on top of that, so you can build on proven methods and standards rather than invent everything yourself.
The timing makes the task unusually rewarding. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. A standalone company needs its own function cost transparency from day one — and few finance leaders get the chance to shape a controlling discipline that does not exist yet, with experienced colleagues behind them, for a company that is coming into existence around them.
Your second role is that of Finance Business Partner to the corporate functions — IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement and Finance among them. You are the financial counterpart their leaders turn to, and just as importantly you develop your own people into that role: a function controller who only reports numbers is not yet a business partner, and getting the team there is one of your central tasks.
You are joining the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry at a moment when it is preparing to evolve towards a Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, potentially bringing together more than 100 finance professionals. The future setup is still being explored, and the people who join now can contribute to shaping it. In this position, you report directly to the Vice President of FP&A and work alongside your peers in the FP&A management team.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Build the Function Controlling discipline for Transformation of Industry from the ground up, including the operating model, scope, governance, interfaces, and organizational structures, with the support of Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team
* Lead the financial performance management of functional cost centers across monthly closings, forecasts, and budgets
* Act as Finance Business Partner to IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement, and Finance by analyzing cost and manpower drivers and translating them into actionable business insights
* Establish standalone function cost transparency, including separation effects, the target cost base, and the steering logic replacing group allocations
* Design standardized and automated controlling processes and dashboards that provide real-time visibility into function costs and manpower utilization, leveraging AI where it adds value

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in Financial Controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex international environment.
* Proven leadership in building, coaching, and developing finance teams, ideally including the setup or transformation of a finance function and the development of business partnering capabilities.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and support business decision-making.
* Excellent knowledge of SAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and process optimization, combined with a structured hands-on approach in ambiguous environments.
* Fluent in English, German is an advantage  

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

You do not need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we would like to hear from you.

Was zu tun ist

- Kundenbetreuung und administrative Unterstützung: Die schnelle und konkrete Beantwortung aller eingehenden Kundenanfragen über alle virtuellen Kanäle (einschließlich Anrufe, E-Mails, SMS, Chat, andere virtuelle Beratungen usw.) und Deeskalation bei kritischen Anfragen ist dir ein wichtiges Anliegen. - Du bist verantwortlich für die Erstansprache aller Web Sales Opportunities in Deutschland. Dabei übernimmst du den ersten Kontakt mit potenziellen Kund:innen, sicherst einen professionellen und überzeugenden ersten Eindruck und leitest die nächsten Schritte im Verkaufsprozess ein

Was mitzubringen ist

- Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen.
Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von EUR 48.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Field Quality team’s mission is to improve customer experience of Tesla products by reducing field issues. The role is responsible for our charging product portfolio including, but not limited to Super & Mega charger, Optimus Charging and Wall connector and works cross functionally with other engineering and service teams. We are seeking a multi-faceted engineer who will be responsible for all aspects of identifying, analyzing, root causing, implementing countermeasures, and reporting on issues affecting products. To be effective, the Field Quality engineer will need to be intimately familiar with the detailed behavior of our Energy Products and the tools and equipment used in their design and manufacture.  They will work with other engineering teams to quickly mitigate and implement countermeasures of field issues to improve quality, reliability, and durability of the products.

What You’ll Do

- Monitor products field performance, identify trending issues.  Prioritize based on severity, occurrence, and/or cost of each failure mode
- Triage emerging trends and use engineering first principals to come up with failure hypothesis
- Coordinate efforts with the Failure Analysis team to identify root causes of problems
- Apply knowledge of mechanical, electrical engineering and PCBA manufacturing to drive containment and corrective action implementation into production / design / supplier / Firmware
- Communicate field performance of the engineering system, gather buy-in from engineering leadership on improvement priorities and urgency
- Drive continuous improvement in design and performance by providing direct and accurate feedback to design owners
- Share Lessons Learned from previous field issues; Provide upfront feedback by participating in design reviews to ensure product performance, reliability, and manufacturability issues are identified and risks mitigated (DFMEAs)
- Take part in ongoing optimization of the products and processes (performance, cost, technology)

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline or equivalent experience
- 2+ years of hands-on experience in power electronics hardware design, design validation, hardware testing, mechanical system reliability, or durability testing (including relevant internship or academic lab work experience)
- Ability/experience to navigate existing software/firmware tools and logs to identify and label failure modes encountered
- The successful candidate for this position must have a broad engineering background with the ability to work with design engineering, manufacturing, service, and suppliers across a wide variety of issues
- Exceptional problem solving and Failure Analysis, strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills are an absolute requirement to establish effective working relationships within Tesla and outside
- Ability to use tools and business system applications to manage, synthesize, and interpret data
- Preferred: Experience with inverters, EV batteries, HV controls, and/or industrial grid codes
- Preferred: Experience working with DC Fast charging systems/features (e.g. high-voltage DC busses, DC isolation monitoring, grid-tied systems, network diagnostics, CAN communication, PLC, Modbus, TCP/IP protocols, etc.)

Tesla is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and experienced attorney to support, collaborate with, and guide business partners at its Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg and the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region on environmental and occupational health and safety (EHS) legal compliance and enforcement matters applicable to automobile manufacturing, service & delivery, lithium refining and battery development, renewable energy products, and sustainable recycling programs for end-of-life product disposal.You must be ready to put on steel-toed boots and traverse our facilities to learn the business and help support operations on EHS legal matters. jobs.title: Senior Manager Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility (m/f/d) (Fachkaufmann/-frau - Personal)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As Senior Manager Global Mobility (m/f/d) you are accountable for the strategic design, governance, and operational excellence of the company's global mobility programs in alignment with the VPCBM. This role provides expert leadership across international assignments, permanent transfers, short-term assignments, localization, and cross-border employment models ensuring compliance with tax, immigration, social security and labor law of both home, and host countries.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Regional Compensation Management

- Lead the execution of regional compensation strategies in alignment with global compensation frameworks.
- Manage annual compensation cycles, including salary planning, merit increases, promotions, bonus programs, and market adjustments.
- Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on compensation decisions related to hiring, internal movement, retention, and workforce planning.
- Conduct job evaluations and support job architecture governance within the regions.
- Monitor market trends and benchmarking data to recommend competitive compensation practices.
- Ensure compensation practices comply with local labor, pay transparency, and wage equity regulations.

Benefits Strategy & Administration

- Manage regional employee benefit team and ensure the programs are aligned with overall Total Rewards objectives.
- Evaluate plan competitiveness, utilization, employee feedback, and cost effectiveness.
- Support benefit renewals, vendor negotiations, cost management initiatives, and employee communications.
- Recommend program enhancements based on market trends and workforce needs.

Mobility Program Management

- Oversee regional mobility team activities including permanent transfers, international assignments, business travelers, localization, and cross-border employment arrangements.
- Ensure guidance to business leaders and HR on appropriate workforce deployment solutions is provided.
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with immigration, tax, payroll, social security, and employment requirements.
- Support assignment cost projections, budgeting, and approval processes.
- Manage complex and sensitive mobility cases, including senior leadership relocations and critical talent deployments.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

- Ensure compensation, benefits, and mobility programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Payroll, Tax, and external advisors to mitigate compliance and financial risks.
- Support internal and external audits and maintain appropriate governance documentation.
- Monitor legislative and regulatory developments impacting Total Rewards programs.
- Escalate risks and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

Analytics, Reporting & Program Effectiveness

- Analyze compensation, benefits, and mobility data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
- Conduct market benchmarking and support regional workforce planning initiatives.
- Develop dashboards, reports, and business cases to support data-driven decision making.
- Measure program effectiveness and recommend process improvements and efficiencies.
- Drive adoption of technology and process standardization across the region.

Managerial Responsibilities

- Lead and develop a regional team of 3 Compensation, Benefits, and/or Mobility professionals.
- Establish team objectives, priorities, and development plans.
- Provide coaching and direction on complex employee and business cases.
- Ensure consistent service delivery and stakeholder satisfaction across the region.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or related field
- Strong knowledge of compensation strategy, job architecture, benchmarking, and incentive programs.
- Knowledge of employee benefits design, administration, and vendor management.
- Understanding of international mobility practices, immigration, tax, social security, and employment regulations.
- Deep knowledge of international tax, immigration, social security, labor law related to international assignments and employment risk concepts.
- Strong financial acumen, including assignment costing, budgeting, and cost governance.
- Ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds.
- Fluent in German with a strong knowledge of German laws essential.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Commodity Manager (f/m/d) CD & NUC, you will shape the sourcing strategy for some of Siemens Energy’s most advanced technology categories, including electronic equipment, controls, digitalization, and nuclear services. Working closely with engineering, quality, and project teams, you will build resilient supplier partnerships, negotiate complex commercial agreements, and ensure a secure, cost-effective supply chain that supports global business growth.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Develop and execute global sourcing and category strategies for electronic equipment, controls, and digital technologies
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic suppliers through market analysis, spend optimization, and cross-functional collaboration
* Build long-term partnerships with key suppliers while driving performance through KPIs, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Lead supplier development programs to strengthen quality, capability, and supply chain resilience in technically complex and regulated environments
* Negotiate complex commercial contracts, including pricing, intellectual property, and long-term service agreements, to maximize value and minimize risk
* Proactively assess supply chain risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity across global procurement activities

What You Bring

Ranging from active health management via flexible working hours and hybrid work all the way to corporate pension plans: everything geared to suit your goals and needs. jobs.title: Sozialpädagog:in / Sozialarbeiter:in als Einrichtungsleitung für Therapeutische Wohnverbünde (m/w/d) (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
jobs.description:
In unseren überregionalen Wohnverbünden erhalten Menschen mit psychischer Erkrankung und Abhängigkeitserkrankung (Substanzkonsumstörungen, Verhaltenssüchte, Substitution) Assistenzleistungen gemäß SGB IX.
Die Wohnverbünde sind Teil eines vielfältigen Angebots an verschiedenen spezialisierten Einrichtungen für Menschen, die Erfahrungen mit psychischen Erkrankungen mit und ohne Abhängigkeitserkrankung gemacht haben.
Zum 01.12.2026 oder früher suchen wir zwei Einrichtungsleitungen für die fünf Standorte der Wohnverbünde "Doppeldiagnose" und "Substitution" mit einem Stellenumfang von jeweils 30-40 Stunden (unbefristet).
Die Einrichtungsleitungen verantworten jeweils einen Teil der Standorte, sollen jedoch in gemeinsamer Verantwortung den gesamten Bereich gestalten und inhaltlich weiterentwickeln.
Der vorrangige Arbeitsplatz ist in unserer Geschäftsstelle in Neukölln. Die Standorte der Einrichtungen befinden sich berlinweit in verschiedenen Bezirken (Mitte, Neukölln, Pankow und Treptow-Köpenick).

Ihre Aufgaben:

- fachliche und personelle Leitung und Weiterentwicklung der Teams, zum Teil mit Teamleitung am Standort, einschließlich Personalverantwortung
- Sicherstellung des Qualitätsstandards und Unterstützung bei Kriseninterventionen
- Belegungssteuerung und Budgetverantwortung
- Teilnahme an Leitungsteam, -supervision, Leitungsklausurtagen, internen/externen Gremien
- Mitarbeit bei der strategischen Ausrichtung des Trägers und des Trägerverbundes

Wir wünschen uns von Ihnen:

- Berufsabschluss als Sozialpädagog:in oder Sozialarbeiter:in
- fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich der Eingliederungshilfe, der Suchthilfe und des Betreuten Wohnens sowie in der Arbeit mit psychisch erkrankten Menschen
- Leitungserfahrung im sozialwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsfeld
- Interesse an Vernetzung und konzeptioneller Arbeit

Wir bieten Ihnen:

- Vergütung nach Haustarif in Anlehnung an TV-L SuE 2025, S18
- arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach der Probezeit in Höhe von 4,6% des monatlichen Bruttogehaltes und Kinderzuschlag
- Zuschuss zum Firmenticket nach der Probezeit: „Deutschlandticket Job“ für 40,30€/Monat statt 63€
- regelmäßige Fortbildungen und Fortbildungsgutscheine für die neuhland-Akademie
- 31 Tage Urlaub
- strukturierte Einarbeitung mit fester Ansprechperson
- monatliche Supervision im Leitungsteam
- ein abwechslungsreiches und gestaltbares Aufgabenfeld in einem unterstützenden und erfahrenen Arbeitsumfeld

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!
Ihre Ansprechpersonen:
Ulrike Hörrmann-Lecher (Geschäftsführung)
Angelika Ingendorf (Geschäftsführung)
Wir sind ein weltoffener und diverser Träger. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit vielseitigen Erfahrungshintergründen!

jobs.title: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Apply at: https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/job/284669?source=BA

jobs.title: Commercial Project Manager / Project Controller (f/m/d) for Germany (Vertriebscontroller/in)
jobs.employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Project Controller / Commercial Project Manager (f/m/d), you will be the financial lead for a portfolio of complex real estate construction projects within Siemens Energy. Acting as the trusted finance business partner to the Real Estate Project Management organization, you will oversee budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and investment approvals while ensuring full compliance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Working closely with colleagues from Accounting, Operations, Procurement, Legal, and Real Estate, you will provide transparent financial insights that support strategic decisions and drive successful project delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Lead the commercial execution of a dedicated portfolio of real estate construction projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cost recognition, and financial reporting
* Prepare robust investment approvals by developing business cases, profitability analyses, and discounted cash flow models for strategic construction initiatives
* Establish accurate financial project structures in SAP, including Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), and ensure alignment with approved project budgets and schedules
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accurate project accounting, and full compliance with IFRS and Local GAAP throughout the project lifecycle
* Present clear financial performance reports, highlight cost deviations, and provide actionable recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Finance, Real Estate, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to enable informed commercial decision-making and successful project execution

What You Bring

* A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or Economics; a master's degree or CPA qualification is an advantage
* Longstanding professional experience in Finance, Controlling, or Project Finance, ideally within construction, infrastructure, or capital investment projects
* Strong understanding of Financial Planning & Analysis/Business Case Models in preparation of investment approvals (e.g. proof of profitability & discounted cash flow calculation
* Proven experience managing CAPEX projects, annual budgets, forecasting, free cash flow, depreciation, and financial reporting for complex project portfolios
* Solid knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP, with hands-on experience in PP&E (CAPEX) accounting and strong SAP expertise, ideally across PS, CO, and FI modules
* Business fluent English communication skills

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Account & Business Development Manager SPACE (w/m/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
HENSOLDT ist ein führendes Unternehmen der europäischen Verteidigungsindustrie mit globaler Reichweite.
Das Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Taufkirchen bei München entwickelt Sensor-Komplettlösungen für Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsanwendungen. Als Systemintegrator bietet HENSOLDT plattformunabhängige, vernetzte Komplettlösungen an.
Zugleich treibt das Unternehmen als Technologieführer die Entwicklung der Verteidigungselektronik und Optronik voran und baut sein Portfolio auf der Grundlage innovativer Ansätze für Datenfusion, Künstliche Intelligenz und Cybersicherheit kontinuierlich aus. 2023 erzielte HENSOLDT einen Umsatz von 1,85 Milliarden Euro. Nach der Übernahme der ESG GmbH beschäftigt das Unternehmen circa 8.500 Mitarbeiter. HENSOLDT ist an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im MDAX notiert.
Wir entwickeln als Hightech Pioniere leistungsfähige Sensorsysteme und digitale Lösungen, die Gefahren erkennen und Mensch und Umwelt schützen. HENSOLDT entwickelt diese intelligenten und integrierten Technologien für alle Einsatzbereiche: in der Luft, zu Wasser, an Land, im Weltraum und im Cyberspace. Wir bei HENSOLDT treiben Innovationen konsequent voran und investieren maßgeblich in Forschung und Entwicklung.

Über den Bereich

Als Senior Account & Business Development Manager (m/w/d) Space & Defence verantworten Sie die strategische Entwicklung und den Ausbau des Geschäfts im Bereich weltraumgestützter Fähigkeiten für die Bundeswehr.

Im Mittelpunkt der Position stehen der Aufbau und die Pflege strategischer Kundenbeziehungen mit dem Bedarfsträger sowie dem ministeriellen Apparat, die Identifikation und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftspotenziale sowie die Begleitung komplexer Akquisitions- und Vergabeprozesse im deutschen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtumfeld.

Ihr Ziel ist es, langfristige strategische Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen, zukünftige Bedarfe frühzeitig zu erkennen, Geschäftschancen zu entwickeln und unser Unternehmen als bevorzugten industriellen Partner für die Bundeswehr zu positionieren.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortung für die strategische Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung des Accounts Bundeswehr im Bereich Space
- Verantwortung für Planung und Realisierung des Auftragseingangs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftsbereichen der HENSOLDT Gruppe
- Aufbau und Pflege eines belastbaren Netzwerkes zum militärischen Bedarfsträger, dem Verteidigungsministerium sowie zu weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern in Verbänden und Industrie
- Identifikation von Entscheidungsstrukturen, zukünftigen Bedarfen und strategischen Prioritäten des Kunden
- Identifizierung und Qualifizierung anstehender Beschaffungsvorhaben der Deutschen Bundeswehr im Bereich weltraumgestützter Fähigkeiten
- Erarbeitung von Beiträgen zur Vorbereitung der Geschäftsleitung auf Termine mit hochrangigen Vertretern aus Politik und Militär

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Studium, vorzugsweise in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Elektrotechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Account Management, Business Development, Vertrieb oder Programm-/Projektmanagement im Aerospace-, Defence- oder Space-Umfeld
- Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtmarktes
- Gutes Verständnis der operativen Anforderungen der Deutschen Luftwaffe und der Technologie von fliegenden und bodengebundenen Waffensystemen
- Gute Kenntnisse des Beschaffungsprozesses der Bundeswehr sowie der Aufbau- und Ablauforganisation der Bundeswehr
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
- Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen, im Schwerpunkt innerhalb Deutschlands

Sie wollen Teil eines zukunftsorientierten Unternehmens werden? Und sind bereit Verantwortung in spannenden internationalen und nationalen Projekten zu übernehmen? Dann sind Sie unser Kandidat!
Bewerben Sie sich bitte ausschließlich online über unser Karriereportal mit Ihrem Lebenslauf und Ihren Zeugnissen.

HENSOLDT setzt sich für Vielfalt und eine integrative Firmenkultur ein. Daher begrüßen wir alle Bewerbungen - unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Identität oder Weltanschauung.

Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.

At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Discover your exciting role

The Global Procurement - ESG Lead (m/f/d) is responsible for integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles into procurement and subcontracting processes. The role drives sustainability and ethical sourcing across the supply chain by aligning procurement strategies with ESG objectives and collaborating with internal teams and external partners. Acting as the central ESG point of contact within Procurement and Subcontracting Management, the position leads sustainability initiatives, supports ESG training for procurement teams and suppliers, and continuously improves processes to strengthen responsible supplier partnerships.
Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Integrate ESG requirements into procurement strategies, processes, and procedures by closely collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to strengthen environmental sustainability and social responsibility.
Ensure compliance with ESG‑related regulations (e.g. LKSG, CSDDD) by identifying gaps and implementing due‑diligence, reporting, and training measures.
Serve as the central ESG point of contact within Procurement and Subcontracting Management, ensuring consistent standards and reduced compliance risk.
Drive ESG improvement initiatives in procurement, balancing sustainability, efficiency, innovation, and cost effectiveness.
Develop and support ESG training for procurement teams and suppliers to strengthen ESG capabilities across the supply chain.
Monitor and report ESG performance using tools such as SAP Ariba and EcoVadis to enable data‑driven decisions and risk mitigation.
Partner with business units and leadership to align procurement optimization with corporate ESG objectives and secure stakeholder buy‑in.
Show your expertise

- 7+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain, sustainability, or ESG‑related roles, preferably in a corporate or multinational environment, with ESG consulting experience considered an asset.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, ESG or Sustainable Procurement certifications preferred.
- Strong knowledge of ESG principles, sustainable procurement, responsible sourcing, and relevant regulations such as LKSG and CSDDD.
- Proven experience in developing and implementing ESG strategies within procurement, including supplier engagement, risk assessment, due diligence, and compliance monitoring.
- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and with suppliers to drive sustainability initiatives.
- Experience in developing ESG training and capacity‑building programs for procurement teams and suppliers.
- Analytical and results‑driven mindset with strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
- Proficiency in procurement and sustainability tools such as SAP, SAP Ariba, and EcoVadis, as well as Excel, PowerPoint, and ESG reporting.
- Fluent English required and German advantageous.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
