Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener 

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

  • Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

  • Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

  • Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

  • Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites.

Your Background

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project.

  • Strong coding skills in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2.

  • Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged.

  • Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo.

  • Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

jobs.title: System Engineer

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

  • Rigorous, structured, and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Bonus: Experience with UAS or defense systems.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

  • A utility business with a strong free tier

  • Experience with high-volume consumer tools

  • Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate.

Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact!

Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.

Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values.

Our Benefits

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home, our offices are pet-friendly

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

🍻 BBQs, game nights, meetups in the Swiss Alps, or in kayaks on Lake Zurich—we’re serious about great coffee, karaoke, and Mario Kart, too!

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

Er du god i møte med mennesker og brenner for faglig utvikling, målrettet arbeid og høy kvalitet i tjenestene?
I Humana omsorg og assistanse går vi på jobb hver dag med en felles visjon: Alle har rett til et godt liv. Ja, alle. Enten man jobber i direkte miljøarbeid eller leder faget fra administrasjonen, er hver enkelt av oss en helt avgjørende del av løsningen.

Nå søker vi en robust og engasjert institusjonsleder til barnevernsinstitusjon Vest Bergen. Her vil du lede et omsorgs- og behandlingstilbud til barn og unge som trenger traumesensitiv omsorg og miljøterapeutisk behandling. Vi gir ungdommene et hjem preget av forutsigbarhet, trygghet, rammer og kjærlighet, og vi søker deg som har en grunnleggende tro på at de kan utvikle nye ferdigheter og mestringsstrategier.

Dine ansvarsområder og arbeidsoppgaver

Som institusjonsleder har du det overordnede ansvaret for daglig drift, økonomi- og budsjettkontroll i tråd med Humanas verdigrunnlag og strategi. Du sikrer at prosedyrer, fagplaner, handlingsplaner og tiltaksplaner utarbeides grundig og følges tett opp. En viktig del av hverdagen handler om å lede medarbeiderne dine gjennom faglig veiledning, opplæring, rekruttering og systematisk HMS- og avviksoppfølging. Du vil også skrive tilbud, dokumentere og rapportere, samt pleie kontakten med våre oppdragsgivere og samarbeidspartnere.

Hva skal til for å lykkes hos oss?

Vi ser etter deg som leder med god selvinnsikt, åpen kommunikasjon og en naturlig evne til å bygge tillit og sterke relasjoner. Du har god kjennskap til barneverninstitusjonsdrift. Videre har du helse- og sosialfaglig utdannelse på bachelornivå (barnevernspedagog, vernepleier eller sosionom) og i tillegg en master i ledelse. Du vil også vurderes dersom du har videreutdanning i ledelese. Rollen krever solid kunnskap om barnevernsloven. Siden rollen krever stor arbeidskapasitet, trives du i et operativt og hektisk miljø der vi dyrker samspill og tverrfaglighet. Det er en stor fordel om du har forretningsforståelse og tidligere erfaring som leder. God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk er et krav.

Hvorfor bli en del av vårt lag?

I Humana omsorg og assistanse tror vi på at ekte kvalitet skapes når vi jobber mot et felles samfunnsoppdrag med glede, engasjement og ansvar. Vi tilbyr:

  • En trygg lederstilling i en stor, landsdekkende organisasjon med tariffavtale, gjennomarbeidede HMS-rutiner og egen intern HR-avdeling.

  • Et faglig sterkt miljø som verdsetter nytenking, og hvor du får reell mulighet til å påvirke både faglig og sosialt.

  • Gode karrieremuligheter internt i organisasjonen.

  • Tilgang til Humanas omfattende fordelsprogram.

Hvis du deler vår visjon, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Ta gjerne en uformell prat med divisjonsleder Kirsten Sunde Haga på telefon 470 11 891 for å høre mer om stillingen og avdelingen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Mekanikere søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Dragør
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter to praktiske og dygtige mekanikere, der kan tage hånd om skrueopgaver i forbindelse med konvertering fra diesel til el på primært maskiner og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner samt at bygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker på vores udviklingsværksted arbejder du med den praktiske af- og remontage på maskiner og andre køretøjer. Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage efter foreløbige arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et delvist internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til bence@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Bence Pati Nagy på bence@ren-teq.com eller på 20778078

RENTEQ Automotive · Dragør, Danmark · www.ren-teq.com

jobs.title: Litt praktisk hjelp, mye hverdagsglede - bli min BPA-assistent!
jobs.description:
Litt om meg

Jeg er ei trivelig dame på 52 år som bor sammen med mine to barn på 12 og 16 år, og en liten hund. Hos oss er det både liv og latter - og en hverdag som jeg virkelig ønsker å være mest mulig til stede i.

Jeg liker å fylle dagene med kreative prosjekter, musikk og turer i naturen. Jeg er nysgjerrig av natur og lærer meg for tiden spansk. Ellers kan du finne meg med lego på bordet, en spillkontroll i hånda eller et puslespill som sakte, men sikkert tar form. Å følge opp barna mine og være en aktiv del av livene deres er noe av det viktigste for meg - og noe jeg setter stor pris på.

Jeg kan og får til det meste, og har både vilje og pågangsmot. Samtidig gjør helseutfordringer at energien ikke alltid strekker helt til i hverdagen. Derfor trenger jeg litt praktisk bistand hjemme. Med din hjelp kan hverdagen bli mer oversiktlig og mindre krevende, og jeg kan bruke kreftene mine på det som betyr mest - familien min og det som gir meg glede.


Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid

Jeg har 13 timer per uke til disposisjon og ønsker å fordele disse på tre til fire dager. Det vil i praksis si korte økter på ukedager, rundt 3 timer på formiddag eller midt på dagen. Noe fleksibilitet må påregnes ved behov. Arbeidstid avtales nærmere.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som min assistent blir du en viktig støttespiller i hverdagen min. Du bidrar til at huset fungerer, at tempoet blir mer overkommelig, og at vi får flyt i dagene våre.

Arbeidsoppgavene handler først og fremst om praktisk bistand hjemme - som matlaging, rengjøring, klesvask, skifte på senger, rydding og handling. Du vil også gå tur med hunden og bidra til at hjemmet vårt oppleves ryddig og trivelig.

I tillegg kan det være aktuelt å bistå ved reiser, hytteturer og ulike fritidsaktiviteter - for eksempel med planlegging, pakking og tilrettelegging. Det kan også handle om litt ekstra innsats i forbindelse med shopping, fritidssysler, forberedelser til bursdager eller andre arrangementer. Oppgavene vil variere noe, men fellesnevneren er at du bidrar til at jeg får brukt energien min på det som betyr mest.


Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du må være fylt 18 år
  • Du må ha førerkort
  • Du må kunne legge frem gyldig politiattest før ansettelse
  • Du må snakke flytende norsk og/eller engelsk

Personlige egenskaper

Jeg ser etter deg som er pålitelig og ærlig, tar initiativ og ser hva som bør gjøres. Du er trygg i møte med ungdom, komfortabel med hund og har både humor og godt humør. Det er en stor fordel om du liker å lage mat og gjerne prøver nye oppskrifter.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!


Mye mer enn bare penger

Visste du at med erfaring fra jobben som personlig assistent er du ettertraktet også i andre jobber?

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet! All arbeidserfaring er relevant for BPA assistenter. Vi mener at BPA ikke er en helsetjeneste, våre BPA-assistenter skal bidra til at våre vedtakseiere hver dag får en bedre hverdag!

Hva du får som assistent i BPA Nord:

  • Sikre deltids- og heltidsstillinger | Varierte arbeidstider
  • Kurs og god opplæring | Assistentmanual
  • Timelønn som ligger over gjennomsnittet i liknende jobber
  • Kompetanseutvikling via gratis E-læringskurs
  • Kveld/natt/helg- og helligdagstillegg
  • Pensjonsavtale for alle ansatte uavhengig av stillingsstørrelse
  • Personalforsikringer (Yrkesskade, Fritidsskade, Gruppeliv og DNBs døgnkontinuerlige Helsetelefon)
  • Verneombud | Bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Enkle digitale registreringssystemer
  • En ekte nordnorsk arbeidsgiver – nær, varm og på lag med deg

Vil DU bidra til en bedre hverdag for mennesker med assistansebehov, samtidig som du får en spennende CV?
Søk assistentjobb hos BPA Nord!


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kompetanse  |  Anerkjennelse  |  Respekt  |  Tillit

BPA Nord er en av Nord-Norges største leverandører av brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA). Vi leverer BPA-tjenester i over 30 kommuner i Nordland, Troms og Finnmark, med administrasjon i Tromsø. Gjennom BPA legger vi til rette for at mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser kan leve selvstendige liv med frihet, valgmuligheter og innflytelse over egen hverdag. Vår visjon er en bedre hverdag!

Nærmere opplysninger om BPA Nord finnes på www.bpa-nord.no.

jobs.title: betterpeople A/S søger på vegne af Rotpunkt Esbjerg en salgs- & indretningskonsulent.
jobs.description:
Salgs- og indretningskonsulent, Rotpunkt Esbjerg

Er du en stærk sælger, der motiveres af ansvar, kundekontakt og muligheden for at drive dine egne salgsforløb? Hos Rotpunkt Esbjerg får du mulighed for at kombinere salg, rådgivning og indretning og følge kunderne hele vejen fra de første idéer til det færdige køkken. Her bliver dit salgsdrive, dit initiativ og din evne til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser afgørende.

Rotpunkt 
Rotpunkt er et veletableret brand inden for køkken, bad og garderobe med fokus på kvalitet, funktionelt design og individuelle løsninger. Virksomheden hjælper kunder med at realisere deres boligdrømme gennem professionel rådgivning og skræddersyede løsninger, der matcher både behov og livsstil. 

Hos Rotpunkt Esbjerg bliver du en del af et mindre team med en uformel hverdag, korte beslutningsveje og stor frihed under ansvar. Her er der tæt samarbejde og plads til sparring, samtidig med at der er en forventning om, at du tager ansvar for dine egne opgaver og bidrager aktivt til butikkens hverdag.  

Skab unikke køkkenløsninger og stærke kunderelationer 
Som salgs- & indretningskonsulent får du ansvar for dine egne kunder og følger dem gennem hele processen, fra den første dialog og behovsafdækning til opmåling, indretning, tilbud, ordre og den videre opfølgning. 

Du rådgiver kunderne om blandt andet indretning, materialer, funktionalitet og løsninger og hjælper dem med bedst muligt at træffe de mange valg, der følger med et nyt køkken. Det kræver, at du er god til at skabe relationer og tillid og kan guide kunden trygt gennem hele processen. 

Du får en høj grad af selvstændighed, stor indflydelse på dine projekter og mulighed for at arbejde med attraktive løsninger i høj kvalitet. 

Stillingen har primært fokus på privatkunder, men du vil også få berøring med erhvervssalg, som Rotpunkt Esbjerg ønsker at udvikle yderligere over tid. 

Du er en stærk sælger med blik for den gode kundeoplevelse
For at få succes i rollen er det afgørende, at du har en naturlig forståelse for salg og kundekontakt og motiveres af at skabe gode resultater og stærke relationer. Du er god til at afdække kundernes behov, skabe tillid gennem hele salgsprocessen og omsætte deres ønsker til konkrete løsninger. Samtidig har du sans for indretning, materialer og funktionalitet. 

Som person arbejder du struktureret og selvstændigt, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du har et stort drive og tager naturligt ansvar i hverdagen. 

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med rådgivende salg, eksempelvis fra køkken-, møbel-, detail-, mode- eller boligbranchen. Erfaring fra køkkenbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

Et kvalitetsprodukt, stærkt fællesskab og grundig oplæring 
Hos Rotpunkt bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høje ambitioner og et kvalitetsprodukt, du kan være stolt af.  

Du får en grundig introduktion til produkterne, arbejdsgangene og salgsprocessen. Der er god mulighed for sparring undervejs, og derfor behøver du ikke nødvendigvis komme fra køkkenbranchen. Har du en stærk salgsbaggrund og lyst til at lære faget, bliver du klædt godt på til opgaven.  

Samtidig bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde, videndeling og arbejdsglæde vægtes højt. 

Rekrutteringen varetages i samarbejde med betterpeople A/S 
Da stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, behandler vi ansøgninger løbende. Der ventes dog gerne på den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så kontakt venligst Claes H. Lindgren på e-mail chl@rotpunkt.dk. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt og med diskretion. Med henvisning til persondatareglerne modtages ansøgninger KUN via link på hjemmesiden. Kan du ikke uploade din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen, bedes du kontakte os.  

OBS: Vores annonce bliver automatisk og løbende fornyet på jobportalerne, indtil stillingen er besat. En fornyelse af et stillingsopslag er ikke et udtryk for genopslag, selvom det kan fremstå sådan.

jobs.title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
jobs.description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

jobs.title: Engineer, Mechanics
jobs.description:
Join us, become part of our **#Fastemsians** work community and grow to be a future professional. Read more and come catch your dream job!

We are looking for an **Engineer, Mechanics** to join our Service Products Delivery team in Tampere. As an Engineer, Mechanics you will contribute to our Service Products deliveries and design according to our customers needs and Fastems long-term experience. This position will allow you to participate in a wide range of different Service deliveries to keep our installed base functioning.

As part of the Service Products Delivery team, you will work collaborating on diverse Service Product deliveries and supporting our local Service organizations and customers all around the world. Service Products are critical end-of-life components that will be upgraded to the latest technology, and the risk of an unexpected breakdown will be minimized. Service Products delivery team is also responsible for delivering different kinds of smaller system modifications and – changes.

The team consists of approx. 14 skilled professionals: delivery managers, electrical engineers and software developers, and together, as a team, we make sure that our customers worldwide are fully supported. We are working tightly as a team and help and support for the mechanical engineer is also available within our company from highly skilled colleagues from different teams.

As an expert in your field, your work contains designing Fastems products and systems modifications in customer deliveries so that the results of the deliveries meet the specifications, standards of quality, budget, and schedule. This includes thinking of possible new design solutions, creating models, manufacturing drawings, and schematics.A large part of the work contains supporting global Service functions relating to mechanical solutions and designs and participating in the Service Product development. Fastems value a unique culture where innovation and enabling development are important and supported in eachrole. We guarantee a flexible and relaxed atmosphere and work environment, where it is possible to develop ones skills and passion in agile ways.

**We expect you to have:**

- MSc or BSc in mechanical engineering

- A few years of experience in design work

- Up to date knowledge of manufacturing technologies

- Good communication and teamwork skills


- Experience of mechanical engineering tools (SolidWorks)

- Basics of strength calculations (with e.g. SolidWorks Simulation)

- Fluent skills in English and Finnish, both written and oral


**As a benefit for the applicant we consider:**

- Experience of industrial robotics and automation systems

- Experience of hydraulic and pneumatic systems and components

- Experience from other engineering softwares (Visual Components, Aton)


- Experience of other technical calculations


As a person you are self-driven, systematic and genuinely interested in technology. You want to keep quality as a priority in your daily work. You naturally maintain an open and positive atmosphere in a team.

**We can offer you:**

- A chance to work in the heart of development and robotics to shape the future of manufacturing industry

- Fastems strong company culture expressed through our **values**

- Career and development opportunities

- International work atmosphere and global activities

- Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely

- Good employment benefits, such as culture benefit and lunch benefit at the office


**Interested in joining #fastemsians?**

For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact:

Martin Zechner / Head of Spare Parts

Send your application together with your CV and salary request **by October 25th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Kock
jobs.description:
**Kock**

Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 24 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en kock till vår restaurang och bar. I Restaurangen och baren arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Vi serverar a la carte, konferenslunch och bistro. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat och dryck och vi kan från hösten 2026 även stoltsera med vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som har stor noggrannhet och tycker om att laga god mat från grunden. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- A la carte

- Konferenslunch

- Bistro

- Följa vår egenkontrollplan

- Övriga förekommande köksuppgifter

- Beställningar


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Du behöver ha köksutbildning eller några års erfarenhet av tidigare arbete med tillagning av a la carte/bistro. Hygienpass är ett krav och vi önskar att du kan svenska eller engelska. Du bör vara minst 20 år fyllda.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är en tillsvidare anställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Köksjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med främst kvällspass under veckans alla dagar.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com. Sista ansökningsdag är den 31.10.2026, men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatta innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta köksmästare Rune på telefon 018-14130.

jobs.title: SAP Industry Solution Advisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Du gestaltest Kundentermine, Workshops und Angebotsphasen in unseren Fokusbranchen Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defence und Automotive
  • Du identifizierst die geschäftlichen und prozessualen Herausforderungen unserer Kunden in der diskreten Fertigung und leitest daraus passende Ansatzpunkte ab.
  • Du führst Gespräche mit Fach- und IT-Entscheidern und übersetzt Anforderungen in überzeugende SAP-Lösungsbilder.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Beratungsteams klare Presales-Storylines, Präsentationen und Lösungsszenarien.
  • Du zeigst auf, wie SAP S/4HANA und digitale Technologien Produktions- und Supply-Chain-Prozesse wirksam unterstützen können.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung in komplexen Vertriebs- und Transformationssituationen und bringst Markt-, Branchen- und Kundenimpulse aktiv ein.



Dein Profil

Die Anforderungen:

  • Du verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis der Prozesse in der diskreten Fertigung und kennst die Anforderungen produzierender Unternehmen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in mindestens einer unserer Fokusbranchen mit: Industrial Manufacturing, High Tech, Defense oder Automotive.
  • Du hast fundierte SAP-Erfahrung aus der Beratung oder aus einem Industrieunternehmen und bewegst dich sicher in Transformationskontexten.
  • Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Produktion, Supply Chain, Digitalisierung und SAP S/4HANA.
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits als Projektleiter:in, Teilprojektleiter:in oder Stream Lead Verantwortung übernommen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturiert erfassen, in verständliche Lösungsszenarien übersetzen und diese sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch vermitteln.


Warum wir?

Was Du unter anderem von uns erwarten kannst:

  • Attraktives Gehalt
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Homeoffice-Option
  • Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und gute Führungskultur (kaum messbare Mitarbeiterfluktuation)
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Firmenwagen und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Lerne ein Unternehmen kennen, in dem Menschen gut und gerne zusammenarbeiten – und finde hier weitere Benefits, die wir dir bieten.
Du erkennst dich in der Beschreibung wieder? Dann zögere nicht und nimm am besten noch heute Kontakt auf. Gerne können wir uns über diese Stelle und deine Möglichkeiten bei GAMBIT unterhalten.
Wir erwarten nicht, dass alle Kandidat:innen in allen genannten Bereichen gleich qualifiziert sind. Nenn uns daher gerne weitere, hier nicht genannte Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen, über die du verfügst und die für diese Stelle möglicherweise relevant sein könnten.
Ganz besonders wichtig ist uns, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen unser Verständnis von Arbeit und Zusammenarbeit teilen. Denn Arbeit ist für uns mehr als nur ein Job, Zusammenarbeit mehr als nur ein Nebeneinander. Wir legen Wert auf einen respektvollen, wertschätzenden Umgang, Fairness und einen offenen Dialog.

jobs.title: Kundebehandler søkes til bilutleie i Bærum
jobs.description:
Vi søker en serviceinnstilt kundebehandler til et engasjement innen bilutleie. Stillingen passer for deg som trives med direkte kundekontakt, har god struktur og liker en variert arbeidshverdag der ingen dager er like.

Arbeidsoppgaver:
  • Betjening av kunder i skranke, per telefon og på e-post
  • Salg av leieavtaler og rådgivning rundt produkter og tjenester
  • Diverse backoffice-oppgaver knyttet til reservasjoner, fakturering og rapportering
Vi ser etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner og egenskaper:
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Serviceinnstilling og evne til å skape trygghet og gode kunderelasjoner
  • Ryddig arbeidsform og evne til å håndtere flere arbeidsoppgaver samtidig
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Grunnleggende datakunnskaper og erfaring med bookingsystemer er ønskelig
Vi tror du er en som: 
  • Trives med utstrakt kundekontakt og setter stolthet i å skape trygghet og gode relasjoner.
  • Liker salg og er en kremmer som ser muligheter i hvert møte med kunden.
  • Takler til tider høyt tempo og klarer å håndtere flere baller i luften samtidig med et smil.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, grundig opplæring og et trivelig arbeidsmiljø med varierte og spennende arbeidsoppgaver. Stillingen er et engasjement gjennom bemanningsbyrå, med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og et tett samarbeid med vår oppdragsgiver.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg som brenner for kundeservice, har interesse for bilbransjen og ønsker å bidra til gode kundeopplevelser hver dag

Av hensyn til GDPR kan vi kun motta søknader via stillingsannonsen. Har du spørsmål om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med Kjell Øivind Sørby på telefon 959 18 477 eller e-post kjell@bemanningsxperten.no.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en mellomstor aktør innen bemanning og rekruttering i Norge. Vi tilbyr skreddersydde løsninger for både arbeidsgivere og jobbsøkere, med fokus på kvalitet, fleksibilitet og langsiktige samarbeid. Med kontorer i Oslo, Bergen, Kristiansand, Arendal og Rogaland, har vi et sterkt nettverk og gode relasjoner i bransjen. Vårt mål er å matche de rette kandidatene med de riktige stillingene.

I Bemanningsxperten jobber vi verdibasert, og setter samfunnsengasjement, vidsyn og mangfold høyt. Vi utfordrer og er dedikert til å finne kandidater som er opptatt av å skape resultater, arbeidsplasser og verdier. Bemanningsxperten har 16 ansatte fordelt på 5 byer i Norge. Alle har relevant erfaring og bidrar med et stort nettverk.

Vi er Bemanningsxperten – vårt navn forplikter

Våre verdier: Dedikert – Pålitelig – Respekt

Se vår hjemme side for mer info.

jobs.title: Mekaaninen asentaja (Rauma)
jobs.description:
Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!

Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!



Tehtävänkuvaus

Haemme asiakkaallemme Raumalle mekaanista asentajaa pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtehtävääsi kuuluu koneiden kokoonpano ja laitteiden asennustehtävät. Työt alkavat 6 kuukauden määräaikaisuudella, jonka jälkeen sopivalle työntekijälle tarjotaan vakituista paikkaa. Töitä tehdään arkipäivisin päivävuorossa klo 8-16. Työtä tehdään 37,5h/vk. Jos haluat päästä työskentelemään osana ammattimaista työporukkaa, niin hae mukaan!

Toivomme sinulta

Sinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Monipuolinen alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi sekä kaikenlainen koneasennuksen ja hydrauliikan tuntemus sekä autopuolen harrastuneisuus. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.

Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. Within the DKCCC project, the candidate will contribute to strengthening connections between the Danish ecosystem and EU pilot lines and to translating spintronic device research into fabrication, prototyping, and technology-development activities.

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 10, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

jobs.title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. jobs.title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
jobs.description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. 

 

Further information 

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. jobs.title: Barselsvikariat – Administrativ indkøbskoordinator
jobs.description:
Fourcom ApS søger en struktureret og serviceminded kollega til et spændende barselsvikariat, hvor du får en central rolle i samspillet mellem indkøb, produktion og salg.

Har du sans for struktur, koordinering og god leverandørkontakt? Trives du med at have mange bolde i luften og samtidig sikre, at tingene bliver fulgt helt til dørs? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Som en del af Fourcom ApS bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige drift, hvor du er med til at sikre et effektivt flow fra indkøb til produktion og videre ud til vores kunder.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for blandt andet:

  • Koordinering mellem indkøb og produktion, så de rette varer og materialer er tilgængelige, når de skal bruges

  • Oprettelse og vedligeholdelse af indkøb, herunder sikring af korrekt information og opfølgning

  • Oprettelse og administration af varenumre, så vores produkt- og indkøbsdata altid er strukturerede og opdaterede

  • Dialog og koordinering med leverandører omkring ordrer, leverancer, priser og eventuelle udfordringer

  • Håndtering og koordinering af retursager, fra oprettelse til afslutning

  • Tæt kommunikation mellem salg og produktion, hvor du er med til at sikre, at information og aftaler bliver omsat til handling

  • Generelle indkøbs- og koordineringsopgaver, hvor du bidrager til at skabe struktur og fremdrift i hverdagen

En rolle med mange kontaktflader

Du bliver en vigtig koordinerende funktion i organisationen og får kontakt med både leverandører, salg, produktion og kolleger på tværs af virksomheden.

Derfor søger vi dig, som kan lide at være den, der skaber overblik, følger op og får tingene til at hænge sammen. Du behøver ikke vide alt fra dag ét – det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og har lyst til at tage ansvar.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt øje for detaljer

  • Er god til at koordinere og bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Har gode kommunikative evner og trives med mange forskellige kontaktflader

  • Er serviceminded og løsningsorienteret

  • Har flair for administrative systemer og IT

  • Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Har erfaring med indkøb, administration, logistik eller koordinering – men det er ikke et krav

Vi tilbyder

Hos Fourcom ApS får du en alsidig rolle med mulighed for at få indblik i hele processen fra indkøb til produktion og salg. Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor samarbejde, fleksibilitet og godt købmandskab er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med opstart 01/11-2026 og forventes at løbe til 01/10-26.

Arbejdssted: Fourcom ApS 
Arbejdstid: min. 30 timer 
Ansøgningsfrist: hurtigst muligt 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og CV på ms@fourcom.dk .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit - toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Osaavan projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.
