jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.

Hlavné úlohy a zodpovednosti: • Montáž mechanických a elektrotechnických zostáv podľa pracovných inštrukcií. • Kompletizácia plastových dielov vrátane vizuálnej a hmatovej kontroly dielov pred montážou. • Osádzanie komponentov do prípravkov, skrutkovanie, zapájanie káblov, jednoduché merania podľa inštrukcií. • Obsluha zariadení na ultrazvukové zváranie plastov (spúšťanie, ukladanie dielov, kontrola výsledku). • Kontrola a vyhodnocovanie kvality zvarov podľa definovaných kritérií (tvar, pevnosť, čistota spoja). • Vedenie záznamov o nekvalite alebo odchýlkach. • Práca podľa pracovných inštrukcií, technologických postupov a vizuálnych návodov. • Disciplinované plnenie pokynov majstra alebo vedúceho bunky. • Účasť na školeniach týkajúcich sa nových produktov, BOZP a kvality. • Dodržiavanie časových noriem a denných plánov. • Spolupráca na zlepšovaní produktivity a minimalizácii nepodarkov. • Hlásenie chýb, odchýlok alebo technických problémov nadriadenému. • Zodpovednosť za čistotu pracoviska v rámci 5S štandardov. • Dodržiavanie bezpečnostných pravidiel pri práci s elektrickými zariadeniami a zváracími prístrojmi. • Používanie predpísaných OOPP.
Výhody:70 € mesačný dochádzkový bonus. Príspevok na dochádzanie 0,50 € na odpracovaný deň. Kvartálne bonusy do výšky 25percent platu. Ročný bonus do výšky 50percent platu. 2 x ročne 250 € dovolenkový bonus. Príspevok na občerstvenie 5 € mesačne. Rizikové poistenie zamestnancov. Finančné odmeny k pracovným výročiam. Príspevky na mimopracovné aktivity.

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Esprit d'initiative, capacité à prendre les choses en main et à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément.

jobs.title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
jobs.description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

Investment Strategist – Local SPOC

locations
Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)

Full time
job requisition id

Your role & work environment

The Investment Strategist is part of the Global Investment Center within ISIM in Luxembourg. The role focuses on building and articulating ING's investment vision from a macro and multi asset perspective, ensuring full alignment between global strategy and the Luxembourg platform.

As the local SPOC, the Investment Strategist works closely with Private Bankers and commercial teams, acting as the key relay for investment insights and ensuring consistent communication of ING's house view across the market.

ISIM, ING's “Super ManCo”, manages both UCITS and AIFs and acts as the Group's central platform for investment fund solutions.
Your key responsibilities

Drives Vision – Macro & Tactical Asset Allocation

• Conduct macroeconomic and market research to shape ING's investment vision.
• Analyze internal and external sources, build scenarios, and produce high-quality investment materials.
• Monitor macroeconomic developments and financial markets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Synthesize complex information into actionable investment insights supporting the monthly investment cycle.
• Contribute to ING's global investment strategy through cross-asset allocation views.
• Translate macroeconomic perspectives into portfolio positioning guidelines.
• Support the performance of centrally managed portfolios and long-term value creation.
• Collaborate closely with the CIO and investment strategists in Brussels and Amsterdam to align local and global investment strategies.

Communication & Strategic Alignment

• Act as the local point of contact for communicating ING's investment vision in Luxembourg.
• Provide regular market updates and investment insights to Private Bankers and commercial teams.
• Prepare and deliver presentations on market developments and investment themes.
• Represent ING's investment views at client events and group presentations.
• Support selected media interactions by communicating aligned investment messages.
• Ensure consistency and alignment with the Global Investment Center's investment strategy and messaging.

We look for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.

As an Investment Strategist – local SPOC you will also need:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or a related field (CFA charter holder is considered as an asset)
• Minimum of 10+ years of experience in financial markets as Portfolio Manager or Investment Strategist, with a proven track record in macro analysis and multi asset allocation.
• Excellent command of English and French (written and spoken), speaking Dutch or any other European language is considered as an asset.
• Strong expertise in macroeconomics, market analysis and cross asset dynamics, with the ability to identify key trends, risks and structural shifts.
• Proven capacity to translate complex macro and market signals into clear, actionable investment views and coherent portfolio positioning guidelines.
• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills, including scenario analysis and data driven decision making, delivering concise and high impact insights to committees, CIO, PMs and senior stakeholders.
• Proven collaboration skills in a global investment environment, working closely with Strategists across locations (Amsterdam, Brussels) and with the CIO. This includes potential (regular) travels.
• Excellent communication skills to support strategic alignment with commercial teams and act as a local SPOC for the Global Investment Center.
• High degree of autonomy, intellectual curiosity and ability to operate effectively in fast moving market environments.
• Excellent presentation skills (orally and powerpoint) for internal and external audiences (including panel discussions with peers) with the capability to present complex matters in (1) an easy way and (2) keep your audience captivated.
• Contribute to strategic projects with your relevant management, including taking ownership on relevant change projects if and when possible.

We offer you  

• Shape ING's investment vision and contribute directly to the performance of centrally managed portfolios.
• Collaborate with leading investment professionals across Luxembourg, Brussels, and Amsterdam in a truly international setting.
• Take ownership of strategic projects and influence key investment decisions in a dynamic and fast-evolving market environment.

We redefine banking. What about you?

There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centered around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that!

Derrière chaque voiture qui quitte notre showroom, rejoint un atelier, un événement ou son nouveau propriétaire, il faut quelqu'un sur qui nous pouvons compter.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Technicien Polyvalent & Transport.
Un poste de terrain, à la croisée de trois univers : la technique, la préparation et le transport.
Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui connaît réellement les automobiles, sait travailler sur celles-ci et comprend ce que signifie se voir confier une voiture, une mission et l'image d'une maison.


VOTRE MISSION:

Votre quotidien sera volontairement varié.

Vous assurerez notamment :

• la préparation esthétique de nos automobiles : lavage, intérieur, finitions et detailing ;
• la préparation des voitures avant présentation, shooting, événement ou livraison ;
• le maintien des véhicules du showroom dans un état irréprochable ;
• les mouvements de voitures entre nos différents sites, stockages et ateliers ;
• le suivi des automobiles en atelier, leur dépôt et leur récupération ;
• les transports au Luxembourg et à travers l'Europe ;
• le chargement, l'arrimage et le déchargement des véhicules ;
• les livraisons et enlèvements chez nos clients et partenaires ;
• la logistique liée aux salons, rallyes et événements ;
• l'entretien du matériel de transport et des véhicules de l'entreprise.

Lorsque vous n'êtes pas sur la route, vous participez pleinement à la vie du showroom et secondez notre mécanicien lorsque cela est nécessaire.
La polyvalence est précisément le métier.


UNE VRAIE EXPÉRIENCE TECHNIQUE:

Ce poste nécessite de connaître les automobiles autrement que par leur volant.
Une expérience technique réelle sur des automobiles analogiques est indispensable.
Vous devez être capable d'assurer des opérations d'entretien courant, d'effectuer les contrôles nécessaires, d'identifier une anomalie mécanique et de comprendre suffisamment une automobile ancienne pour savoir ce que vous pouvez résoudre vous-même et ce qui doit être confié au mécanicien.
Carburation, allumage, alimentation en carburant, refroidissement, freinage, batterie ou électricité automobile de base ne doivent pas être pour vous des notions abstraites.
Vous n'avez pas vocation à remplacer notre mécanicien, mais vous devez pouvoir le seconder efficacement et assurer le relais lorsqu'il est absent.
Nous ne recherchons donc pas simplement un passionné ayant quelques notions de mécanique.
Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui a déjà travaillé sur des automobiles analogiques et sait réellement mettre les mains dedans
Une expérience professionnelle en atelier ou en concession automobile constitue naturellement un plus.


SUR LA ROUTE:

Une partie importante du poste concerne le transport de nos automobiles.
Le permis permettant la conduite avec remorque est indispensable, tout comme une véritable aisance dans le chargement, l'arrimage et la conduite d'un ensemble routier.
Vous devez également être disponible pour des déplacements réguliers de plusieurs jours en Europe.
Nous ne recherchons pas la rapidité.
Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui charge correctement, vérifie deux fois lorsque cela est nécessaire, conduit proprement et ramène une automobile exactement dans l'état dans lequel elle lui a été confiée.
Avec une voiture de collection derrière soi, bien arriver compte davantage qu'arriver vite.


À L'EXTÉRIEUR, VOUS REPRÉSENTEZ LL CLASSIC CARS:

C'est une responsabilité importante et nous ne la prenons pas à la légère.
Vous serez reçu chez nos clients, entrerez parfois dans des collections privées, rencontrerez nos partenaires et représenterez LL Classic Cars lors de déplacements et d'événements.
Nous attendons donc une personne naturellement ponctuelle, discrète, courtoise et irréprochable dans sa conduite comme dans son comportement.
Le respect de la vie privée de nos clients et la confidentialité concernant leurs automobiles, leurs collections et les informations auxquelles vous pourrez avoir accès sont absolus.
Les imprévus font partie du métier : une ancienne peut refuser de démarrer, un transport peut prendre du retard, un programme peut changer.
Le professionnalisme avec lequel ils sont gérés, lui, ne doit jamais être un imprévu.


VOTRE PROFIL:

Vous êtes avant tout quelqu'un d'automobile.
Vous avez une expérience concrète des voitures de génération analogique et savez qu'elles demandent de l'observation, de la méthode, du soin et parfois de la débrouillardise.

Vous êtes :

• fiable et ponctuel ;
• soigneux et organisé ;
• autonome sans être individualiste ;
• débrouillard et à l'aise avec les outils ;
• capable de prendre des initiatives avec discernement ;
• suffisamment humble pour demander conseil lorsque vous ne savez pas ;
• disponible et à l'aise avec les déplacements.

Vous disposez du permis permettant la conduite avec remorque et d'une expérience réelle de celle-ci.
Le français est indispensable.
La pratique de l'anglais est appréciée compte tenu de nos déplacements et de notre clientèle internationale.


POURQUOI LL CLASSIC CARS ?

Parce que peu de postes permettent de passer aussi naturellement d'un carburateur à une remorque, d'un showroom à un atelier, d'une automobile des années 60 à un youngtimer et du Luxembourg aux routes d'Europe.
Vous travaillerez quotidiennement au contact d'automobiles remarquables et de personnes qui les apprécient.
Mais cela n'a de sens que si l'on mesure la responsabilité qui l'accompagne.
Chez LL Classic Cars, la confiance se donne avec l'autonomie et se conserve par l'exemplarité.
Nous ne cherchons pas simplement quelqu'un qui souhaite travailler autour de belles voitures.
Nous cherchons quelqu'un à qui nous pourrons confier nos automobiles, nos clients et notre nom.

L'infirmier preste des soins infirmiers préventifs, curatifs ou palliatifs qui sont de nature relationnelle, technique ou éducative.

Surveillance neurologique des patients notamment en postopératoire direct – Glasgow
Coma Scale / Score d'Oxford et sensibilité – motricité des membres

jobs.title: Process Management Consultant - Bank Processes (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Process Management Consultant - Bank Processes (m/f/d)

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

As Process Management Consultant – Bank Processes (m/f/d) you will take responsibility for designing, implementing and maintaining a robust process management framework that meets regulatory, governance, and operational requirements of a newly licensed bank in Luxembourg.
The role is responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive process documentation, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing evidence of effective and compliant process execution in line with CSSF, ECB, EBA, and internal governance expectations.

Role & responsibilities:

• Maintain and continuously enhance the bank-wide process management framework.  
• Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end process landscape, including process hierarchies, ownership structures, roles, responsibilities, and governance mechanisms.  
• Ensure complete, accurate, and audit-ready process documentation supporting regulatory compliance.  
• Help to translate regulatory and supervisory requirements issued by the CSSF, ECB, EBA, and other relevant authorities into operational processes, controls, and governance standards.
• Define and implement methodologies, standards, and best practices for process modelling, documentation, maintenance, and review.  
• Establish mechanisms to demonstrate and evidence compliant process execution to regulators, auditors, and internal control functions.  
• Support the implementation of the Three Lines of Defense model by clearly defining process ownership, control responsibilities, and oversight activities.  
• Identify process-related risks, control gaps, and regulatory weaknesses and drive remediation initiatives.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (m/f)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operations Analyst - New Issues, you will play a key role in supporting securities operations through the analysis, onboarding, monitoring, and maintenance of financial instruments. This position offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of products while contributing to data quality, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance within an international banking environment.

RESPONSABILITIES

Securities Documentation and Analysis

• Review and analyze securities documentation, including prospectuses, final terms, key information documents, term sheets, issuer notices and other supporting documents.
• Assess documentation for completeness, consistency and operational usability before the instrument is created or maintained in the Bank's systems.
• Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies or unclear product features and coordinate clarification with issuers, arrangers, custodians and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain a complete and traceable repository of instrument documentation for operational, audit and regulatory purposes.

Instrument Data Validation

• Validate instrument static data and key economic characteristics, including ISIN, issuer, currency, coupon, maturity, underlying, payment frequency, call features and market classification.
• Ensure instrument data recorded in internal systems is complete, accurate and consistent with the official documentation and approved data sources.
• Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate timely correction with relevant internal teams and external data providers.
• Perform periodic data-quality reviews and support control evidence and audit-trail requirements.

Pricing and Tolerance Controls

• Perform daily or periodic pricing controls and review price movements against established tolerance thresholds.
• Investigate missing, stale or out-of-tolerance prices and obtain supporting information from approved market data sources, issuers or valuation providers.
• Escalate material pricing exceptions and ensure that corrections or overrides are appropriately supported, approved and documented.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of pricing-control procedures and tolerance parameters.

Fiscal Impacts and Fiscal Documentation

• Analyze potential fiscal impacts associated with financial instruments, income events, redemptions and other lifecycle events.
• Collect, validate and maintain fiscal documentation required for withholding-tax treatment, tax relief, reclaim processes and applicable reporting obligations.
• Coordinate with Tax, Compliance, custodians and issuers to clarify the fiscal treatment of instruments and specific events.
• Ensure fiscal assumptions, supporting evidence and operational instructions are clearly documented and escalated when uncertain.

Funds – NAV Control

• Monitor and control Net Asset Value (NAV) information for investment funds using approved sources.
• Investigate missing, stale or unusual NAV movements and coordinate resolution with fund administrators, custodians, distributors and data providers.
• Validate that fund prices and relevant reference data are correctly reflected in internal systems.
• Maintain supporting evidence for NAV exceptions, corrections and escalations.

Onboarding of Structured Products

• Coordinate the operational onboarding of structured products from initial request through instrument readiness.
• Review final terms, term sheets, payoff descriptions, issuer information, relevant risk indicators and operational settlement details.
• Coordinate instrument creation and data validation with internal functions and confirm that required documentation and regulatory information are available before activation.
• Track open onboarding items, dependencies and approvals, escalating issues that could prevent timely product availability.

Monitoring of Specific Events

• Monitor instrument-specific events and issuer notices that may affect product terms, valuation, client positions or operational processing.
• Analyze relevant event information, identify impacted instruments and coordinate required updates in the Bank's systems.
• Communicate material events and operational impacts to the relevant internal stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
• Maintain evidence of the analysis, decisions, actions and follow-up performed.
• Coordination with Issuers and External Parties
• Act as an operational point of contact with issuers, arrangers, custodians, fund administrators and data providers for instrument documentation, reference data, pricing and event-related queries.
• Coordinate the collection of missing information and follow up on outstanding requests within required operational timelines.
• Ensure communications and received documentation are retained in accordance with applicable internal record-keeping requirements.
• Escalate unresolved or material issues to the Senior Operations Analyst or Operations Manager.
• General Responsibilities
• Maintain clear and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Identify operational risks and opportunities to improve data quality, controls and process efficiency.
• Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, process documentation and operational projects.
• Execute assigned controls and reporting activities while maintaining accuracy, traceability and appropriate escalation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in securities operations, instrument data management, product onboarding, pricing controls, funds operations, or related areas.
• Strong understanding of financial instruments, including bonds, equities, investment funds, and structured products.
• Knowledge of securities documentation, instrument static data, and product lifecycle events.
• Understanding of pricing controls, tolerance monitoring, NAV validation, and related operational processes.
• Awareness of withholding tax documentation and tax-related operational impacts is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Fluent English is required; Portuguese is considered an advantage.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

This position is based in Luxembourg and primarily office-based. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. You will work closely with internal teams and external market participants, including issuers, custodians, fund administrators, and data providers. Successful candidates will demonstrate resilience, sound judgment, and a commitment to delivering accurate and timely operational outcomes while contributing to continuous process improvement. Occasional additional effort may be required to meet operational, regulatory, or project-related deadlines.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

At XXXX, diversity is both a value and a strategic priority. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are welcomed, respected, and valued.

If you are looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while contributing to the transformation of an international banking institution, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of XXXX's journey of trust, innovation, and sustainable growth.

jobs.title: Gen B Graduate Program, Process Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position.  



To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  



A program designed for your future

For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations.

Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential. 

Find your path

As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  

In this role as a Process Development Engineer, you'll be part of the the R&D team at Harjavalta smelter, supporting production operations and, when needed, investment projects. You will solve process-related challenges, contribute to long-term assignments linked to strategic objectives, and collaborate closely with production, maintenance, and project personnel.

Responsibilities:

    Respond promptly to requests from production and help resolve process-related problems

    Support production operations and contribute to investment projects when needed

    Contribute to longer-term assignments linked to the company’s strategic objectives

    Combine rapid operational problem-solving with systematic long-term planning

    Review historical reports, external research, and industry publications and assess their relevance to Harjavalta smelter

    Document trials, new materials, operating-window changes, results, and lessons learned for future use

    Collaborate with production, maintenance, and project personnel on process development initiatives

Qualifications: 

    Master of Science in metallurgy, sustainable process metallurgy, extractive metallurgy, process engineering, chemical engineering, process chemistry, or a closely related field



Who you are

We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert. 

What you bring

You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027.

How to apply

Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage.

About Boliden

Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.

Learn more at www.boliden.com.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 20th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.title: Manager, Support Engineering (AMER)
Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

**Did we pique your interest?**

If this sounds like the perfect next career move for you, please send us your CV, cover letter, and up-to-date transcript of studies by **20 October 2026** to get the conversation going! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

**P.S.: Apply as soon as possible** – we will start reviewing applications and getting to know candidates already during the application period.

_The selected person will undergo a health check-up and drug testing._

jobs.title: Ethics & Compliance Counsel @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Hey Ethics & Compliance professional!**

Are you looking for a diverse role in ethics and compliance within a listed company? Would you be excited to join a team where your work helps build a more sustainable future?

If you are thinking **YES**, please keep reading because we are now looking for **a Legal Counsel, Ethics & Compliance** to join **Stora Enso's Ethics and Compliance Team**!

**In this role**, as a member of the Ethics and Compliance team, you will work with assignments on group level, and, at the same time, serve as the dedicated Ethics and Compliance resource for one or several of Stora Enso's Business Areas. More specifically, you will:

- Serve as the dedicated E&C resource for assigned Business Area(s), providing proactive and reactive legal support including risk assessments, policy interpretation, and compliance investigations

- Monitor relevant regulatory developments in Finland and across the EU, covering anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations

- Draft, update, and implement E&C policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent understanding and application across the organisation

- Develop and deliver E&C training and awareness initiatives, both in person, online and through e-learning programmes

- Contribute as an integrated member of the Group E&C team, taking ownership of group-level projects and supporting the Chief Compliance Officer as needed


Together with your team, you will also attempt to manage information in digital form by using AI, and thus continuously work towards making the routines more efficient and better.

**The Ethics and Compliance team** consists of 6 professionals in several global locations. The team is spread across multiple locations but operates as a genuinely close-knit group, with strong connections and active day-to-day collaboration across geographies. Team members support one another and are encouraged to challenge each other constructively. This is a team where you are expected to contribute, grow, and be heard - ambition is welcomed, and opportunities for development are real.

The position is based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki, but the position also involves occasional, pre-planned travel, mostly within Europe. You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer, who is based in Sweden.

**This position is a great fit for a candidate who has:**

- a Finnish law degree or other education and experience the employer deems relevant for this position;

- at least five years of relevant experience in ethics and compliance in an international environment, whether in-house or at a law firm;

- a strong knowledge of competition law, anti-corruption, trade sanctions, grievance handling and investigations, as well as business ethics and corporate values more broadly;

- a good understanding of the fast-moving regulatory landscape relevant to corporate ethics and compliance, including developments at both the Finnish and EU levels, particularly in the areas of anti-corruption, sanctions, data privacy, and sustainability-related obligations;

- project management experience and experience of rolling out cross-functional programmes in international organisations;

- proven integrity and high ethical standards as well as a strong drive to get things done and the ability to perform well under pressure and meet tight deadlines;

- strong interpersonal skills and a team player mindset; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required. Additional language skills, such as Swedish, German, Polish, Dutch or Chinese, are considered an advantage.


**What Stora Enso offers you:**

**A place for professional growth:** Stora Enso's innovative and high-speed environment offers you an opportunity to constantly develop professionally at all stages of your career.

**A diverse working culture:** You get to be part of highly skilled team within an international corporation where everyone is treated fairly and with respect.

jobs.title: Director, M&A Legal @ UPM
jobs.description:
**Hey lawyer with a proven track-record in M&A,**

Are you ready to take the lead on strategic transactions in a multinational and multifaceted business environment? Do you find meaning in using your skills to promote sustainable and innovation-driven future in a global material solutions company?

If these sound like your career goals, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **UPM** as a **Director, M&A Legal** in a newly established role.

_UPM is entering an exciting phase where strategic transactions continue to play an important role in shaping our future. We are building a dedicated M&A Legal capability to support that journey, and we are looking for a business-minded lawyer who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership and thrives in helping organizations navigate complex opportunities and change._

**\-Markus Skrabb, VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal**

**As a Director, M&A Legal**, you will join UPM's Legal and Compliance function. The role is preferably based in Helsinki, Finland (or other UPM location), and you will report to VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal.

**In this role,** you will take a leading, hands-on role in mergers, acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions. You will operate across UPM's business areas and geographical footprint, and work with business area leaders, senior management, Legal and Compliance colleagues, other corporate functions and external advisers. In addition to legal support in transactions, you will contribute to developing consistent, efficient and practical M&A legal ways of working across UPM.

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

- leading and coordinating legal workstreams in acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, reorganizations and other strategic transactions;

- providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice to transaction teams, business leadership and senior management;

- coordinating legal due diligence and translating material findings into contractual protections, risk-mitigation actions and clear decision-making materials;

- drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share and asset purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements and ancillary documents;

- planning and coordinating signing, closing and transaction implementation activities;

- working with legal specialists and other functions on merger control, compliance, finance, tax, sustainability, employment, intellectual property, data protection and other relevant matters;

- managing external legal advisers, including scope, resourcing, quality and cost; and

- developing UPM's M&A legal governance, templates, playbooks and transaction tools (including legal tech & AI solutions), and promoting lessons learned and knowledge sharing.


The role involves travel according to transaction activity. UPM's team members currently work based on a hybrid work policy, but due to the collaborative and fast-paced nature of this role, frequent office presence is preferred.

**You could be an ideal candidate if you:**

- are an experienced M&A lawyer with a masters degree in law (or an equivalent legal qualification), who combines strong transaction expertise with sound business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

- have substantial M&A experience from a reputable law firm, an international company or a combination of both, in which context you have led complex domestic and cross-border transactions and have strong experience in legal due diligence as well as assessing, drafting and negotiating transaction documentation;

- take ownership, communicate clearly and move complex matters forward in demanding and time-sensitive situations;

- are a credible leader and influencer who can build trust across the organization, aligning stakeholders with different perspectives, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority;

- understand transaction structures and the interaction between legal, commercial, financial, tax, regulatory and operational considerations;

- can translate legal risks into clear, proportionate and actionable advice and have strong leadership, influencing, project-management, stakeholder-management and negotiation skills;

- work effectively with business leaders, internal specialists, external counsel and counterparties;

- are proactive, structured and comfortable managing several workstreams under pressure; and

- have excellent written and spoken English (Finnish or other relevant language skills are an advantage). Experience in listed-company transactions, carve-outs, joint ventures, merger control, foreign investment screening or post-merger integration is an advantage.


**UPM offers you:**

- **A meaningful role**: You will contribute directly to UPM's strategic development by supporting in transactions of significant importance to the company.

- **A key role with broad exposure**: You will work across UPM's businesses, functions, countries and organizational boundaries, including with senior management.

- **An opportunity to build**: As the first dedicated M&A Legal resource, you will help shape UPM's shared M&A legal practices, governance, tools and institutional knowledge.

- **Inspired and motivated colleagues**: You will join an experienced, collaborative and international Legal and Compliance community.

- **Development opportunities**: The role offers varied and demanding transaction work and broad exposure to UPM's businesses, strategy and operating environment.

- **Responsibility for people and the environment**: UPM's ethical principles embrace people and the environment, and the company continuously works to build a more sustainable future.


**_UPM_** _is a material solutions company, renewing products and entire value chains with an extensive portfolio of renewable fibers, advanced materials, decarbonization solutions, and communication papers. UPM's performance in sustainability has been recognized by third parties, including EcoVadis and the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices. UPM operates globally and employs approximately 15,100 people worldwide, with annual sales of approximately €9.7 billion. UPM's shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd._
